name: Jin Ming
profile: Jin Ming (金明) is a long-time Suning executive who joined founder Zhang Jindong's appliance retailer in 1993, became a director and shareholder, and in July 2010 replaced Sun Weimin as president. He was widely seen as a possible successor to Zhang. His wealth comes from his Suning shareholding; he was on the Hurun China list from 2007 to 2011.
interesting_fact: He spent his whole early career at Suning, joining straight out of university in 1993 when it was still a Nanjing air-conditioner retailer, and rose to president of what became one of China's largest electronics retailers.
deep_cut_fact: He joined Suning in 1993 straight after graduating, three years after Zhang Jindong founded it as a single air-conditioner shop in Nanjing, and in July 2010 succeeded Sun Weimin as company president.
current_role: Former President of Suning Appliance / Suning Commerce Group (2010 to about 2015); current role not publicly known
research_notes: In January 2015 there were reports, which Suning disputed, that he had stepped down as president; I found nothing public about him since. No personal channels. Suning.com's IR office is the only institutional route, and he may no longer be connected to it. A common name, so double-check identity before any outreach.

name: Qiao Tianming
profile: Qiao Tianming spent more than 30 years at Jiannanchun, one of the 'Mao-Wu-Jian' baijiu brands. He became chairman in 2001 and led its 2003 restructuring from state ownership, which made him a major owner. He largely vanished from public view around 2016, and in 2023 a Leshan court convicted him in a case tied to that restructuring.
interesting_fact: In 2012 he announced the RMB 2bn Datang Guojiu eco-park to add 20,000+ tonnes of base-liquor capacity; it was only formally unveiled in 2022, a decade later.
current_role: Former chairman of Sichuan Jiannanchun (JNC) Group, the Mianzhu baijiu maker; no active public role since c.2016
research_notes: Not a viable podcast guest. He was reported missing from public view around 2016, and in 2023 the Leshan Intermediate Court sentenced him to 5 years for bribery and illegally dividing state assets, with a RMB 400m fine (per media reports). Some reports say his son Qiao Yu took on management. Source: https://www.nbd.com.cn/articles/2018-07-24/1238247.html and tmtpost.

name: He Yan
profile: Chengdu-born (1961) computer engineer turned entrepreneur. Founded Chengdu Guoteng (GoldTel) Communications in 1995 and in 2003 Guoteng Microelectronics, forerunner of Zhenxin Technology, often called China's 'first BeiDou navigation stock'. After years of legal disputes over the parent group, courts confirmed her control and she was reinstated as Zhenxin's actual controller in Jan 2025.
interesting_fact: Her group built an early Chinese satellite-navigation chip business (BeiDou), with GoldTel spanning communications, power, tax/finance equipment, satellite comms and IC design.
deep_cut_fact: She studied computer science at Nanjing Institute of Technology (now Southeast University), started her career in 1983 at Dongfang Electric, and is an adjunct professor at the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (UESTC).
current_role: Controlling shareholder of Chengdu GoldTel (Guoteng) Electronics Group and, since Jan 2025, actual controller of Chengdu Zhenxin Technology (300101.SZ, BeiDou satellite-navigation chips)
research_notes: Highly sensitive: arrested in 2013-14 in connection with the Li Chuncheng corruption case and served prison time; long control fight with Zhenxin management continues. Not a recommended podcast target; no published contact found.

name: Wang Yangang
profile: Controlling shareholder, chairman and CEO of China Animal Healthcare, a veterinary-vaccine and animal-drug maker (incl. Inner Mongolia Bigvet Bio-tech) that listed via Singapore in 2007 and moved to Hong Kong in 2010. Hurun listed him with Li Chunhua (2014-2016). He stepped down from all board roles in July 2017; the shares were suspended in 2015 and the listing cancelled in January 2020.
interesting_fact: China Animal Healthcare was one of the few Chinese veterinary-vaccine makers to list overseas, first via a 2007 reverse takeover in Singapore before transferring to the Hong Kong main board in 2010.
current_role: Former chairman and CEO, China Animal Healthcare Ltd (HKEX: 0940); no current public role found
research_notes: Name also romanised Wang Yan Gang in HKEX filings. Company delisted (2020) after a long suspension, and he has kept no public profile since leaving in 2017; no published contacts. Probably a poor podcast target.

name: Li Chunhua
profile: HKEX filings name Madam Li Chunhua as the ultimate controlling party and a controlling shareholder of China Animal Healthcare, a Chinese veterinary drugs and vaccines maker; she is described as the spouse of former chairman and CEO Wang Yangang. The company's shares were suspended and provisional liquidators appointed in 2019, so her current business activity is unclear.
current_role: Former ultimate controlling shareholder, China Animal Healthcare Ltd (HKEX-listed; in provisional liquidation since 2019)
research_notes: Essentially no public profile; source: HKEX filings (e.g. https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2018/0517/ltn20180517013.pdf). Company in liquidation; Forbes wealth figure likely stale. Not a good outreach candidate.

name: Dou Qiling
profile: Dou Qiling (窦啟玲, b. 1960), a co-founder of Guizhou Yibai Pharmaceutical in Guiyang, has led the company as chair, vice-chair and general manager over the years; it makes traditional-Chinese-medicine and oncology drugs (e.g. Aidi injection). Her daughter Dou Yaqi is now vice-chair and general manager.
interesting_fact: She holds a doctorate in business administration and is one of the few women founder-chairs of a listed Chinese drugmaker; the family runs Yibai as a two-generation team.
current_role: Chairwoman and controlling shareholder, Guizhou Yibai Pharmaceutical Co. (SSE 600594)
research_notes: Pharma, not energy. Company has had several regulatory warnings (2019, 2024) - avoid in outreach. Contact via board secretary email.

name: Zhang Shiquan
profile: Zhang Shiquan (b. c.1950) co-founded Zhejiang Shibao in Yiwu in 1993 and, with family members, controls it. Shibao designs and makes automotive steering gears and steering-system components, with subsidiaries such as Siping Steering Gear and Wuhu Sterling Steering Systems. He was CEO until December 2017 and remains chairman.
interesting_fact: Shibao is dual-listed in Hong Kong and Shenzhen and is one of China's main independent steering-system suppliers, now developing electric power steering for new-energy and intelligent vehicles.
deep_cut_fact: He served as Shibao's chief executive for over 24 years, from its founding in June 1993 until December 2017, before handing the CEO job on while staying chairman.
current_role: Chairman and legal representative, Zhejiang Shibao Co. (浙江世宝, SZSE: 002703 / HKEX: 1057)
research_notes: Low media profile; the controlling group includes several Zhang family members. Best route is via the company's board secretary / IR (HKEX 1057 filings list company secretary contacts).

name: Sheng Faqiang
profile: Sheng Faqiang (盛发强) co-founded Beijing outdoor-gear brand Toread in 1999. In 2009 it listed on ChiNext, where it was called the 'first outdoor stock', and he served as chairman during its mid-2010s diversification. In 2021 the founders transferred control to an investor group led by chip-industry executive Li Ming, and Sheng stepped down as chairman.
interesting_fact: Toread was one of the first companies on Shenzhen's ChiNext growth board when it launched in 2009, and was dubbed China's 'first outdoor stock'.
deep_cut_fact: Before outdoor gear he was in printing: around 1993 he quit a state railway survey-and-design institute, worked as a salesman for a printing plant in Beihai, Guangxi, and then set up his own small printing company.
current_role: Co-founder and former chairman, Toread Holdings (探路者); no current executive role found
research_notes: Since 2021 Toread has been controlled by Li Ming's group, so the company website is no longer a direct route to Sheng. Low recent public profile; I found no personal channels.

name: Chen Fucheng
profile: Hong Kong-resident Chen Fucheng (陈福成) is the actual controller of Songz (松芝股份), a Shanghai maker of bus and passenger-car air-conditioning and thermal-management systems founded in 1998 and listed in Shenzhen in 2010. He owns about 43.8% of the company; day-to-day leadership is with chairman Chen Huanxiong. He was on the Hurun China list 2010-2021.
interesting_fact: Songz is a leading supplier of large and mid-size bus air conditioners and has moved into battery thermal-management systems for new-energy buses and passenger cars.
current_role: Controlling shareholder and actual controller (43.82%) of Shanghai Songz Automobile Air Conditioning Co. (SZ002454); holds no executive post
research_notes: 2024 annual report lists him as a Hong Kong (China) natural person with 'no' principal occupation/position - a passive owner with no public profile. Route via the board secretary / securities affairs office (IR email). Alive inferred from his continued listing as shareholder in the April 2025 filings.

name: Gu Qingwei
profile: Born 1972, a Jiangxi University of Finance & Economics graduate who spent 1996-2002 in Huawei's finance organisation before founding Dinghan in 2002. Dinghan makes rail-transit power systems (signal, platform-door and traction power supplies, train electrical equipment) and was among the first ChiNext listings (2009). Guangzhou state investor GIIC's capital arm is now controlling shareholder; Gu remains chairman and a 5%+ holder.
interesting_fact: Dinghan carries code 300011 - it was in the very first batch of 28 companies to list on Shenzhen's ChiNext board in October 2009; it supplies power systems for metro and high-speed rail across China.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding Dinghan he was a Huawei finance man for six years: section chief in finance management, CFO of Shandong Huawei, director of Huawei's Beijing financial shared-services centre and CFO of North Huawei. He holds EMBAs from both Peking and Tsinghua universities.
current_role: Founder & Chairman, Beijing Dinghan Technology Group (鼎汉技术, SZSE: 300011)
research_notes: Good energy/power-electronics angle (rail power supply). Board secretary office (ir@) is the formal route. Source is Dinghan 2024 annual report (bio section).

name: Xu Xianda
profile: Xu Xianda (徐咸大) and his children Xu Tuanhua and Xu Qingfang were the controlling shareholders of Guangdong Delian Group, a Shenzhen-listed maker of automotive fluids and fine chemicals. A September 2024 company filing says he has died and his shares await inheritance.
current_role: Deceased; was a controlling shareholder and actual controller of Guangdong Delian Group (002666.SZ, automotive fine chemicals)
research_notes: Deceased per Delian Group's Shenzhen exchange filing: https://disc.static.szse.cn/download/disc/disk03/finalpage/2024-09-09/77909eab-e7f8-4ba9-9d40-9d4c142dbee8.PDF (the family relationship is in the 2016 filing: https://disc.static.szse.cn/disc/disk01/finalpage/2016-03-28/9262a952-b6b2-4e19-81ad-213be012b88d.PDF). Exact date of death not found. The business is now run by his son Xu Tuanhua (chairman).

name: Chen Zhifeng
profile: Xinjiang entrepreneur whose Yema Group grew from trade with Central Asia into finance, property and tourism (Hurun China 2008-2014). He is best known as the man who brought Akhal-Teke 'heavenly horses' from Central Asia to China in numbers, running a breeding and exhibition base in Urumqi (Xinjiang Paleo-ecology Park).
interesting_fact: Claims the world's largest herd of Akhal-Teke horses, more than 300, imported from Turkmenistan via Kazakhstan to his ranch in Urumqi.
deep_cut_fact: He bred the first Akhal-Teke foal born in China and founded the country's first Akhal-Teke exhibition base; at the 2016 Huanta Rally in Tacheng he had the horses pay tribute at the opening ceremony.
current_role: Chairman, Yema (Wild Horse) Group Co., Ltd., Urumqi, Xinjiang
research_notes: Horse/Silk-Road angle is the best hook. No official Yema Group website or contacts found in this pass.

name: Yan Xiaoping
profile: Yan Xiaoping (闫晓平) is co-controller, with husband Tie Xiaorong, of Eppen Group, whose Ningxia Eppen Biotech became one of China's top bio-fermentation makers of MSG, lysine and other amino acids. In 2022 Xinghu Technology acquired 99.22% of Eppen Biotech for shares and cash, making Eppen Group a large Xinghu shareholder.
interesting_fact: Eppen Biotech describes itself as ranking among the top three companies in China's bio-fermentation industry (MSG, lysine, threonine and other amino acids, largely for food and animal feed).
current_role: Co-controlling shareholder of Eppen Group (伊品集团), a major shareholder of Guangdong Xinghu Technology (星湖科技, SSE: 600866)
research_notes: Very private; appears only in shareholding disclosures (e.g. 2024 equity-change report showing she and Tie Xiaorong each hold 28.30% of Eppen Group). Best institutional route would be Xinghu Technology's board office via its exchange filings; no personal/office contact published.

name: Ma Guoli
profile: Ma Guoli (马国利, b. Oct 1967) is a Changzhi, Shanxi entrepreneur; Hurun's 'Victory' is its rendering of his Chenggong ('Success') Group. He made his money in coal (Changzhi Liansheng Xizhang Coal, Xishan Coal) and built a 'one body, two wings' group: coal as the core, with Chenggong Auto (mini-trucks) and Chenggong General Aviation, which he still chairs, as the wings.
interesting_fact: Chenggong General Aviation, which he founded in 2010, says it was the first fixed-wing general-aviation company listed on China's NEEQ (2015). It flies cloud-seeding and emergency-rescue missions with a 16-aircraft fleet that includes Y-12s, King Airs and Airbus H225 heavy helicopters.
deep_cut_fact: Before coal, he served in the People's Armed Police Changzhi detachment (Oct 1985-Nov 1988), then ran Changzhi Dafa Industrial Co. as general manager from 1991, per his official biography in Chenggong Aviation's 2024 annual report.
current_role: Legal representative and controller, Shanxi Chenggong (Success) Investment Group; chairman, Shanxi Chenggong General Aviation (NEEQ: 834916)
research_notes: Hurun lists him as 马国利 | 成功集团 | 原煤、汽车、航空 (2010 list: https://finance.ifeng.com/money/special/hurun2010/20101012/2698001.shtml). The email is the Chenggong Aviation board office (board secretary Xu Huating). 'Alive: yes' because he signed the 2024 annual report in April 2025. An aviation and EV-truck angle could interest the podcast.

name: Zhang Chunlin
profile: Zhang Chunlin (张春霖) founded Shanghai-based SafBon Water Service, a water-treatment engineering and equipment company listed in Shenzhen, and chaired it from 1999 to October 2021. In 2021 he sold a 9.91% stake (about CNY 340m) to Shandong Gaochuang Construction Investment Group, which took control, and he left the company in 2022.
interesting_fact: He sold a 9.91% SafBon stake to state-backed Shandong Gaochuang Construction Investment for about CNY 340m, completed 21 June 2021, handing control of the water-treatment firm he had built since 1999 to a state-linked investor.
deep_cut_fact: He has an MBA from Antai College of Economics & Management at Shanghai Jiao Tong University.
current_role: Founder and former chairman of SafBon Water Service (Shanghai); listed as CEO of Shanghai Yingsu Environment & Technology
research_notes: Low profile since leaving SafBon. Career dates come from MarketScreener aggregator profiles. No published personal or office contact found.

name: Lin Xiuhao
profile: Hurun China (2017-2019) lists Lin Xiuhao (林秀浩) as the holder of 'Heiniu Investment' (黑牛 = Blackcow). The name points to Shantou's Black Cattle/Blackcow Food Co. (黑牛食品), a soy-milk and cereal maker whose listed shell was later renamed Visionox Technology, an OLED display maker. No source retrieved confirms Lin Xiuhao's own role.
interesting_fact: In July 2016 Black Cattle Food sold its whole food and beverage business (soy-milk powder, cereals, sesame paste, nut milks) for CNY 513m to Shenzhen Blackcow Capital Management, and the listed shell pivoted to tech. It is now Visionox, the OLED panel maker.
current_role: Unconfirmed; listed by Hurun against Heiniu Investment (黑牛投资)
research_notes: Identity not verified. Chinese search engines (Baidu, Sogou) blocked automated access, and English sources only show Lin Xiuhai (possibly a relative) as a Blackcow/Visionox director. Confirm via Blackcow Food's pre-2018 annual reports on cninfo.com.cn before any outreach. Very private, with no personal channels.

name: Qiu Guang
profile: Qiu Guang (邱光) founded Shenzhen Riland, a maker of inverter welding and cutting equipment sold under the Riland, Rilon, HiTronic and T&R brands. Riland listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext board in December 2010; Qiu remains chairman, CEO and actual controller, with the company now expanding into laser welding and robotic/intelligent welding systems.
interesting_fact: Riland was the first company in China's domestic inverter welding equipment industry to list on the A-share market (ChiNext, December 2010).
deep_cut_fact: Known in Western trade press as 'Simon Qiu', he signed a 2014 cooperation deal with German welding-robot maker CLOOS at the Beijing Essen Welding & Cutting fair, under which Riland produces machines in China under CLOOS quality control.
current_role: Chairman & CEO and controlling shareholder, Shenzhen Riland Industry Group (瑞凌股份, SZSE: 300154)
research_notes: Email is Riland's published marketing-department address (not a dedicated press/IR desk); the site also has an investor-relations section and online message form. Hurun lists wealth shared with Qi Xuexia.

name: Qi Xuexia
profile: Qi Xuexia (born 1975, master's degree) is a co-founder-generation director of Riland, a Shenzhen maker of inverter welding and cutting machines controlled by chairman and president Qiu Guang. Hurun lists the wealth jointly with Qiu. She was sales director of the predecessor company, Shenzhen Riland Industrial, and now also runs Riland International and several investment vehicles.
interesting_fact: Riland is one of China's leading inverter-welding-equipment brands, with a European subsidiary (Riland Europe) and recent units in intelligent welding and industrial investment.
deep_cut_fact: She started on the commercial side as sales director of Shenzhen Riland Industrial, before the 2010 ChiNext listing. She now also sits on the board of Shenzhen HIT (Harbin Institute of Technology) Sci-Tech Innovation Industry Development Co. and is a director of Shenzhen Hengte Gene.
current_role: Director and Assistant to the President, Shenzhen Riland Industry Co. (瑞凌股份, 300154.SZ)
research_notes: Wealth is shared with Qiu Guang (controller, chairman and president). Board secretary: Kong Liang; securities representative: Xiong Xiaoju. Both are reachable via the IR email. Very low media profile.

name: Guan Yanbin
profile: Heilongjiang entrepreneur who turned a failing county brick/plastics factory into a business, then in 1998 led 46 shareholders in buying the insolvent state-owned Wuchang Pharmaceutical, which became Kuihua (Sunflower) Pharmaceutical, a major OTC and children's medicine maker. He resigned as chairman in 2019; reports say he remains the controlling shareholder.
interesting_fact: In April 1998 he and 45 other individuals paid about RMB14.9m for Wuchang Pharmaceutical, which had been shut for nine months and was insolvent, and built it into a listed national brand.
deep_cut_fact: Early in China's reform era he voluntarily left a government office job to run a near-bankrupt small brick factory, switched it to plastic products, and in 1985 borrowed money to import equipment from Italy.
current_role: Founder and controlling shareholder, Kuihua (Sunflower) Pharmaceutical; no executive role since 2019
research_notes: IMPORTANT: In July 2020 a Daqing court convicted him of intentional homicide (case involving his ex-wife) and sentenced him to 11 years (https://finance.sina.cn/2020-07-17/detail-iivhvpwx5932813.d.html). He is likely in prison; not a suitable podcast guest. Kuihua is now run by other executives.

name: Lin Xinliang
profile: Appears on the Hurun China Rich List 2014-2018 with wealth attributed to a steel-plate business, Kerui Steel Plate (科瑞钢板). Searches in Chinese (蔺新亮) and English found no public record of this person or company, so identity and current status could not be verified.

name: Zhang Guoxing
profile: Listed on Hurun China 2010-2013 with Zhang Guoping for 'Shenda' (soft plastics). This most likely refers to Jiangsu Shenda Group, a privately held BOPP/plastic film maker whose president is Zhang Guoping, but no source checked confirms Zhang Guoxing's role there.

name: Huang Jiadi
profile: Huang Jiadi (黄嘉棣, b. 1962) is founder-chairman and controlling shareholder of Royal Group, a Guangxi dairy company built around buffalo milk that listed in Shenzhen in 2010. In July 2026 he agreed to sell ~5.8% to a Shenzhen green/low-carbon investment partnership, keeping ~20% and control.

current_role: Chairman and President, Royal Group Co. (皇氏集团, formerly Huangshi Dairy; 002329.SZ), Nanning, Guangxi

Company and he received regulatory warning letters over disclosure (2023-2024). Also president of the Shanghai Guangxi Chamber of Commerce and CKGSB Guangxi alumni association.

name: Gong Xuebin
profile: Gong Xuebin (b. 1937) built Longda Group in Laiyang, Shandong, from his post as head of the Laiyang brick and tile factory into a food conglomerate spanning vegetables, frozen foods and pork. With Gong Mingjie he was actual controller of Longda Meat Foodstuff (SZSE: 002726) at its 2014 IPO; that listed firm is now controlled by Lanrun Development.
interesting_fact: A two-time National People's Congress deputy (10th and 11th), he received China's National Model Worker title, the May Day Labour Medal and a lifetime achievement award from the Chinese meat industry.
deep_cut_fact: His early career was as Party secretary and factory director of the Laiyang Brick and Tile Factory before he led Longda; he also served as president of the Shandong Vegetable Association.
current_role: Chairman, Longda Group (龙大集团), Laiyang, Shandong (per 2014 IPO documents; current status unverified)
research_notes: Born 1937 (age ~89); no death report found but alive status unconfirmed. Listed Longda Meishi (ST龙大) is now controlled by Lanrun Development (chnfund.com report, 2026), so the Gong family's link is via private Longda Group.

name: Chen Mingjun
profile: Chen Mingjun (age 57 per 2025 annual-report data) founded Beijing publisher Thinkingdom in 2002 with a four-person team. It became China's largest importer of Japanese books and published all of Gabriel Garcia Marquez's works in Chinese. He was re-elected chairman for 2026-2029 and holds 56.79% of the listed company.
interesting_fact: Starting with One Hundred Years of Solitude (new Chinese edition, 2011) and ending with the memoir Living to Tell the Tale in April 2016, Thinkingdom published all 17 of Gabriel Garcia Marquez's works in China.
deep_cut_fact: Thinkingdom started in 2002 with just four people, including Chen and Japanese PhD student Shizuko Saruwatari, whom he recruited from Peking University's Chinese department. Its first title, the Korean novel 'Chrysanthemum Fragrance' (菊花香), was China's No. 1 literary bestseller of 2002.
current_role: Chairman and controlling shareholder (56.79%), Thinkingdom Media Group / 新经典文化股份有限公司 (SSE: 603096)
research_notes: Chairman term 2026-06-17 to 2029-06-16 per Sina Finance (https://finance.sina.com.cn/stock/aiassist/ggbd/2026-06-18/doc-inictxki3597694.shtml). Low personal media profile; corporate email main@readinglife.com is listed for the board secretary. Don't confuse him with Taiwan's 陳明俊.

name: Fan Jinsong
profile: Fan Jinsong founded Korrun in 2005 after a decade-plus in IT and manufacturing management, including at Lenovo. Korrun is a bag and luggage ODM/OEM maker that also owns consumer brands '90fen' (90FUN) and Guildford; it listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext at end-2016. He remains actual controller per the company's 2026 interim report.
interesting_fact: Korrun runs two businesses: contract manufacturing of bags for global brands, and its own consumer luggage brands 90FUN and Guildford.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding a luggage company he was a tech person: he studied microelectronics at Hefei University of Technology and worked at Lenovo Group, later earning an EMBA at Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business.
current_role: Founder, chairman and actual controller, Anhui Korrun Co. (SZSE ChiNext: 300577)
research_notes: IR/board-secretary contact email published in Korrun's 2026 interim report summary. Best route is via the board secretary's office.

name: Sun Taoran
profile: Peking University economics graduate (1991) and serial entrepreneur: co-founded BlueFocus (China's first listed PR firm) in 1996, led the launch of the Business Pocket (商务通) PDA at Hengji Weiye, then founded payments firm Lakala in 2005 with Lenovo and Lei Jun as backers. Lakala is now pushing an 'AI First' strategy and a planned Hong Kong H-share listing.
interesting_fact: As VP of Hengji Weiye from 1998 he led the launch of the 商务通 handheld, which reportedly held over 70% of China's PDA market in 1999-2001.
deep_cut_fact: After graduating from Peking University in 1991 he turned down his state-assigned job, joined Sida Group, rose from deputy manager of its ad department to GM of Sida Advertising within three years, and ran the computer magazine 《电脑时代周刊》 with a newspaper.
current_role: Founder and major shareholder of Lakala Payment (300773.SZ); founded it in 2005 as chairman and president
public_contact: ir_email: contact@lakala.com | contact_form: https://ir.p5w.net (Lakala investor interaction platform, used for its earnings calls)
research_notes: Lakala's 2026 IR events were fronted by director/GM Wang Guoqiang and board secretary Tang Hui, not Sun; his exact current board title was not confirmed. contact@lakala.com is the company mailbox listed in the 2024 annual report.

name: Tang Xinzheng
profile: Listed on Hurun China Rich List 2017-2021 with wealth attributed to 'Yinxin' (real estate). No source found online identifying him or the company beyond the Hurun listing.
research_notes: Searches for 唐鑫政 with 银信/房地产/胡润 returned no matching person; 'Yinxin' company could not be pinned down. Needs Hurun original listing to identify company and city.

name: Zhang Lingyun
profile: Co-founded Beijing digital-reading company iReader (掌阅) with Cheng Xiangjun in September 2008. The two ran the company jointly until about 2021, and it listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2017. Their concert-party agreement expired in Feb 2025 and was not renewed; Zhang still holds about 20.7% of the shares.
interesting_fact: Inside iReader he was the content builder: he championed the '掌阅公版' (iReader public-domain editions) project and invested heavily in copyright-management systems, while Cheng Xiangjun focused on channels.
deep_cut_fact: Per TMTPost, the name '掌阅' ('read in the palm') was chosen one night in 2008 by four young founders chatting in a bar at Beijing's Houhai; the company began charging for content from 2009.
current_role: Co-founder and major shareholder (~20.7%), iReader Technology (掌阅科技, SSE: 603533); listed by MarketScreener as former director
research_notes: Low public profile; Lanjinger describes his presence fading after 2021, and he sold 8.6M shares in Nov 2024. Mailing address in the 2025 SSE disclosure is iReader's office (四惠大厦, Chaoyang, Beijing): https://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2025-03-01/1222674658.PDF . Holding: https://uk.marketscreener.com/insider/LING-YUN-ZHANG-A29WRV/

name: Sun Gang
profile: Hurun lists Sun Gang (孙刚) with wealth from Anjoy Foods (安井食品, SSE 603345 / HKEX 2648), a Xiamen frozen-food maker. Anjoy's 2025 HK listing disclosures show a 孙钢 (different character) holding 15.97% of Guoli Minsheng, which held 25% of Anjoy; actual controllers are 杭建英 and 陆秋文. Chairman is 刘鸣鸣.
current_role: Shareholder (15.97%) of Fujian Guoli Minsheng (福建国力民生), controlling shareholder of Anjoy Foods - if 孙钢 is the same person
research_notes: Name character differs (孙刚 on Hurun vs 孙钢 in HK prospectus coverage, https://m.rccaijing.com/news-7287372888410879626.html); likely same passive shareholder but unconfirmed. Not an operating executive; no public profile found.

profile: Qi Jianping (戚建萍) was the legal representative of Zhejiang Honglei Copper Co., a Zhuji (Datang town) maker of enamelled wire and high-precision copper tubes, when it listed on the Shenzhen exchange in December 2011. name: Gong Mingjie
profile: Gong Mingjie chairs Longda Foodstuff Group, the Laiyang, Shandong food-processing group that was the controlling shareholder of the listed meat company Longda Meat (later Longda Meishi, SZSE: 002726). As of 2020 he and Gong Xuebin together held 64.17% of the group. The group sold blocks of its stake in the listed company in 2019-2020.
interesting_fact: Longda Group is based in Longwangzhuang subdistrict of Laiyang, a Shandong city known for food processing.
current_role: Chairman and legal representative of Longda Foodstuff Group (龙大食品集团), Laiyang, Shandong (as of 2020 filing)
research_notes: The 2020 filing lists Longda Group's phone, but no email/site was found. The listed company is now 'ST Longda' (2026). His current role was not verified after 2020.

name: Huang Jinxi
profile: Huang Jinxi (b. June 1949) is a co-founder of Homso (雄塑科技), a Foshan, Guangdong maker of plastic/polymer pipes and building materials for construction and municipal use, listed in Shenzhen in 2017. He served as vice-chairman for years and in Oct 2025 became honorary chairman, with Huang Ganxiong as chairman.
interesting_fact: He chaired Shunde Xiongsu Industrial (顺德区雄塑实业) from 1996 to 2003, the forerunner of today's listed Homso pipe business founded in Foshan's Nanhai district.
deep_cut_fact: His official filing bio notes he is a graduate of Longjiang Middle School in Longjiang town (Shunde), with high-school education, and holds Macau permanent residency.
current_role: Honorary Chairman (名誉董事长), Guangdong Homso / Xiongsu Technology (雄塑科技, SZ:300599), from Oct 2025
research_notes: Listed-company board data from Sina Finance (300599). Board secretary is Li Dan per Sina; company IR contact available in exchange filings. Low public profile.

name: Huang Changhua
profile: Huang Changhua (黄昌华), born 1968, has chaired and run Shenzhen Kingsignal since 2002; the company makes RF coaxial cables and communications interconnect products. A chemical-engineering graduate of South China University of Technology with a Tsinghua EMBA, he worked at Zhuzhou Chemical Industry Group, Zhuhai Hansheng and Jiangsu Hengtong before Kingsignal.
interesting_fact: He led Kingsignal's participation in drafting international standards for RF coaxial cable.
deep_cut_fact: Before Kingsignal he worked at cable maker Jiangsu Hengtong Group and at Hunan's Zhuzhou Chemical Industry Group; he was named to the Shenzhen Nanshan District science bureau expert pool for 2008-2009.
current_role: Chairman, Shenzhen Kingsignal Technology (深圳金信诺高新技术, 300252.SZ) (per undated profile; not re-verified)
research_notes: Bio source is a user-contributed profile site (maigoo); verify against Kingsignal annual report. Route via listed company's board secretary.

name: Bian Cheng
profile: Bian Cheng (边程, b. 1964, MBA, senior economist) joined Foshan-based Keda in 1998, served as director and general manager until 2012 and has chaired it since. Keda makes ceramic-tile machinery, builds tile/building-material plants overseas (notably Africa) and holds a strategic stake in lithium-salt producer Lanke Lithium, plus lithium-battery materials and smart-energy units.
interesting_fact: Keda's bet a decade ago on Lanke Lithium (Qinghai salt-lake lithium) and overseas tile plants is what Bian credits for its current results; Keda ranks 3rd in Foshan for tech innovation in the 2026 survey.
deep_cut_fact: At Foshan's 2026 entrepreneurs' day he told bosses their job is three things - find the right road, build the right team, split the money well - adding: 'Our boss mentality is the enemy of our future development' (我们老板的老板意识就是我们未来发展的敌人).
current_role: Chairman, Keda Industrial Group (科达制造, 600499.SH), since Aug 2012; president of Foshan Enterprise Confederation
research_notes: Energy angle: lithium salt (Lanke Lithium) and battery anode materials. Board secretary is Peng Qi (彭琦) per 10jqka. Resume from 10jqka company page.

name: Chen Gonghai
profile: Co-founder and chairman of Henan BCCY Environmental Energy (百川畅银, 300614.SZ), described as China's largest biogas (landfill-gas) power investor-operator. It has expanded into carbon-reduction trading and mobile energy-storage heating. He and Li Na are the actual controllers. In Jan 2026 they agreed to sell about 10% to Jiangsu Energy without changing control.
interesting_fact: BCCY is described as China's largest biogas power generation investor-operator. It captures methane from landfills to generate electricity and earn carbon-reduction credits.
deep_cut_fact: In April 2017 he gave up the general manager post at BCCY (then 百川环能) to bring in management talent, appointing Zhang Feng, formerly of PowerChina Road & Bridge, as GM.
current_role: Chairman and co-actual controller, Henan BCCY Environmental Energy Co. (百川畅银, 300614.SZ)
research_notes: Current-role and stake facts come from media citing filings (June 2026: ~27.45% held directly, Li Na ~4.82%): https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20260604A069MJ00. No published personal contact found; use the company board secretary/IR. Relevant to energy themes (landfill gas, storage).

name: Zhai Jun
profile: Zhai Jun (b. 1963) founded Beijing Wanji (now Vanjee Technology) in 1994 and has been its chairman and general manager since. The Shenzhen-listed (2016) company supplies road and urban transport customers with weigh-in-motion, DSRC (ETC) short-range communications and laser-detection products; he is its controlling shareholder.
interesting_fact: Vanjee, which Zhai founded in 1994, listed on the Shenzhen ChiNext board in October 2016 and its products span dynamic vehicle weighing, dedicated short-range communication for highway tolling and laser detection.
deep_cut_fact: Zhai holds an MBA and the rank of professor-level senior engineer (正高级工程师); he is in the Ministry of Science and Technology's national expert pool and was selected for the national 'Ten Thousand Talents' programme as a tech innovation-entrepreneurship talent.
current_role: Chairman and General Manager, Vanjee Technology (北京万集科技, SZSE: 300552)

name: Fan Shaowen
profile: Born 1953; trained in regional economics at Southwest Normal University. Spent 1976-91 at the Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences' Institute of Blood Transfusion, then Shuyang Pharma, Chongqing Dalin Biotech and Wuhan Ruide. Founded human-vaccine maker Olymvax in 2009 at age 56; daughter Fan Fan is vice-chair. Olymvax filed for a HK listing in Nov 2025.
interesting_fact: Founded his vaccine company at 56, after more than 30 years in blood-product and biotech roles.
deep_cut_fact: Headed the protein laboratory at the Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences' Institute of Blood Transfusion from 1976 to 1991; he is a licensed pharmacist and chief technician.
current_role: Chairman, general manager and legal representative, Chengdu Olymvax Biopharmaceuticals (欧林生物, STAR 688319)
research_notes: Career details from Chinese media summaries; verify against Olymvax annual report.

name: Fan Fan
profile: Fan Fan (b. ~1981) co-controls Chengdu-based vaccine maker Olymvax with her father, chairman Fan Shaowen. Its adsorbed tetanus vaccine drove ~91% of 2024 revenue; the pipeline targets drug-resistant bacteria (S. aureus vaccine in Phase III, oral H. pylori vaccine). Olymvax filed for a Hong Kong dual listing in Nov 2025.
interesting_fact: She came to vaccines from hospitality: undergraduate in international hotel management at Manchester Metropolitan, then an MSc at Imperial College London, CEIBS EMBA and a PhD from Southwest University of Political Science and Law.
deep_cut_fact: When Olymvax was founded she joined as an ordinary employee, starting in basic administration and HR roles before rising to vice chairman.
current_role: Vice Chairman and co-actual controller, Chengdu Olymvax Biopharmaceuticals (欧林生物, SSE STAR: 688319)
research_notes: UK-educated, so an English-language approach via IR may work. Less fit for energy/data-center theme (vaccines).

name: Gao Weiquan
profile: Chairman since 2015 of GETO New Materials (renamed GETO New Materials Group in 2026), a Jiangxi-based provider of aluminum formwork systems for construction (design, manufacture, sale and rental), listed in 2021. He and Liu Liqin are the actual controllers. GETO is expanding overseas, with subsidiaries in Kazakhstan, Indonesia and the UAE, and into prefabricated/modular products.
interesting_fact: GETO's overseas revenue rose about 39% in 2025 to 722m yuan; it has subsidiaries in Kazakhstan, Indonesia and the UAE.

current_role: Chairman and President, GETO New Materials Group (志特新材, SZSE: 300986)
research_notes: IR contact via SZSE filings (board secretary). Company name change announced Aug 2026: https://stock.stockstar.com/notice/SN2026080600000053.shtml

profile: Liu Liqin is named with chairman Gao Weiquan as an actual controller of Jiangxi GETO New Materials, a supplier of aluminium formwork systems for building construction founded in 2011 and listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext in April 2021. Before the IPO the two indirectly held about 64.8% via Zhuhai Kaiyue and three Zhuhai partnership platforms.
interesting_fact: GETO is described as a leading Chinese provider of aluminium formwork (reusable moulds for pouring concrete walls and floors), founded 8 Dec 2011 and listed in Shenzhen on 30 Apr 2021.
current_role: Co-actual controller (with chairman Gao Weiquan), Jiangxi GETO New Materials Corp. (300986.SZ)

name: Kwok Chi Leong
profile: Karl Kwok Chi Leung (郭志樑), BBS, MH, is chairman of Wing On Company International, the Hong Kong-listed holding company of the Wing On department-store business founded by the Kwok family in 1907; he is a third-generation family leader and the board is still Kwok-family run. He is also a prominent offshore yachtsman and Hong Kong sports administrator.
interesting_fact: His yacht Beau Geste won the 1997 Sydney to Hobart race overall, months after Hong Kong's handover; he says he remains the only Chinese skipper to have won it, and he also won the 2009 Transatlantic Maxi Yacht Cup and the China Sea Race twice.
deep_cut_fact: He first sailed as a university student in Minnesota in the late 1960s on a Hobie 16 catamaran; every boat he has owned since has been named Beau Geste, and he now also races a Fast 40 called Beau Ideal. He was president of the Sailing Federation of Hong Kong 1990-2010.
current_role: Executive Director and Chairman, Wing On Company International Limited (HKEX: 289)
research_notes: Hurun spelling 'Leong'; HKEX filings use 'Kwok Chi Leung Karl'. Event Ambassador for the 2027 Hong Kong Dragon World Championship - sailing is a strong outreach hook. Board list confirmed in HKEX announcement of 15 June 2026: https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0615/2026061500421.pdf

name: He Cailin
profile: Born February 1947, he is a high-school-educated senior engineer from Ningbo's Beilun district. He built Xuelong from a string of small local electrical-parts and plastic-fan factories into a listed maker of engine cooling fans and auto parts. His daughter He Pinyan, vice chairman and general manager, runs day-to-day operations.
interesting_fact: He led the cooling-fan working group of China's national internal-combustion-engine standardization technical committee, which means the founder of a village electrical-parts workshop helped write national standards for engine cooling fans.
deep_cut_fact: His first ventures were tiny Beilun workshops: he ran the Xiapu Telecom Parts Factory, the Xiapu Jiaoqi Electrical Parts Factory and the Beilun Automotive Plastic Fan Factory before founding Ningbo Xuelong Automotive Fan Factory. He has been named a 'Ningbo Charity Role Model'.
current_role: Chairman and actual controller, Xuelong Group Co., Ltd. (603949.SH), Ningbo
research_notes: Aged 79 and a family-run company, with his daughter He Pinyan as GM. The board secretary is Zhu Feifei. The bio is matched to the 1947-born chairman entry in the 2025 annual report's director list.

name: He Zenglin
profile: He Zenglin (贺增林) is the founder, chairman and actual controller of Xi'an Tianhe Defense Technology, a Shenzhen-listed defense electronics and communications company (about 25% stake per 2026 reporting). A serial Xi'an entrepreneur since the 1990s, he still chairs the company and was listed as chairman and GM in its 2025 filings.
interesting_fact: Before defense electronics he ran a string of Xi'an ventures: an electrical-machinery firm (1994-99), a network-engineering company (2001-05) and even a culture-and-tourism company, Shaanxi Yuhe (2000-10).
deep_cut_fact: His first company was Xi'an Xinfeng Electrical Machinery (西安信风机电), which he chaired and managed from 1994 to 1999, before founding Xi'an Tianwei Electronic System Engineering in 2001.
current_role: Chairman (and general manager), Xi'an Tianhe Defense Technology Co., Ltd. (天和防务, 300397.SZ)

profile: Liu Danying is the wife and acting-in-concert partner of He Zenglin, controlling shareholder of Xi'an Tianhe Defense Technology, a defense electronics maker. A Sept 2024 filing shows she held 3.04% directly (28.15% combined with He) and is a limited partner (10%) in Xi'an Junyao Linghang, the vehicle used for a private placement.
interesting_fact: In the 2024 private placement, the subscriber Xi'an Junyao Linghang was 90% funded by He Zenglin as general partner and 10% by Liu Danying as limited partner.

name: Jia Tongchun
profile: Jia Tongchun received 121.6 million new BNBM shares in October 2016, when BNBM issued shares to buy out the minority holders of its gypsum-board subsidiary Taishan Gypsum. He was the largest individual recipient in the deal, and it made him one of BNBM's main individual shareholders.
interesting_fact: In the 2016 CSRC-approved deal, BNBM issued 121,616,516 shares to Jia Tongchun, second only to Tai'an Guotai Minan Investment Group.
current_role: Major individual shareholder of Beijing New Building Materials (BNBM, 000786.SZ); no current executive role found

name: Jiang Shenghua
profile: Jiang Shenghua (蒋生华), born 1962 per Yahoo Finance, founded Zhejiang Huasheng Technology in 1996 in Haining's warp-knitting industrial park. The company makes plastic composite materials: drop-stitch airtight fabric for paddle boards, gym mats and inflatable boats, plus tarpaulin and lightbox advertising fabric. name: Wei Wenyuan
profile: Wei Wenyuan (尉文渊) built the Shanghai Stock Exchange and was its first general manager when it opened on 19 Dec 1990, pushing electronic matching, paperless shares and T+0 trading. His rich-list wealth came from an early stake in wind-turbine maker Sinovel (via Tibet Xinmeng), which he briefly chaired in 2012-13. Retired as of 2020.
interesting_fact: At 35, with no finance background, he volunteered to build the Shanghai Stock Exchange in six months, insisted on computer-matched trading instead of open outcry, and personally struck the opening gong in 1990.
deep_cut_fact: He came up with Shanghai's famous '6'-prefixed stock codes on the spot, copying how Shanghai phone numbers had just gone from six to seven digits by adding a leading 6; he also says the idea for paperless shares came to him one morning while brushing his teeth.
current_role: Retired; founding general manager of the Shanghai Stock Exchange and former chairman/acting president of Sinovel Wind (Huarui Fengdian)
research_notes: Retired and private; gave a long interview to Shanghai Securities News in Nov 2020 for the market's 30th anniversary. Sinovel stake via Tibet Xinmeng per bjnews (https://www.bjnews.com.cn/detail/155147330514089.html). Avoid Sinovel's later troubles. No contact route found.

interesting_fact: The brand name Chaohongji (潮鸿基) was meant to evoke '潮汕明珠，宏图大展，基业长青': pearl of Chaoshan, grand ambitions, an enduring foundation.
deep_cut_fact: He started as a 'gold broker' in Chaoyang, buying gold, having it processed on contract and reselling it. Around 1993, when HK/Taiwan-backed processors in Panyu and Shenzhen undercut family workshops, he decided the future was building a brand.
current_role: Co-founder and non-executive director, Guangdong CHJ Industry (潮宏基, 002345.SZ)
research_notes: Low public profile. Sources differ on the founding year (1996 vs 1997). The best route is CHJ's investor relations / board office (SZSE filings).

name: Zhuang Xiaohong
profile: Zhuang Xiaohong (age 59 per the company's 2025 annual disclosures) was the controlling shareholder and chairman of Shenzhen Zhongzhuang Construction, a listed building-decoration contractor, alongside her son Zhuang Zhannuo. A board reshuffle completed in January 2026 named Long Jisheng as chairman, and she is listed as having left the chairman role.
current_role: Former chairman of Shenzhen Zhongzhuang Construction Group (中装建设, SZSE: 002822); left the chair when the 6th board was elected in January 2026
research_notes: Departure confirmed in company remuneration disclosure (https://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H2_AN202604231821495876_1.pdf, lists her as 董事长 离任). The company is under ST risk-warning status and her shares were subject to court-arranged sales in 2025 per search summaries; not a promising outreach target. No published contacts.

name: Zhuang Zhannuo
profile: 庄展诺 (b. March 1986) is, with Zhuang Zhong (b. 1962, former chairman), an actual controller of Zhongzhuang Construction, a Shenzhen-listed building decoration and construction contractor. He served as a director and president of the company.
current_role: Co-actual controller of Shenzhen Zhongzhuang Construction Group (002822.SZ); formerly director and president (current role after Jan 2026 board re-election not confirmed)
research_notes: Caution: a 2025 CSRC Shenzhen administrative penalty decision names the company, Zhuang Zhong and Zhuang Zhannuo over overstated profits in 2017-2021 annual reports (https://www.csrc.gov.cn/shenzhen/c104320/c7553850/content.shtml). Not a straightforward outreach target.

name: Gong Ruiliang
profile: Associated with Changshu Ruite Electric, founded in 1993 in Changshu, Jiangsu, which makes marine and offshore electrical and automation systems (switchboards, circuit breakers, alarm/monitoring and navigation control). The company was renamed Changshu Guorui Technology in October 2020; its current board (chairman Ge Ying since 2022) does not list Gong.
current_role: Unclear; formerly linked to Changshu Ruite Electric (now Changshu Guorui Technology, SZSE: 300600)
research_notes: Company details from https://ng.investing.com/equities/changshu-ruite-electric-company-profile . A search snippet of Yahoo Finance mentioned 'Mr. Ruiliang Gong' (b. 1965) as GM and director, but I could not open that page to confirm; control of the company appears to have changed around 2020-2022.

name: Zhang Xiubing
profile: Zhang Xiubing (张秀兵) and Wan Lili (万丽莉) are listed as the actual controllers of Beijing-based Shunya International (宣亚国际), a PR/marketing agency founded in 2007 and listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext in February 2017. He served as a director, and as of Sept 2026 he was still its No. 2 shareholder, holding about 0.9% directly.
interesting_fact: Shunya, a traditional PR agency, has repositioned as 'martech', with digital advertising, data products and 'OrangeGPT' AI marketing tools.
current_role: Co-founding shareholder (with Wan Lili) of Shunya International Martech (300612.SZ); former director; no current executive role (chairman is Ren Xiang)
research_notes: Shareholding and controller data are from Eastmoney F10 (ShareholderResearch). I found no personal biography. Wealth shared with Wan Lili. The IR mailbox is the company's, not his.

name: Wan Lili
profile: Listed on Hurun China (2017-2020) with wealth from 'Shunya' (enterprise services), shared with Zhang Xiubing. No source found in this task identifying the company or this person.
research_notes: Searches for 万丽莉 / 张修兵 returned only unrelated namesakes (e.g. a Beijing Jiaotong University academic). Identity unverified; company name 'Shunya' could not be matched to a Chinese entity.

name: Ye Bin
profile: A Ye Bin (叶滨) is listed as a founding shareholder (~8.17%) of Zhuhai Dingli Communications (珠海世纪鼎利, est. Oct 2001, listed 2010, mobile network testing/optimization); legal representative is Li Tao.
research_notes: Do not confuse with Ben Ye (叶滨), founder of The ONE Music. Hurun listing 2010 only. Shareholding source: https://pitchhub.36kr.com/project/1678239424164868 (may be dated).

name: Chen Jianjun
profile: Chen Jianjun (b. Dec 1972) leads the Danyang, Jiangsu-based DARE group, whose brands include Power Dekor (圣象) flooring, DARE wood panels, packaging, DARE wheels (auto parts) and real estate, with new-materials and new-energy segments. He became group chairman in 2019 after running Power Dekor from 2015.
interesting_fact: DARE's car-wheel business (大亚车轮) is the 'car accessories' source in rich lists; the group now spans home furnishings, smart packaging, new materials and new energy, and DARE wheels exhibited at the 2026 Frankfurt auto-parts fair.
deep_cut_fact: Before joining the family group he worked from 1995 at Zhenjiang's foreign trade company and Danyang's foreign economic and trade commission; he holds a Fudan University MBA and won the 2019 China Forestry Industry Outstanding Contribution Award.
current_role: Chairman of the Board and President, DARE Technology Group (大亚科技集团, 'Dareglobal'); Chairman, Dare Power Dekor Home (大亚圣象, SZSE: 000910)
research_notes: Common name; identity matched via DARE group site listing 陈建军 as chairman/president. Maigoo bio is user-submitted. Avoid the well-reported family control dispute. New-energy segment may be a podcast hook.

name: He Jun
sec_insider_companies: TAIWAN SEMICONDUCTOR MANUFACTURING CO LTD (TSM) - VP
profile: He Jun (b.1969, engineer) has been in Jingsheng's management since 2010: director and VP on the first board, then president since Dec 2016 (per 36Kr). Jingsheng makes crystal-growth and wafer-processing equipment for solar silicon, 8-12 inch IC-grade wafers, sapphire and SiC. Filings list him as acting in concert with the controlling founders.
interesting_fact: Jingsheng says it leads globally in PV equipment technology and scale and is a leading Chinese supplier of growth and processing equipment for 8-12 inch IC-grade silicon wafers.
current_role: Director and President, Zhejiang Jingsheng Mechanical & Electrical (晶盛机电, SZSE: 300316) per third-party profile; senior executive per 2026 interim report
research_notes: The SEC 'TSMC VP' tag is a different person with the same name - ignore. Role history from https://pitchhub.36kr.com/project/2221842219204873 (third-party, undated); 2026 interim report shows ~6.35M executive-locked shares. jsjd@jsjd.cc is the company mailbox listed in the 2026 interim report.

name: Hu Mingming
profile: Chairman and controller of Delinhai, a Wuxi company specialising in cyanobacteria (blue-green algae) control and internal-load eutrophication treatment for lakes and reservoirs, listed on the STAR Market in July 2020. He is pushing 'AI + water governance'. In April 2026 he and two other holders agreed to sell 14.97% of the company to Zhu Mingming at 25 yuan/share, without change of control.
interesting_fact: During the 2008 Taihu blue-algae bloom crisis Delinhai pioneered the 'haul ashore, separate algae from water' emergency treatment approach used for large, recurring algal blooms.
deep_cut_fact: In a TMTPost interview he said that with AI empowerment 'lake governance will open a new digital-intelligence era', and framed China's dual-carbon action plan as both a challenge and an opportunity.
current_role: Chairman, controlling shareholder and actual controller, Wuxi Delinhai Environmental Technology (德林海, SSE STAR: 688069)
research_notes: He is reportedly a co-inventor on Delinhai algae-harvesting patents (seen only in a search snippet citing https://kmb.cas.cn/tzgg/202305/W020230510346422996328.pdf, unverified). Share transfer to Zhu Mingming pending as of May 2026 reports (https://www.nbd.com.cn/articles/2026-04-30/4377267.html).

name: Zheng Youwen
profile: Zheng Youwen was, with chairman Huang Junhui, an actual controller of Great-Sun Foods, a Shantou fruit-and-vegetable company covering growing, procurement, pre-cooling, cold storage, grading, packaging and cold-chain distribution, listed in Shanghai in 2016. In June 2025 Huang agreed to sell a 26.54% stake, with control to pass to Suzhou investors.
interesting_fact: In June 2025 Huang Junhui agreed to sell about 151m shares (26.54%) at RMB5.68 each (~RMB860m) to Suzhou Shenze Ruitai; Huang and Zheng also signed a voting-rights waiver, with actual control to move to Ye Tao, Liu Yang and Suzhou Asset Investment Management Group.
current_role: Former co-actual controller, Great-Sun Foods (Honghui Fruit & Vegetable, 603336.SH), Shantou; control transfer agreed June 2025
research_notes: Identity based on company disclosures listing Huang Junhui and Zheng Youwen as actual controllers (2016 prospectus; June 2025 equity change report). Completion of the 2025 transfer not confirmed in sources read. Very low public profile.

name: Wu Shiming
profile: Wu Shiming (吴仕明), born 1957, built Beijing Succeeder Technology, a Beijing maker of in-vitro diagnostic instruments and reagents for coagulation/thrombosis testing. He ran its predecessor as chairman and GM from 2003, has chaired the joint-stock company since Dec 2015, and still chairs the board (2025 annual report, Apr 2026).
interesting_fact: Before founding Succeeder he spent 1995-2003 at Beijing Shidi Scientific Instrument Co.; he was also Succeeder's general manager 2017-2020 before handing day-to-day management to Wang Hai, a former PLA General Hospital lab technician.
deep_cut_fact: Since April 2020 he has also been director and GM of Beijing Sainuo Xide Medical Technology, and since 2017 executive partner of Beijing Sainuoheng, Succeeder's employee share-ownership platform.
current_role: Chairman, Beijing Succeeder Technology Inc. (赛科希德, STAR Market: 688338)
research_notes: Hurun lists source as 'Succeeder' (Beijing Succeeder Technology / 赛科希德), not to be confused with Beijing SL Pharmaceutical (赛升药业). Low media profile; IR email is the best route.

name: Wu Tong
profile: Wu Tong — wealth from Succeeder (China) Estimated net worth $410M (Hurun China, 2020).

name: Yang Yinfen
profile: Yang Yinfen (杨银芬) is a co-founder of Wuhan-based snack retailer Bestore (良品铺子), alongside Yang Hongchun and Zhang Guoqiang. Yang was general manager 2017-2022 and chairman/GM from November 2023, then stepped down in March 2025 for personal reasons, remaining a director and strategy-committee member with the title of honorary chairman.
interesting_fact: As chairman, Yang launched Bestore's biggest-ever price cut in late 2023 - nearly 300 products, by up to 45% - framed as a return to 'good quality at friendly prices'.
deep_cut_fact: Yang championed the 'high quality, high looks, high experience' (高品质、高颜值、高体验) brand concept that repositioned Bestore as a premium snack brand; staff call Yang 'Fen Zong' (芬总).
current_role: Director and Honorary Chairman, Bestore Co., Ltd. (良品铺子, 603719.SH)
research_notes: Sources disagree on gender and join date (one says joined 2010 as director/deputy GM; others cite involvement from ~2008). Avoid the price-cut controversy angle; focus on brand-building.

name: Zhang Ye
profile: Zhang Ye co-founded Yiguo, one of China's earliest fresh-produce e-commerce platforms, in 2005 with Jin Guanglei and Mao Lu, after building Shanghai-based Yimao (founded 1999), a B2B commodity information and trading platform for chemicals, energy and pulp & paper. He studied at Shanghai Jiao Tong University.
interesting_fact: Yiguo began in 2005 when the founders asked whether consumers could buy quality imported fruit online at fair prices; co-founder Mao Lu was then doing customs clearance for imported fruit.
deep_cut_fact: He earned two bachelor's degrees at Shanghai Jiao Tong University, in industrial foreign trade and in computing; colleagues say his palate is weak, so co-founder Jin Guanglei spots over-seasoned dishes. His line: 'In the future there is no e-commerce, only fresh food.'
current_role: Co-founder and (as of 2016) chairman & CEO of Yiguo; chairman of eTrade/Yimao Holdings (易贸控股); current status not verified
research_notes: Very low-profile; a 2016 TMTPost profile said almost no public information on him existed. Yiguo's current state not verified in this pass; check before outreach. Yimao (eTrade) Holdings is the likely current route.

name: Zi Zhenjun
profile: Zi Zhenjun founded Venus Medtech (启明医疗), a Hangzhou maker of transcatheter heart valves and the first company incubated by the Dinova medical group to go public (Hong Kong). He is also a founding partner of Dinova Capital.
interesting_fact: Venus Medtech was the first IPO among the companies incubated by the Dinova medical group.
current_role: Founder of Venus Medtech (2500.HK); founding partner of Dinova (德诺) Capital
research_notes: Sensitive: Venus Medtech shares have been suspended since Nov 23, 2023. Jiemian reported a complaint accusing him of diverting company funds, which he did not answer before publication. Approach with caution.

name: Wu Jianlong
profile: Wu Jianlong (吴建龙, b. 1967, Shaoxing) founded Zhejiang Sunflower Light Energy (向日葵, brand Sunowe), a solar-cell and module maker he chaired when it listed on ChiNext in 2010. In 2019-20 the company sold its PV assets and bought his Beide Pharmaceutical, becoming Sunflower Great Health. He remains actual controller; Wu Shaoqin is now the legal representative.
interesting_fact: Rather than ride out the solar shakeout, he turned his listed solar company into a pharmaceutical business. The PV unit went to his private Shaoxing Sunflower Investment, and the listed company took over Zhejiang Beide Pharma, which he had already chaired since at least 2010.
deep_cut_fact: Before going into business he worked for the Huashe town government in Shaoxing County. He later earned an EMBA from Zhongnan University of Economics and Law and was a Shaoxing County people's congress deputy (2010 annual report bio).
current_role: Actual controller of Zhejiang Sunflower Great Health (300111.SZ, formerly Zhejiang Sunflower Light Energy / 'Sunowe'); chairman of Zhejiang Longhua New Century Real Estate
research_notes: Hurun 2021: 吴建龙 | 向日葵光能 | b.1967 Shaoxing | RMB 2.6bn. 'Sunowe' is Sunflower's English brand/domain, not a separate firm. The IR email belongs to board secretary Li Lan (published in the annual report). 'Alive: yes': he is named as actual controller in the 2025 annual report and in a Sept 2026 share-pledge release. He holds Hong Kong residency. Not the Taiwanese basketball coach.

research_notes: Identity unresolved; Hurun listing lapsed after 2013. Needs company full name/city from the original Hurun entry or a corporate-registry check.

name: Huo Dongling
profile: Huo Dongling (霍东龄, known in HK as Tony Fok Tung Ling, aged 69) co-founded Guangzhou-based Comba Telecom in 1997 after years trading telecom equipment; it became a major global supplier of base-station antennas, wireless access and DAS/indoor-coverage systems for mobile operators. He still chairs the board and leads group strategy.
interesting_fact: He was named Hong Kong CEO of the Year at the CNBC Asia Business Leader Awards 2006.
deep_cut_fact: He started out as a technical engineer (1982-87) at the Guangdong Post & Telecom Bureau's Microwave Telecommunications Main Station, and graduated in microwave communications from the Beijing Institute of Posts and Telecommunications in 1986.
current_role: Chairman & Executive Director, Comba Telecom Systems Holdings (2342.HK)
research_notes: Hurun pairs him with Chen Jingna. Uses the English name Fok Tung Ling in HKEX filings. Telecom-infrastructure angle (5G/Open RAN) fits a data/energy-infrastructure podcast. No published IR email found on the site; HKEX annual reports list company secretary contacts.

name: Yang Wenjiang
profile: Founded KingTeller, a Guangzhou maker of ATMs and financial self-service equipment, and is its controlling shareholder (~13.7% direct stake); resumed chairman/GM role in July 2023.
interesting_fact: Founder and controlling shareholder of one of China's domestic ATM makers.
current_role: Founder, Chairman & General Manager, Guangzhou KingTeller Technology Co., Ltd. (御银股份, SZSE: 002177)
research_notes: No public personal channels found; route via company board secretary.

name: Liang Yaohui
profile: Dongguan-born (1967) businessman who chaired the Oasis (Aoweisi) Group, owner of Dongguan's Prince Hotel and Zhongyuan Petroleum, and was a National People's Congress deputy; Hurun put his wealth at about RMB 2bn in 2008. He was removed as NPC deputy in 2014 and sentenced to life imprisonment in 2017.
current_role: None (former chairman, Oasis/Aoweisi Group, Dongguan; imprisoned)
research_notes: NOT a suitable outreach target: convicted in 2017 (life sentence) in the Dongguan Prince Hotel case; source zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/梁耀辉. Hurun listing (2007-2013) predates this. Recommend dropping from the list.

name: Li Chengwen
profile: Li Chengwen (李成文) appeared on the Hurun China Rich List from 2007 to 2014 with wealth from Fato, a low-voltage electrical equipment maker. A company called Huatong (FATO) Group, founded in 1987 in Wenzhou, makes low-voltage apparatus, distribution boxes and voltage regulators. No source directly links him to that firm or describes his current activities.
interesting_fact: FATO comes from the Wenzhou/Yueqing low-voltage electrical cluster that also produced Chint and Delixi. Directory listings say FATO makes more than 2,000 types of low-voltage electrical apparatus.
current_role: Listed as owner of Fato (low-voltage electrical equipment) on the Hurun China list (2007-2014). Likely Huatong (FATO) Group of Wenzhou, Zhejiang, but his current role is not verified.
research_notes: Not to be confused with Li Chengwen (b. 1955), the Chinese diplomat and former ambassador to Saudi Arabia. Off the Hurun list since 2014. The identity link to FATO is unconfirmed. Grid and electrical-equipment angle if confirmed.

name: Xu Baojin
profile: Xu Baojin (徐宝金, b. July 1960, Shaoxing) built Jinhui Holding Group, a Shaoxing private group in chemical fibre, property and investment; he owned 90% of it in 2015. Through Jinhui he invested in companies including Juneyao Airlines and Weiming Biomedical, where he was vice chairman when Weiming was injected into Wanchang Technology (002581) in 2015. Hurun listed him in 2009-10.
interesting_fact: His Jinhui Holding appeared among the pre-IPO investors disclosed in Shanghai budget carrier Juneyao Airlines' 2015 IPO documents. Those documents list Xu as Jinhui's 90% owner, chairman and president.
deep_cut_fact: He came out of Shaoxing's textile boom: a business-management graduate of Hangzhou Commercial College, he was general manager of the Shaoxing County Chemical Fibre Company from 1991 to 1995 before building Jinhui.
current_role: Chairman and president of Jinhui Holding Group (金晖控股集团, Shaoxing), per 2015 filings; former vice chairman of Weiming Biomedical
research_notes: Hurun 2009/2010 (hurun.net): 徐宝金 | 金晖控股集团 | chemical fibre, property, investment | b.1960, Shaoxing. Identity confirmed via Wanchang Technology's 2015 restructuring report and Juneyao's IPO appendix. In 2017 his Shaoxing Jinhui Yueshang partnership filed a stake-reduction report on Weiming (002581). No company website or contact found; private.

name: He Qinghua
profile: Hurun China (2007 to 2020) lists He Qinghua (何清华) with real-estate wealth from 'Dijing' (likely 帝景, a property developer). I could not identify the company or person; note that a different He Qinghua founded Sunward Intelligent Equipment (construction machinery).
research_notes: Unresolved: the web search quota ran out before research. Do not confuse him with He Qinghua of Sunward (山河智能), a Central South University professor, who is a different person. Needs a follow-up search.

name: Chen Desong
profile: Chen Desong co-founded Chunghsin Technology in Taizhou, Zhejiang (2007, with Jiang Zhenhui), an electronics ODM making flat-panel TVs, notebooks, tablets and phones that listed in Shanghai in 2015. He was chairman and legal representative, but the group's parent, Chunghsin Industry Group, later went into bankruptcy liquidation, and regulators named him the 'former actual controller' in 2023.
interesting_fact: Chunghsin grew from a 2007 Taizhou start-up into a Shanghai-listed contract manufacturer of TVs, notebooks, tablets and phones within about eight years.
current_role: Former chairman and actual controller of Chunghsin Technology Group (Zhongxin Keji, SSE: 603996), Taizhou, Zhejiang; no longer controller
research_notes: Not recommended for outreach. A 2023 filing says the CSRC warned and fined former controllers Chen Desong and Jiang Zhenhui RMB 1.6m each and imposed 10-year securities-market bans over undisclosed related-party fund occupation (https://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H2_AN202311171611365228_1.pdf). The parent group was ordered into bankruptcy liquidation (2021). Wealth figure is likely obsolete.

name: Yang Zewen
profile: Nanhai (Foshan) native who in 1988, aged 42, founded a school-run factory making building fans that became Nanfang Ventilator, a leading maker of ventilation systems for metros and nuclear power plants. The Yang family took full ownership by 2005 and listed it among the first 28 ChiNext stocks in 2009 (code 300004). In Dec 2022 he and son Yang Zijiang sold 32m shares, exiting as 5%+ holders.
interesting_fact: Nanfang Ventilator was ticker 300004, one of the inaugural batch of companies on Shenzhen's ChiNext board in Oct 2009; its pivot to subway and nuclear-plant ventilation came in 1998 at the urging of his then 27-year-old son, a Xi'an Jiaotong nuclear graduate.
deep_cut_fact: At IPO time he drew a chairman's salary of just RMB 150,000 a year, and the family had lent the company RMB 18.58m that was converted into equity in 2005; he let his sons front the 2009 IPO roadshow while he stayed out of view.
current_role: Founder and former chairman of Nanfang Ventilator / Nanfeng Co. (300004.SZ), Foshan; family sold down below 5% in Dec 2022
research_notes: Born c.1946; alive as of the Dec 2022 share-transfer filing (https://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H2_AN202212211581267520_1.pdf). Very private family that rarely gives interviews; company now under new control (Li Jie), so its IR is not his channel.

profile: Listed by Hurun China (2014-2021) for CSC (real estate), with Zheng Jiawen. Searches did not identify the company's full Chinese name or any public profile of Zheng Songxing (郑松兴).
current_role: Linked by Hurun to 'CSC' (real estate); not confirmed
research_notes: Could not identify which 'CSC' this is. Research was cut short when the shared web-search budget ran out; worth a follow-up in Chinese sources (e.g. Hurun list pages, Qichacha for 郑松兴).

name: Song Qi
profile: Ms. Song Qi co-founded Shenzhen supermarket chain Renrenle (Ren Ren Le) in 1996 and served as its vice chairman and vice president; by 2008 it ran about 100 hypermarkets and community supermarkets in 23 Chinese cities with revenue above CNY 6 billion, and listed in Shenzhen in 2010. After years of losses, a 2025 report said the chain was preparing to exit the A-share market.
interesting_fact: Renrenle was once Shenzhen's flagship home-grown retailer, competing head-on with Walmart and Carrefour in southern China.
current_role: Co-founder and director, Renrenle Commercial Group (SZSE: 002336); director of regional Renrenle subsidiaries
research_notes: Low public profile; bio from MarketScreener (https://in.marketscreener.com/insider/QI-SONG-A10QG0/), which says she founded Renrenle in 1996 (other sources credit He Jinming as founder). Company is shrinking/delisting, so wealth figure may be stale. No personal channels found.

name: Lu Tingxiu
profile: Lu Tingxiu (陆廷秀, b. 1960, Zhenjiang, Jiangsu) built CEEG (中电电气) from 1991 into a major power-transformer maker. In 2004 he co-founded solar-cell maker China Sunergy in Nanjing, which listed on NASDAQ in May 2007. He chaired CSUN from 2007 and returned as its CEO in September 2014, retiring from CEEG executive posts. Hurun listed him from 2012 to 2017.
interesting_fact: China Sunergy's CTO from its 2004 founding was Dr. Jianhua Zhao, formerly an associate professor at UNSW's Centre of Excellence for Advanced Silicon Photovoltaics, the lab known for record-efficiency silicon cells. That makes it an early Chinese solar firm with direct UNSW lineage.
deep_cut_fact: Per CSUN's 2014 20-F, he was general manager of CEEG's predecessor, Jiangsu CEEG Electrical Equipment Manufacturing, from 1991 to 2003. In 2005 he won the China Entrepreneur Confederation's China Excellent Entrepreneur award and was named one of Jiangsu's Top Ten Distinguished Youth Entrepreneurs.
current_role: Founder of China Electric Equipment Group (CEEG, Nanjing transformer maker) and co-founder/former chairman-CEO of China Sunergy (ex-NASDAQ: CSUN); current role unverified
research_notes: Hurun (Sina 2012 list): 陆廷秀 | 中电电气 | 江苏南京 | 变压器、光伏 | b.1960, Zhenjiang. Identity confirmed via SEC 20-F filings (CIK 1396247). CSUN later ran into financial difficulty and was delisted, so avoid that topic. CEEG website (ceeg.cn) did not resolve from here; no published personal or office contact found.

name: Chen Jingna
profile: Chen Jingna (陳靜娜) is the wife of Fok Tung Ling (Huo Dongling), co-founder and chairman of Comba Telecom, a Guangzhou/Hong Kong maker of wireless base-station antennas, RF and mobile-network infrastructure. Under the SFO she is deemed interested in his Comba shares, which is the basis of her Hurun listing.
interesting_fact: Comba Telecom's annual report lists her as a substantial shareholder solely through spousal interest in Fok Tung Ling's holding (via Prime Choice Investments).
current_role: Substantial shareholder (spousal/deemed interest), Comba Telecom Systems Holdings (HKEX 2342); no executive role found
research_notes: Very private; no public role or interviews found. Better podcast target is husband Fok Tung Ling (Comba chairman); route via Comba IR. Alive status not confirmed (still listed in 2020 annual report).

name: Liu Tie
profile: Hurun's 2014 entry: 刘铁, b.1972, Zhengzhou, Ruimaotong (瑞茂通), coal supply chain, RMB 2.4bn. No 刘铁 appears in Ruimaotong's filings. Its co-founder and vice chairman Liu Yi (刘轶) was 41 in 2013 and is Zhengzhou-based, so 刘铁 is probably a misprint. Liu Yi ran Henan Hechang Property from 2007 and co-founded the Zhongrui group, which took Ruimaotong public via a 2012 backdoor listing.
interesting_fact: The coal supply-chain company listed on the stock market through an unlikely shell. Ruimaotong (600180) began life as Shandong Jiufa Edible Fungus Co., a mushroom producer listed in 1998, before the Zhongrui group of Wan Yongxing and Liu Yi took it over in 2012.
current_role: Probably Liu Yi (刘轶), co-founder and former vice chairman of CCS Supply Chain Management (瑞茂通, 600180.SH, Zhengzhou) and a concert-party holder with controller Wan Yongxing

name: Zhang Yichen
profile: Zhang Yichen (张懿宸), born 1963 and an MIT graduate, started on Wall Street in 1987 and worked at Bank of Tokyo and Merrill Lynch before joining CITIC Pacific in 2000. He founded CITIC Capital in 2002 and built it into a major China-focused alternative investment firm whose deals include McDonald's China, Alibaba, SF Express and Focus Media. He also chairs Harbin Pharmaceutical and GNC and sits on the HKEX board.
interesting_fact: Through CITIC Capital and Trustar he chairs McDonald's master franchise business in mainland China and Hong Kong, as well as the US supplement chain GNC.
deep_cut_fact: His first Wall Street job, in 1987, was at Greenwich Capital Markets. He later headed proprietary trading at Bank of Tokyo in New York. In a 2014 interview he recommended Charles Duhigg's 'The Power of Habit' and called China's anti-corruption drive 'a colossal exercise in changing habits.'
current_role: Chairman and CEO, CITIC Capital; Chairman, Trustar Capital; Chairman of McDonald's China master franchise
research_notes: CITIC Capital's media page directs press enquiries to Corporate Relations (Director: Cindy Tam) at info@citiccapital.com. He is a regular speaker at WEF, Milken and Boao forums, which are good warm contexts for an approach.

name: Li Yuzheng
profile: Li Yuzhen (李玉珍; input romanisation 'Li Yuzheng') controls Guangzhou-based Jinyi Cinemas (金逸影视), one of China's larger cinema chains, listed in Shenzhen in 2017, alongside co-controller Li Genchang. She holds about 53.7% directly and appeared on the Hurun China list 2012-2020 (cinemas and real estate). The company elected Qiu Xianbang as new chairman in June 2026.
interesting_fact: In June 2026 Jinyi's board turned over: Li Xiaowen stepped down as chairman after about 16 years in the role (remaining a director) and Qiu Xianbang was elected chairman; Li Yuzhen remains the majority owner.
current_role: Controlling shareholder (53.72%) and co-actual controller of Jinyi Film & Television / Jinyi Cinemas (SZ002905), Guangzhou
research_notes: Correct Chinese name per filings is 李玉珍 (Li Yuzhen). She holds no listed executive post and keeps a very low profile; best route is the company's securities/IR office.

name: Teng Daochun
profile: Teng Daochun (滕道春, b. Jan 1970) is a Xuzhou industrialist who controlled Xuzhou Tianyu Investment (77.67% in 2006). Its businesses span coke, pig iron, molybdenum alloys and coal washing, later grouped as Tianyu Energy. In 2006 Tianyu joined Shougang in restructuring S*ST Shengfang (000620). In 2017 HKEX-listed 1187 proposed buying his power-and-heat business. Hurun listed him 2012-2019.
interesting_fact: In 2006 his Tianyu Investment joined state steel giant Shougang in a restructuring of Shenzhen-listed S*ST Shengfang (000620), a rare private-plus-SOE tie-up for a Xuzhou family firm.
deep_cut_fact: He became a factory boss young. Per a 2006 filing, he was GM of Xuzhou Tai'an Co. at 20 (1990-92) and then director of Xuzhou No. 2 Ferroalloy Plant for a decade (1992-2002), before running the Huanyu molybdenum and coking businesses.
current_role: Controller of the Tianyu group (Xuzhou Tianyu Investment / Jiangsu Tianyu Energy Technology Group), Xuzhou, Jiangsu; coking coal, ferroalloys, power and heat
research_notes: Hurun 2019 (hurun.net): 滕道春 | 天裕能源 | 焦煤 | Xuzhou | family wealth RMB 2.8bn. 'Tianue' = 天裕. HKEX 1187 resumption-proposal update (Feb 2017) naming him: https://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2017-02-28/1203117765.PDF. Low public profile; no published contact found.

name: Jiang Yong
profile: Born 1968, Jiang Yong is the brother and concert party of Bailing founder Jiang Wei; together they control Guizhou Bailing, an Anshun-based maker of Miao ethnic-minority traditional medicines. He was previously deputy director of the Anshun Pharmaceutical Factory and VP of several Bailing companies, overseeing sales.
interesting_fact: Bailing specialises in Miao (Hmong) ethnic medicine from Guizhou - a niche of Chinese traditional pharmacy rooted in the province's minority communities.
current_role: Director (since 2007) and co-controlling shareholder of Guizhou Bailing Group Pharmaceutical (贵州百灵, SZSE: 002424); former VP (2007-2021)
research_notes: CAUTION: In 2026 the CSRC found Bailing's 2019-2023 annual reports misstated; Jiang Yong (as director/VP) was warned and fined RMB 2M and Jiang Wei resigned as chairman (March 2026). Not a suitable or easy outreach target; poor podcast fit. Company now trades as ST Bailing.

name: Qian Zhida
profile: Born 1967; senior economist and controlling shareholder of Brother Enterprises, a Haining, Zhejiang chemicals group founded in 1991 and listed in 2011. It started in leather chemicals and now spans vitamins (K3, B1, niacinamide), flavours, APIs, catalysts and chromium salts, with plants in Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Jiangxi and South Africa. He was formerly also its president.

current_role: Chairman, Brother Enterprises Holding Co., Ltd. (兄弟科技, SZSE: 002562), re-elected Sept 2026 for 2026-2029
research_notes: Low media profile. Best route: board secretary Qian Liuhua via stock@brother.com.cn. Web-search budget ran out mid-lane, so only filings and the company site were used.

current_role: Former chairman and actual controller of Zhejiang Hugeleaf (浙江瀚叶股份); current role unknown
