name: Li Lianzhu
profile: Li Lianzhu (李连柱) moved from software into furniture: after co-founding design-software maker Yuanfang Software, he founded Shangpin Home Collection in 2004, pioneering made-to-measure whole-home furniture with a C2B+O2O model. It listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext in 2017. At the 2026 Two Sessions he pushed AI and 3D printing for personalised manufacturing.
interesting_fact: Shangpin was the first home-furnishing company to list on Shenzhen's ChiNext board (2017); in 2026 Li argued AI plus 3D printing can deliver truly 'one person, one product' (一人一品) customised furniture.
deep_cut_fact: Before furniture, Li co-founded Guangzhou Yuanfang Software (圆方软件) in 1994 with university classmates, building interior-design and furniture design software - the IT roots behind Shangpin's digital custom-furniture model.
current_role: Chairman, Guangzhou Shangpin Home Collection (尚品宅配, SZSE: 300616); member of the National Committee of the CPPCC
research_notes: Active public figure (CPPCC member, gives media interviews at Two Sessions). Company IR is handled by board secretary He Yubing; best formal route is Shangpin's investor-relations channel / SZSE Hudongyi platform. No published email verified in sources checked.

name: Li Yikui
profile: Li Yikui (李一奎, b. 1951, Jilin) founded what became Tonghua Dongbao in 1984 from a small Tonghua tonic factory. He took it public in Shanghai in 1994, and it grew into a major Chinese insulin maker within the Dongbao Industrial Group. He served as a deputy to the 8th and 10th National People's Congress. Group leadership has since passed to the next generation.
interesting_fact: He started the business in 1984 as the Tonghua Baishan tonic/pharma factory. It listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 1994 and now sells injectable insulin internationally.
deep_cut_fact: He grew up in a poor family in Tonghua, Jilin, and graduated from Peking University's biology department with a degree in microbiology and biochemistry. He worked at a state-owned pharmaceutical plant before founding Dongbao.
current_role: Founder of Dongbao Industrial Group and Tonghua Dongbao Pharmaceutical (SSE: 600867). His son Li Jiahong has chaired Tonghua Dongbao since March 2024.
public_contact: ir_email: thdb600867@thdb.com (Tonghua Dongbao securities department) | office_email: bgs@thdb.com (company general office) | official_website: http://www.thdb.com
research_notes: Alive status not freshly confirmed (zh.wikipedia listed him as living as of 2021; no death report seen). He has handed day-to-day control to the next generation, so the company route is the only published channel. Web-search budget ran out during this lane, so this entry relied on direct page fetches.

Wison started as a chemical-engineering firm in 1997 and now spans energy engineering, offshore/marine fabrication (FLNG) and new energies. interesting_fact: Wison won a 2012 contract for a floating LNG facility off Colombia's coast, an early step into floating-liquefaction vessels. The group now runs Wison New Energies from Shanghai's Zhangjiang Hi-tech Park.
current_role: No executive role found; holds an interest in Wison as the spouse of founder Hua Bangsong
research_notes: No public profile of her own. The wealth is the Hua family's Wison stake (source on spousal interest: https://test.gurufocus.com/insider/239900/huang-xing). For an energy podcast the natural guest is Wison's leadership (Hua Bangsong or Wison New Energies), reachable via Wison's corporate marketing email. Contacts are company-level only.

name: Yang Liangzhi
profile: Yang Liangzhi (杨良志) leads Richinfo Technology, a Shenzhen software company founded in 2004 that built its business as an operating partner for China Mobile's 139 Mailbox and enterprise email, later expanding into digital marketing, cloud and collaboration software. Richinfo listed on ChiNext in March 2018; Yang was re-elected chairman of the fourth board in 2025 and the company now pushes its Rich AIBox AI application platform.
interesting_fact: Richinfo is the operations partner behind China Mobile's '139 Mailbox' consumer email service, which grew out of its mobile-email products around 2009.

research_notes: Founder status per one secondary source (altss.com) only. Hurun lists wealth shared with Wang Haihong. IR handled by board office (board secretary Wang Xin per 2025 filings); use Shenzhen exchange/cninfo IR channels.

Richinfo's controllers are Yang Liangzhi (MIT MBA, chairman) and Zeng Zhijun (acting in concert). The Richinfo board-office email is the only route.

name: Dai Kebin
profile: Born in the 1980s, he studied finance at Sun Yat-sen University (2003) and spent five years at P&G before founding a headhunting site that became Liepin, China's leading mid-to-senior talent recruitment platform. He took it public in Hong Kong in 2018, renamed it Tongdao Liepin in 2022, launched overseas brand Leapin from Hong Kong in 2023 and is pushing AI interview products.
interesting_fact: Liepin's 'BHC' model connects Businesses, Headhunters and Candidates; its 2018 IPO was billed as Hong Kong's first technology HR stock. Fortune China has named him to its 40 Under 40 list three times.
deep_cut_fact: In 2011 he scrapped Liepin's original offline headhunting model and went fully online, despite a painful revenue dip. He told 36Kr: 'Entrepreneurs cannot blame their failures on the winter' (创业者不能把做得不成功的原因归结于寒冬).
current_role: Founder, Chairman and CEO, Tongdao Liepin Group (HKEX: 6100)
research_notes: A visible speaker (e.g. HK Global Talent Summit), so a podcast request is plausible. AI-in-hiring angle fits the data-center theme. The 2011 pivot is described at https://www.huxiu.com/article/18361.html

name: Wen Zhifen
profile: A member of the founding Wen family and a named actual controller of Wens, he rose from vice president to president and vice chairman/CEO before becoming chairman. Wens, a 1983 village chicken partnership, is now one of China's largest pig and poultry producers with 100bn+ yuan revenue; he calls modern farming a high-tech, R&D-driven industry.
interesting_fact: Under his chairmanship Wens crossed the 100-billion-yuan revenue mark, yet he has publicly said he does not want the company to 'run too fast'.
deep_cut_fact: He trained in animal husbandry at South China Agricultural University's animal science department, later earned a doctorate-level degree at Sun Yat-sen University, and has been named a National Model Worker and shared a National Science and Technology Progress Award (second class).
current_role: Chairman, Wens Foodstuff Group (300498.SZ), Yunfu, Guangdong
research_notes: Hurun lists the fortune shared with Sun Fen (also a named actual controller). IR email is the board secretary's office. Education/awards from a third-party profile (cnpp.cn) - verify before use.

current_role: Member of the Wen family group named as joint actual controllers of Wens Foodstuff Group (SZSE: 300498); no executive role disclosed
research_notes: Very private, no public profile; exact family relationship not confirmed in sources checked. Hurun listing shared with Wen Zhifen (Wens chairman/legal representative). Route via Wens board office.

name: Liu Chenyan
profile: Liu Chengyan (刘成彦, b. 1964; listed as 'Liu Chenyan') joined CDN/edge-cloud provider Wangsu Science & Technology as COO in 2001, a year after its founding by Chen Baozhen, became its second-largest shareholder and long-time chairman after its 2009 listing. He stepped down as chairman on 7 Apr 2025 for personal reasons, the same day he completed buying Wangsu's 42.3% stake in AI-cloud unit Cloudsway for RMB105.7m.

current_role: Director (former chairman to Apr 2025) and major shareholder, Wangsu Science & Technology (300017.SZ); controls Cloudsway via Fromindo Limited
research_notes: Highly relevant to data-center/edge-cloud theme (CDN, edge computing, AI inference cloud via Cloudsway). Times Weekly reports he bought an 18% Wangsu stake in 2005 for RMB1.8m (https://m.163.com/dy/article/JV2KQS900519APGA.html). Current director status after 2025 not re-verified.

name: Jiang Xuezhen
profile: Jiang Xuezhen (b. July 1960) has chaired Changzhou Tenglong Auto Parts, a Shanghai-listed maker of auto thermal-management and fluid piping parts, since 2006. He previously ran a Wujin crane-parts factory (1990-2006). Since 2020 he has also chaired Sunrise Power (新源动力), a hydrogen fuel-cell company.

current_role: Chairman, Changzhou Tenglong Auto Parts (腾龙股份, SSE: 603158); Chairman, Sunrise Power (新源动力)

In August 2019 Kingkey Group agreed to acquire 100% of Huachao from them, taking Kingkey's control of Kangdaer to 71.5% and triggering a tender offer at RMB 18.97/share.

research_notes: Hurun 'Hua Chao' = 华超投资. Very low public profile, no personal channels found. Huachao's period at Kangdaer involved a contested control dispute with Kingkey; avoid that topic in outreach. Whether he still holds significant wealth after the 2019 sale is unknown.

research_notes: Romanized in English databases as Xiao Jun Jing. Company traded as ST Renzixing; route via Surfilter board secretary/IR.

name: Li qingliang
profile: Li Qingliang (李清凉, Li Ching Leung) is one of the shareholder-directors of Xinyi Glass, the Hong Kong-listed float, auto and architectural glass maker founded in 1988 by a group of Fujian-origin partners led by Lee Yin Yee; his Hurun wealth (shared with Dong Lvmin) reflects that stake. Filings indicate he was appointed executive director in Aug 2004 and redesignated non-executive in Sept 2005, after serving as assistant GM of the group's Wuhu industrial park.
interesting_fact: Xinyi Solar, formed in 2008 when Xinyi Glass split off its solar PV glass business, is described as the world's largest solar cover-glass producer - a direct link from his glass fortune to the energy transition.
current_role: Non-executive director, Xinyi Glass Holdings (HKEX: 00868) per company filings summarised by Lixinger
research_notes: Very low profile; no interviews found. Career details from Lixinger summary of HKEX filings (https://www.lixinger.com/equity/company/detail/hk/00868/868/senior-executive/resume) - verify against the latest Xinyi Glass annual report. Search budget ran out before a deep-cut could be sourced.

name: Dong Lvmin
profile: Listed by Hurun China 2021 with wealth from Xinyi Glass (信义玻璃, 0868.HK), jointly with Li Qingliang (likely Li Ching Leung, a known Xinyi co-founder shareholder). Xinyi Glass, founded in 1988 by a group of Fujian (Jinjiang) partners, makes float, auto and architectural glass; its sister company Xinyi Solar makes PV glass. Dong Lvmin's own role could not be confirmed.
interesting_fact: Xinyi Glass, founded in 1988 and listed in Hong Kong in 2005, supplies automotive glass to carmakers including Ford, GM and Volkswagen and is a Hang Seng Index component.
research_notes: Not among Xinyi Glass's listed board (chairman Lee Yin Yee, Tung Ching Bor, Tung Ching Sai); likely a passive co-founder shareholder. The Cantonese romanisation in HKEX filings is unknown. Identity unverified because the web search budget ran out.

name: Li Xiaofan
profile: Listed (as 李潇帆) among shareholders of Xiamen/Zhangzhou-based Leedarson IoT Technology alongside legal representative Li Jianghuai (27%). Leedarson is an ODM of smart lighting and IoT devices and a Zigbee/CSA board member company.
current_role: Shareholder, Leedarson IoT Technology Inc. (立达信, SHSE: 605365)
research_notes: Romanization 李潇帆 vs 李晓帆 unconfirmed; no executive role found. Keep minimal.

name: Liang Hongjian
profile: Liang Hongjian (b. 1972) helped build Shenzhen Consys from 2004, serving as deputy GM and director (2016-2022) of the maker of military electronic information equipment (command-and-control, radar signal processing). It listed on the STAR Market; he holds about 18% and now drives its chip subsidiary Gaoxin Sitong.
interesting_fact: He led R&D on Consys' command-information processing equipment, software-radar processing equipment and portable wireless command terminals, and now focuses on the company's in-house chip business.
deep_cut_fact: He began as an engineer in ZTE's switching division (1996-99), took a year out for further university study, then ran the OS department at Shenzhen Shengbo embedded-computer company before joining Consys in 2004.
current_role: Deputy GM of Gaoxin Sitong (chip subsidiary) and core technical staff, Shenzhen Consys Science & Technology (SH:688788); ~18% shareholder
research_notes: Defence-electronics company; may be reluctant to do media. Hurun 2021 'Consys' matched via Sina/annual report.

name: Lin Jinxi
profile: Lin Jinxi (林金锡) founded Changzhou Almaden in 2006. The company specialises in anti-reflective coated and ultra-thin photovoltaic glass for solar modules and supplies major panel makers such as JA Solar. He remains chairman and is taking Almaden overseas: in 2025 it announced a CNY 1.75B, 500,000-ton-per-year solar glass plant in the UAE.
interesting_fact: Almaden's planned UAE plant will make 1.6mm ultra-thin PV glass in the same industrial zone as Trina Solar's planned $5B Middle East manufacturing base.
deep_cut_fact: He is listed as an inventor on Almaden's own PV-glass patent filings. He is also vice president of the China New Energy Chamber of Commerce and of the Changzhou Photovoltaic Industry Association.
current_role: Founder, Chairman & General Manager, Changzhou Almaden Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 002623), a photovoltaic glass maker
public_contact: office_email: info@czamd.com (Almaden company general inbox) | official_website: http://www.czamd.com
research_notes: Strong energy-podcast fit (solar supply chain, Middle East expansion). The company email is a general inbox. For a formal approach, use the board secretary listed in the SZSE annual report. The patent link rests on Justia records, which were not directly verified (blocked).

name: Mark Liu
profile: Mark Liu (劉德音) is the Taiwanese engineer who spent 30 years at TSMC, as co-CEO (2013-18) and executive chairman (2018-June 2024), while it became the world's dominant foundry and the main chipmaker for AI. Since retiring he has founded a policy center at UC Berkeley, chairs his own investment fund and joined Micron's board.
interesting_fact: He began his career at Intel as a processor designer, then did high-speed electronics research at AT&T Bell Labs before joining TSMC in 1993.
deep_cut_fact: He holds an MS (1980) and PhD (1983) in electrical engineering from UC Berkeley. In February 2025 he founded TCIP at Berkeley's College of Engineering to advise US policymakers on advanced manufacturing; its first policy study was on rechargeable batteries.
current_role: Founder & Chairman, J&M Copper Beech Ventures; founder of UC Berkeley's Technology Competitiveness and Industrial Policy Center (TCIP); Micron board director (since Mar 2025)
research_notes: He is from Taiwan, not mainland China, although Hurun listed him under its China list. He speaks publicly on US-Taiwan industrial policy. TCIP, through Berkeley Engineering, is the best route; I could not load tcip.org (403) to check for a contact form.

name: Chen Yuanfen
profile: Chen Yuanfen (陈远芬) appears on Hurun China 2021 together with Liu Nianxin (刘年新), founder-chairman of Shenzhen Hongtao Decoration (now Hongtao Group), a public-building interior-fit-out contractor for theatres, libraries, hotels and stadiums. She is a top-10 shareholder of the company but holds no board or management role, and her relationship to Liu is not stated in public filings.
interesting_fact: Hongtao began in 1985 as a state-owned Shenzhen decoration engineering firm. It was privatised in 2003 under Liu Nianxin and listed in 2009, specialising in fit-outs for theatres, conference halls and stadiums.
current_role: Shareholder (top-10, about 0.3%) of Shenzhen Hongtao Group Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 002325); no executive or board role
research_notes: Web search quota ran out partway through this lane, so the information comes from Sina Finance company and shareholder pages. Hongtao is now under *ST special treatment and is in financial difficulty, so the Hurun wealth figure is likely out of date. Liu Nianxin (born 1956) is the chairman and the more relevant contact. Chen Yuanfen keeps a very low profile.

name: Liu Shiqiang
profile: A Liu Shiqiang appears among Yonyou Network's top-ten shareholders as a domestic individual: 68m shares (1.98%) in an April 2022 disclosure, falling to about 32m shares (0.94%) by Sept 2026. No biography, executive role or other public profile was found, so who he is beyond being a shareholder is unconfirmed.
interesting_fact: He has been one of Yonyou's largest individual shareholders, holding about 2% of the enterprise-software company in 2022.
current_role: Individual shareholder of Yonyou Network Technology (SSE: 600588); no executive role found
research_notes: Appears to be a private (possibly financial) investor rather than a founder or executive. Holding trend from https://quote.cfi.cn/gdtj/1296/600588.html. Not a named Yonyou executive; there is no outreach route other than the company IR. Name is also shared with an unrelated Jiangxi Agricultural University professor.

name: Lu Xiuqiang
profile: Born June 1956, glass engineer who worked at Jiangsu Glass Factory 1977-92, set up Xinxing Investment in 1998 and founded Xiuqiang in 2001. Xiuqiang makes coated/decorative glass for home appliances (Haier, Midea, Siemens, etc.), kitchen appliances, electronics and BIPV solar, and listed on ChiNext in Jan 2011. In 2021 his holding companies sold 25% to Zhuhai Port, making Zhuhai SASAC the controller.
interesting_fact: Xiuqiang's appliance glass is supplied to brands including Haier, Hisense, Midea, Fotile, Xiaomi, Panasonic, Whirlpool, BSH (Siemens) and GE, and it has moved into building-integrated PV glass.
deep_cut_fact: A hands-on inventor: at IPO he was named inventor or lead inventor on 24 Chinese patent filings in glass deep-processing, sat on the national industrial and special glass standardisation committee, and twice won Suqian's science and technology progress award.
current_role: Founder and former chairman/GM, Jiangsu Xiuqiang Glasswork (秀强股份, 300160.SZ), Suqian; control sold to Zhuhai Port (state-owned) in April 2021
research_notes: No recent public activity found after the 2021 control sale (http://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2021-04-28/1209835608.PDF); alive status not confirmed. Company IR (zqb@jsxq.com) now belongs to a state-controlled firm, not his channel.

name: Lui Wing Chi
profile: Lu (Lui) Wing Chi, Jesse, chairs S E A Group, one of Hong Kong's longest-established property developers (founded 1956), which he joined in 1969. The group has developed 200+ projects across Hong Kong, mainland China, the UK, Australia and New Zealand and holds London offices such as 33 Old Broad Street and 20 Moorgate. Recent Hong Kong projects include Grand Victoria in West Kowloon and The Cendas office tower in Kowloon East.
interesting_fact: S E A's consortium won the West Kowloon waterfront residential site (now Grand Victoria) at a record HK$17.3bn, and the group sold its Wan Chai tower at 108 Gloucester Road to China Everbright for about HK$10bn.
deep_cut_fact: He joined the family group in 1969, when its experience included godown (warehouse) and factory operations, before it became an international office and residential developer; in 2022 it set a government-tender record with a HK$1.18bn Repulse Bay waterfront site.
current_role: Chairman & Executive Director, S E A Holdings Ltd (HKEX: 0251)
research_notes: Hurun lists him as 吕荣梓; company uses 'Lu Wing Chi'. Day-to-day leadership sits with Chief Executive Lambert Lu. Company general inbox is the published route; low personal media profile.

name: Lyu Shiming
profile: Lyu (Lu) Shiming, born 1965, built Suzhou Sunmun Technology (brand Smcolor), a Kunshan-based maker of nano-colouring materials, colour pastes, functional nano-dispersions, intelligent colour-matching systems and electronic chemicals for paints, textiles, fibres and inks. The company, founded in 2001, listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext in 2016; Yahoo Finance lists him as chairman and CEO, while a June 2026 board election named Lu Yong chairman.
interesting_fact: The listed company carries his name: its Chinese short name, Shiming Technology (世名科技), uses the same characters as Lyu Shiming's given name.
current_role: Founder and major shareholder, Suzhou Sunmun (Shiming) Technology Co., SZSE: 300522 (former chairman & CEO; Lu Yong elected chairman of 6th board, June 2026)
research_notes: Current title uncertain: Yahoo Finance HK lists 'Shi Ming Lu, Chairman & CEO, b.1965', but June 2026 SZSE announcement names Lu Yong chairman (https://szse.io/releases/300522-shiming-technology-co-ltd/1225343951-announcement-of-suzhou-shiming-technology-co-ltd-on). Contact via company board secretary (Wu Peng) per filings.

name: Mao Liping
profile: Mao Liping (b. 1966) co-funded Eyebright Medical in 2010 with founder Xie Jiangbing, putting in RMB9.8m alongside wife Bai Ying; the Beijing firm makes intraocular lenses and orthokeratology lenses and listed on the STAR Market in 2020. The couple held ~5.85% in 2026 and have been trimming the stake.
interesting_fact: Before backing an ophthalmic-device maker he was a telecoms executive - marketing director and VP at Shenzhen Guoren Communications - after starting out in HR at the Ministry of Electronics' components company.
deep_cut_fact: He holds a law (economic law) bachelor's from Renmin University of China and an MBA from Peking University's Guanghua School of Management.
current_role: Co-founding shareholder (and director from 2019) of Eyebright Medical (爱博医疗, SSE STAR 688050); chairman of 弘浩明传科技(北京)
research_notes: Investor rather than operator; low profile. Current Eyebright board status after 2025 re-election not verified. IR email from 2019 prospectus. Web search budget ran out during this lane.

name: Mei Zefeng
profile: Listed on Hurun China 2021 with wealth from 'Jiangnan Industrial' (metallurgical, construction and machinery). Searches found no public profile confirming the company's full name or his role.
research_notes: Identity not established: 'Jiangnan Industrial' is a common name and no source links 梅泽峰 to a specific company. Needs a Chinese business-registry lookup before outreach.

name: Mu Jingwei
profile: Mu Jingwei (穆竟伟, female, born 1979) is a qualified accountant with a Tsinghua EMBA. She controls and chairs Shanghai Kaibao Pharmaceutical, a modern traditional-Chinese-medicine maker best known for Tanreqing injection for respiratory infections. The 'Xinyi Pharmaceuticals' in her rich-list entry is Kaibao's Henan subsidiary. She previously served as Kaibao's deputy GM and board secretary.
interesting_fact: Kaibao's flagship Tanreqing injection is a national strategic reserve drug. In 2024 it was written into China's official treatment protocols for measles, dengue and human avian influenza.
deep_cut_fact: She worked her way up inside the company: Kaibao's 2010 interim report lists her as board secretary. She is now chairwoman, a member of the 14th Shanghai CPPCC, and vice-chair of the Respiratory Drug Research Committee of the China Association of Traditional Chinese Medicine.
current_role: Chairwoman, Party Secretary and controlling shareholder, Shanghai Kaibao Pharmaceutical (上海凯宝, SZSE 300039); director of subsidiary Kaibao Xinyi (Xinxiang) Pharmaceutical
research_notes: The IR email is the board-secretary office address published in Kaibao's 2024 annual report (board secretary: Ren Liwang). Company is in Fengxian, Shanghai. Little English-language coverage of her.

name: Ouyang Jianping
profile: Ouyang Jianping (欧阳建平, b. 1973) is a Harbin Institute of Technology computer-science graduate who has run Beijing-based Tansun Technology since 2003; it builds core banking, credit and risk-management software for Chinese banks and listed in Shenzhen in 2020. He directly and indirectly controls about 26% of the company.
interesting_fact: Tansun serves mainly bank clients with AI, blockchain, cloud and big-data fintech, covering IT planning/consulting, fintech software and 'scenario operations' for banks' marketing, risk control and processing.
deep_cut_fact: Before joining Tansun in 2003 he was an engineer at the Second Academy of the aerospace ministry's Institute 706 (1997-98) and then a senior engineer in IBM's Lotus division (1998-99), followed by stints at Borqi Group and Beijing Yichi Meidi.
current_role: Chairman (since 2014) and general manager (since 2003), Tansun Technology / 天阳宏业科技 (SZ300872), Beijing
research_notes: Career details from the company's 2025 annual report (director bios). Hands-on technical founder; IR / board-secretary office is the published route.

name: Sun Xueli
profile: One of the founding technical-management shareholders of Beijing Dahao Technology, whose roots go back to 1986 and which makes industrial CNC electronic control systems for sewing and knitting machines; it listed in Shanghai in 2015 and is controlled by state-owned Beijing Yiqing Holdings. He remains the joint-fourth-largest holder with ~7.6% as of Sept 2026.
interesting_fact: Dahao's control systems sit inside a large share of China's industrial sewing and knitting machines - an unglamorous but dominant niche of Chinese CNC electronics, run from Beijing's Jiuxianqiao electronics park.
current_role: Major individual shareholder (~7.6%) of Beijing Dahao Technology (大豪科技, SSE: 603025); current executive title not confirmed
research_notes: Shareholding confirmed from Eastmoney top-10 holders (Q3 2026); personal bio not found (search budget exhausted). Very low profile.

name: Tan Qing
profile: Hurun China 2021 listed Tan Qing (谭庆) with wealth from 'Dahao', a manufacturing business, possibly Beijing Dahao Technology (大豪科技, sewing and embroidery machine control systems). The link is unconfirmed.
current_role: Listed by Hurun (2021) as founder/owner of 'Dahao' (manufacturing); could not verify the current role
research_notes: Do not confuse with the Chongqing Tongliang Party official of the same name on zh.wikipedia. The link to Dahao Technology is a guess, not confirmed. Web search budget ran out during this lane, so this is minimal; worth a re-run with Chinese-language search (company filings, Qichacha).

name: Wang Xuehai
industry: Pharmaceuticals, real estate, education, travel, investment
profile: Wuhan entrepreneur associated with Wuhan Dangdai Technology Industries Group, a conglomerate in pharmaceuticals, real estate, education and travel whose flagship was Shanghai-listed Humanwell Healthcare, which he chaired. Dangdai lost control of Humanwell in 2025 when China Merchants' life-science arm reorganised its board, ending 32 years of Dangdai control.
interesting_fact: Humanwell, which he chaired, grew into one of China's leading anaesthesia/analgesia drug makers under Dangdai's 32-year control before China Merchants took over in 2025.
current_role: Former chairman/director, Humanwell Healthcare (人福医药); a principal of Wuhan Dangdai Technology Industries Group (current role unconfirmed)
research_notes: Sensitive: Dangdai group has been in financial distress and he was named in regulatory penalties (SSE 2023, Hubei CSRC Dec 2025) over related-party fund occupation at Humanwell; avoid referencing. Humanwell IR (board secretary) is the only corporate route, but he is no longer in control.

name: Wu Yinhe
profile: One of the early shareholder-directors of Xinyi Glass, which was founded in 1988 and is now a Hang Seng Index constituent making float, automotive and low-e architectural glass. Known in Hong Kong filings as NG Ngan Ho (aged 61 in the 2025 annual report), he joined the group in 2003, ran finance and purchasing at the Dongguan complex, and holds his shares through Linkall Investment Ltd.
interesting_fact: Xinyi Glass says it has about 14% of global float-glass capacity, more than 25% of the global automotive replacement-glass market and 25% of the global low-e energy-efficient glass market.
deep_cut_fact: Besides glass, he is an executive director of Xinyi Electric Storage, the group's listed energy-storage and EV-battery-related arm, which is relevant to an energy-focused podcast.
current_role: Non-executive Director, Xinyi Glass Holdings (HKEX: 0868); Executive Director, Xinyi Electric Storage Holdings (HKEX GEM: 8328)
research_notes: Matching 吴银河 to 'NG Ngan Ho' rests on the Cantonese romanisation plus the Xinyi Glass/Hurun 2021 link; the Chinese name was not machine-readable in the annual report PDF. Low profile; route via Xinyi IR.

name: Yan Binsheng
profile: Yan Binsheng (b. 1975) built Ganyuan Foods, a Jiangxi-based snack maker known for green peas, sunflower kernels, broad beans and mixed nuts. After working at several Guangdong snack companies he joined Pingxiang Ganyuan as marketing director in 2006, became chairman in 2012 and chairman/GM in 2015; the company listed in Shenzhen in 2020. He holds about 56% of the shares.
interesting_fact: Ganyuan's core products are humble pantry snacks - green peas, sunflower seed kernels, broad beans and mixed nuts - sold nationally from a factory park in Pingxiang, Jiangxi.
deep_cut_fact: He came up through sales: before Ganyuan he worked at Guangdong Qibao Yiding Food and other Foshan/Shunde snack firms, and joined Pingxiang Ganyuan in 2006 as marketing director before rising to chairman in 2012.
current_role: Chairman, General Manager and controlling shareholder (~56%), Ganyuan Foods Co., Ltd. (甘源食品, SZSE 002991), Pingxiang, Jiangxi
research_notes: Board secretary is Zhang Ting (per 10jqka); IR email should be in the company's annual report on cninfo.com.cn (not verified here). Site lists only a sales/franchise mailbox. Snack-food founder - tangential to energy/data-centre themes.

name: Yan Hua
profile: Yan Hua (严华, b. 1977) controls and runs Farben Information Technology, a Shenzhen software outsourcing and digital-transformation services firm founded in 2006 that listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext in December 2020. He also chairs the affiliated Shenzhen Farben Electronics and Shanghai Farben Electronic Technology.
interesting_fact: Farben provides software R&D, testing and digital-transformation engineering services, largely as an outsourced development partner to large tech and financial clients; Yan holds about 105.5 million shares (28.13%).
deep_cut_fact: Before building Farben, Yan started out in sales - he was sales director at Shenzhen Kairong Industrial (深圳市凯荣实业) - and later completed a doctorate while running the company.
current_role: Chairman and General Manager, Shenzhen Farben Information Technology (法本信息, SZSE: 300925); controlling shareholder (~28%)
research_notes: Low media profile. Board secretary is Wu Chao (吴超); IR channel via SZSE filings/Hudongyi is the formal route. No published email found on the company site.

name: Yang Huanming
profile: Yang Huanming (杨焕明, b. 1952, near Wenzhou) is a geneticist who co-founded the Beijing Genomics Institute (BGI) in 1999 and led China's part of the international Human Genome Project. BGI later moved to Shenzhen and became a commercial genomics group whose listed arm, BGI Genomics, is the basis of his wealth. He is a member of the CAS, the Leopoldina and the US National Academy of Sciences.
interesting_fact: His BGI team's draft sequence of the indica rice genome was the cover story of Science on 5 April 2002, an early sign that China had become a genome-sequencing power.
deep_cut_fact: In 2011 he was the only Chinese appointee to the international research panel of President Obama's Presidential Commission for the Study of Bioethical Issues, which examined the 1940s Guatemala syphilis experiments. He earned his PhD at the University of Copenhagen's Institute of Medical Genetics.
current_role: Co-founder and Chairman, BGI Group (Shenzhen); academician, Chinese Academy of Sciences
public_contact: office_email: info@bgi.com (BGI Group general enquiries) | official_website: https://www.bgi.com
research_notes: Scientist-founder who often speaks at conferences (e.g. ICG). A conference keynote may be an easier route than cold email. He is a well-known advocate of open genomic data, a strong podcast angle.

name: Yang Jiuhong
profile: Yang Jiuhong (b. 1950), from Changzhou, Jiangsu, owned about 58.8% of Aohong Electronics, a printed-circuit-board maker, before its 2020 Shanghai IPO. She controls it jointly with her son-in-law Chen Dinghong, the chairman and general manager. She is not a board member; she is listed as administrative director of the Haihong Electronics subsidiary.
interesting_fact: Aohong is a family-run PCB maker: the 2020 prospectus shows founder Yang Jiuhong and Chairman Chen Dinghong jointly controlling about 93% of shares before the IPO. Under a 2019 supplementary agreement, Chen's decision prevails if the two disagree.
current_role: Controlling shareholder and co-actual controller, Changzhou Aohong Electronics (SSE: 605058); administrative director of subsidiary Haihong Electronics (per 2020 prospectus)
research_notes: Very private, older controlling shareholder with no media presence. Chairman Chen Dinghong is the public face and the more realistic interview target. Contacts are company-level, from the 2020 prospectus.

name: Yao Zhongliang
profile: Yao Zhongliang (姚忠良), born 1962 in Pingyu, Henan, left the army in 1983 for local grain bureaus and in 1996 became general manager of the Baixiang instant-noodle factory, turning it into one of China's leading domestic noodle brands. He still runs the company as chairman and president and is an NPC deputy and vice chair of the Henan Federation of Industry and Commerce.
interesting_fact: About one-third of Baixiang's employees are people with disabilities; when this was reported during the 2022 Beijing Winter Paralympics, consumers bought its noodles en masse in support and the brand went viral.
deep_cut_fact: Before noodles, Yao was a soldier who, after leaving the military in 1983, worked his way up through a county and then a regional grain bureau; he was named a National Model Worker in 2010 and carried the torch for the 2023 Chengdu Universiade.
current_role: Party Secretary, Chairman and President, Baixiang Food Co., Ltd. (白象食品), Henan; deputy to the 14th National People's Congress
research_notes: Low personal media profile despite brand fame; company refers to disabled staff as 'self-improvement staff'. Route via Baixiang corporate office (Zhengzhou).

name: Yu Guoxu
profile: Born 1958; a Zhejiang builder-turned-energy entrepreneur who controls Hengsheng Energy, a combined heat-and-power (cogeneration) utility supplying steam, hot water and electricity to industrial parks in Longyou, plus waste-to-energy via subsidiary Hengxin Power. Hengsheng listed in Shanghai in 2021; it has since diversified into CVD lab-grown diamond through subsidiary Zhejiang Huamao Technology.
interesting_fact: His cogeneration company has moved into CVD-grown synthetic diamond (single- and poly-crystal) via Huamao Technology, and in H1 2026 sold 150,000 tonnes of carbon allowances on China's national emissions-trading market.
deep_cut_fact: He came up through construction, not power: project manager at Lanxi City Construction (1988-97), GM of Lanxi Longma Building Materials, then chairman of Zhejiang Qinglongshan Building Materials, before running technical upgrades ('技改办主任') at Hengxin Power and Hengsheng from 2008.
current_role: Chairman and controlling shareholder, Hengsheng Energy (恒盛能源, SSE 605580), Longyou, Zhejiang; chairman of Zhejiang Xurong New Materials
public_contact: ir_email: hsny@hs-energy.com.cn (Hengsheng Energy board secretary Jin Hai)
research_notes: Very low profile, regional; no personal channels. Route via board secretary. Company is family-controlled (do not reference family members).

name: Yu Xindong
profile: Yu Xindong is founder and chairman of TKD Science and Technology, a Hubei-based maker of quartz crystal resonators and oscillators (frequency-control components) used in phones, IoT, automotive and communications gear. He ran the predecessor Shenzhen Taijing Industrial from 2004, has chaired TKD since 2005 and took it public in Shanghai in 2016. He is also a council member of the China Electronic Components Association's piezoelectric crystal branch.
interesting_fact: TKD is one of China's leading domestic suppliers of tuning-fork and SMD quartz crystals, a component category long dominated by Japanese makers. Its industrial park is in Suizhou, Hubei.
deep_cut_fact: He was one of the main drafters of China's national electronics industry standard for tuning-fork quartz crystal units (SJ/T10015-2013, 10kHz-200kHz test methods). He also earned a PhD in management science and engineering from Wuhan University of Technology in 2017, three decades after graduating from its mechanical department in 1988.
current_role: Chairman, TKD Science and Technology Co. (泰晶科技, 603738.SH), Suizhou, Hubei
research_notes: Hurun's 'Tkd' is TKD Science and Technology (泰晶科技). He also holds a Tsinghua MBA (2007). Securities representative: Zhu Liuyan. The company board-office email is the best route.

name: Zhang Banghui
profile: Born 1963, a former fisheries research assistant who became deputy GM at a Wuxi animal-nutrition company and then general manager of Yuyao Tianbang. He built Tianbang (Tech-Bank) from aquafeed into one of China's larger hog producers and pork processors. After heavy debt in the pork-cycle downturn, the company went through a court-led debt restructuring in 2024.
interesting_fact: In a 2024 interview he predicted the end of China's famous 'pig cycle' as small farmers exit: 'From now on there will be no pig cycle; whoever is cost-competitive will survive.'
deep_cut_fact: Before going into business he was a research assistant at the Freshwater Fisheries Research Center of the Chinese Academy of Fishery Sciences in Wuxi; Tianbang's roots are in aquaculture feed.
current_role: Founder, controlling shareholder and Chairman, Tianbang Food (天邦食品, SZ: 002124); president role reportedly ended April 2026
research_notes: Hurun 'Tech-bank' = Tianbang (天邦). Company had debt restructuring in 2024 (ST status), so wealth likely much reduced; approach sensitively. Contact via company IR/board secretary listed in SZSE filings.

name: Zhang Bei
profile: Shenzhen small-appliance entrepreneur who has run Jinghui Electric (晶辉电器), an appliance manufacturer, since 1992. Together with George Mohan Zhang (Buydeem's chairman/GM) he controls about 52.5% of Shenzhen Crastal Technology, which owns the Buydeem (北鼎) premium kitchen-appliance brand known for kettles and health pots and listed in Shenzhen in 2020.
interesting_fact: Crastal started as an OEM appliance maker and built its own consumer brand, Buydeem, now a recognisable premium kettle and kitchenware label in China.
current_role: Chairman and General Manager, Jinghui Electric (Shenzhen) Co. (since June 1992); co-actual controller and ~24.5% shareholder of Shenzhen Crastal Technology / Buydeem (300824.SZ)
research_notes: Low public profile; the public face of the company is George Mohan Zhang. Best route is Buydeem's board-secretary IR email. Role details from Buydeem 2025 annual report (section on actual controllers).

name: George Mohan Zhang
profile: George Mohan Zhang (张默涵, b. 1982, Canadian national) has run Shenzhen Crastal Technology as chairman and GM since 2003. The company began as an OEM/ODM maker of small kitchen appliances and built its own premium brand, BUYDEEM, selling health kettles, steam ovens, water dispensers and toasters. He and Zhang Bei are the actual controllers; it listed in Shenzhen in 2020.
interesting_fact: He took the helm of the company in 2003 at about 21, and turned a contract manufacturer into a design-led consumer brand (BUYDEEM) sold in China and overseas.
deep_cut_fact: He studied mathematics and computing science (BSc) at Simon Fraser University in Vancouver and earned a master's in industrial engineering at UC Berkeley, as did his deputy GM Fang Zhen.
current_role: Chairman and General Manager, Shenzhen Crastal Technology Co. (Buydeem, 北鼎股份, SZSE: 300824)
research_notes: English-speaking, North America-educated founder of a consumer brand, so a possible fit for an entrepreneurship episode. Route via the company's board office (buydeem@crastal.com).

name: Zhang Chongyu
profile: Zhang Chongyu (张翀宇, b. 1954) has led Jinyu Bio-Technology, a Hohhot-based maker of veterinary biological products, since 1993, as chairman and president until 2019 and chairman since. Hurun lists the fortune jointly with Zhang Jing, the company's vice-chairman and president.
interesting_fact: He has chaired the same company for more than 30 years (since March 1993) and has received the national May Day Labour Medal and National Model Worker honours.
deep_cut_fact: Before vaccines he spent 1976-1993 at Hohhot Metal Materials Company, rising from business-section chief to general manager; he holds a postgraduate degree and is a senior economist.
current_role: Chairman and Party Secretary, Jinyu Bio-Technology Co. (生物股份, 600201.SH), Hohhot, Inner Mongolia
research_notes: Company 2024 annual report confirms him as chairman/party secretary since 2019 (chairman since 1993). Company describes its business as R&D, production and sale of veterinary biologics.

name: Zhang Chongshun
profile: Zhang Chongshun (b. 1969, Wenzhou) built a fortune supplying hardware and motorcycle parts in Haikou before founding Xinri electric bicycles in 1999, positioning it as a premium brand. Xinri listed in Shanghai in April 2017 as the first listed e-bike maker in China; he and his wife Chen Yuying control it.
interesting_fact: Xinri was an official vehicle supplier for the 2008 Beijing Olympics, the year its output passed 2 million e-bikes, and in 2017 it became the e-bike industry's first A-share listing.
deep_cut_fact: After failing the high-school entrance exam in 1985 he apprenticed in his father's hardware trade; in 1989, aged 20, he went to Haikou and supplied motorcycle parts to Sundiro, and even learned southern-style kung fu and staff fighting there. Motto: '实业实业，就是要实实在在、兢兢业业'.
current_role: Founder and Chairman, Jiangsu Xinri E-Vehicle Co. (新日股份, SSE: 603787)
research_notes: Key early tech came from a CAS Institute of Physics affiliate (motor/battery tech) in 1998 per the same profile. EV/battery angle fits an energy podcast.

name: Chen Yuying
profile: Chen Yuying is a board director and individual shareholder of Wuxi-based Xinri E-Vehicle, the electric-bicycle maker founded by her husband, chairman Zhang Chongshun; together with his vehicle Anji Zhunlai they act in concert as controlling shareholders. Xinri listed in Shanghai in April 2017, the first electric two-wheeler maker on China's A-share market.
interesting_fact: Xinri was the first electric-bicycle company to list on China's A-share market (2017); its market value at one point passed RMB 6bn.
current_role: Director and major shareholder, Jiangsu Xinri E-Vehicle Co. (SSE: 603787)
research_notes: Still a Xinri director per April 2026 board announcements. Low personal profile; company founder/public face is chairman Zhang Chongshun. Best route is the board office email.

name: Zhang Gengsheng
profile: Listed on the Hurun China list (2021) with Lin Lan for a SaaS company named 'Chase Science'. Searches did not identify the company's Chinese name or confirm this person's role.
research_notes: Could not identify; Chinese company name for 'Chase Science' needed (check Hurun 2021 list original). Unrelated namesake: a Hebei Normal University math professor.

name: Lin Lan
profile: Born 1973, a long-time Chase Science executive who rose through its systems-integration, network-security and financial-products divisions, served as board secretary and deputy GM, then became general manager and, in May 2025, chairman of the Fuzhou-based fintech/payments software firm. She is a co-actual controller with Zhang Gengsheng.
interesting_fact: Her career inside the company spanned marketing manager in systems integration, deputy GM of the network-security unit, and head of the financial-products division before she took the top job.
deep_cut_fact: She holds a master's degree from Nanjing University of Science and Technology and an EMBA from CEIBS (China Europe International Business School).
current_role: Chairman (since May 2025), general manager and legal representative of Fujian Chase Science (创识科技, 300941.SZ)
research_notes: Wealth shared with Zhang Gengsheng (co-controller), who stepped down as chairman in May 2025 and is subject to an investigation and court case, so avoid that topic. The IR mailbox is the securities office; the board secretary is Peng Hongyi.

name: Zhang Kaiyi
profile: Long-time Sangfor executive and significant shareholder (about 2.58% per Q1 2020 report) of the Shenzhen cybersecurity and cloud-infrastructure company founded in 2000 by He Zhaoxi (River He) and Xiong Wu. As a VP he was a public spokesman for Sangfor's 2017 push into hyperconverged infrastructure and cloud.
interesting_fact: In a 2017 interview he said Sangfor put 50% of its 2016 R&D budget into hyperconverged infrastructure and cloud products - a big bet for a company then known for security gear.
current_role: Early executive and shareholder of Sangfor Technologies (深信服, 300454.SZ); Vice President as of 2017 (current title not confirmed)
research_notes: Not named among Sangfor's actual controllers (He Zhaoxi, Xiong Wu, Feng Yi). Shareholding from 2020 Q1 report (https://disc.static.szse.cn/download/disc/disk02/finalpage/2020-04-25/3ee4f90b-4557-4fc9-ac14-d5bd08a1edc4.PDF). Data-center/cloud angle relevant to podcast.

name: Zhao Jian
profile: Founding-era shareholder of Guangzhou food company Ligao Foods (立高食品), whose predecessor was founded in 2000 and run by Peng Yuhui, Zhao Songtao and Peng Yongcheng. After the April 2021 listing he held 10.14% as third-largest shareholder; from 2022 he sold down for about RMB 1.185bn, holding 1.14% by May 2023 and planning a near-complete exit.
interesting_fact: Although a shareholder since the company's founding, he never took part in running it; he invested on the strength of Peng Yongcheng's team's cream R&D and production expertise.
current_role: Former major (passive) shareholder of Ligao Foods (立高食品); not involved in management
research_notes: Per the company (via TMTPost, 2023) he has settled overseas with no plan to return and is liquidating his domestic holdings. Very private; no public contacts. Weak podcast fit.

name: Zhao Shanqi
profile: Power-semiconductor engineer (PhD) who founded Macmic in Changzhou in August 2006 and remains its chairman, GM and largest individual shareholder (~14-18%). Macmic designs and makes IGBT and FRED power chips and modules for EVs, wind/solar/storage and industrial drives, and is now expanding into AI data-center power (GaN chips, UPS and server power).
interesting_fact: In Sept 2026 he said Macmic's GaN 650V 30mΩ chip had passed certification with AI data-center power-supply customers and it is working with a leading North American power-equipment company on UPS, server-power and solid-state-transformer (SST) products.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding Macmic he was deputy chief engineer at the Beijing Power Electronics Center (to 1994), then a postdoc (1994-95) and visiting associate professor (1995-96) at INSA de Lyon in France.
current_role: Chairman and General Manager, Jiangsu Macmic Science & Technology Co. (SSE STAR: 688711), Changzhou
research_notes: Strong fit for energy/data-center angle (power semiconductors for AIDC). Jilin University graduate per profiles. No published IR email captured; Macmic's securities office is reachable via SSE e-interaction (sns.sseinfo.com) and the company website. Chinese name 赵善麒.

name: Zhao Songtao
profile: Zhao Songtao (赵松涛) is one of three related co-controllers of Ligao Foods, a Guangzhou maker of frozen baked goods and baking ingredients (creams, fats, fruit fillings, sauces) founded in 2000 and listed on ChiNext in 2021. With Peng Yuhui and Peng Yongcheng he held about 46.6% around listing; the three renewed their concert-party agreement in April 2026.
interesting_fact: Ligao supplies frozen baked goods and baking creams to bakeries, supermarkets, restaurants and new-retail channels, a B2B 'behind the bakery' business.
current_role: Vice Chairman and co-actual controller, Ligao Foods Co., Ltd. (立高食品, SZSE 300973)
research_notes: Controller status per Jiemian (https://m.jiemian.com/article/6011270.html). Search-tool summary of 2026 filings says he is vice chairman; not read directly. Low public profile; route via board secretary (Wang Shijia, per stockanalysis).

name: Zhao Yulling
profile: Zhao Yuling (赵玉岭) is one of the individual co-owners of Beijing Dahao Technology, a Shanghai-listed maker of control systems for sewing and embroidery machinery, majority-owned by state-owned Beijing Yiqing Holdings. As of 30 Sept 2026 he held about 73.5 million shares (6.58%).
current_role: Major individual shareholder (6.58%), Beijing Dahao Technology Corp. (大豪科技, SH:603025)
research_notes: Lane spelling 'Yulling' should be Yuling. Not chairman (Hu Xiongguang elected chairman July 2026). Shareholding source: https://quote.cfi.cn/gdtj/19782/603025.html. Very low public profile.

name: Zhong Xuanxuan
profile: Zhong Xuanxuan (钟䁢䁢) is an elder sister of Nongfu Spring founder Zhong Shanshan. Nongfu Spring's 2020 Hong Kong IPO prospectus lists her as a shareholder and associate of Zhong Shanshan. She bought shares with personal funds in 2007-2008 and became a public shareholder when the company listed in September 2020.
interesting_fact: She was one of 27 individuals who became Nongfu Spring shareholders in 2007-2008, more than a decade before the bottled-water company's 2020 IPO made her brother China's richest man.
current_role: Individual shareholder of Nongfu Spring (9633.HK); no operating role found
research_notes: Private individual whose wealth comes from a passive shareholding; no public profile or contacts found. Any approach would have to go through Nongfu Spring's corporate channels, and she is unlikely to be a suitable guest.

name: Guo Jingsong
profile: Born 1962, an engineer by training, Guo Jingsong (郭景松) founded Zhongshan Debao Packaging Machinery in 1997, which became Sotech, a maker of gravure printing machines and later intelligent automated manufacturing equipment; he chaired it from 2000 (listed company from 2007). Foshan Public Utilities Holding took a stake in 2019 and the company was later renamed Funeng Oriental.
interesting_fact: He won a first-class Guangdong Provincial Science and Technology award and in March 2017 was named a 'Zhongshan Science and Technology Innovation Leader'; he was also vice-chairman of the gravure printing branch of the China Printing Technology Association.
deep_cut_fact: He began his career (1983-1992) as an engineer at the Ministry of Geology and Mineral Resources' Hengyang Exploration Machinery Plant, then was deputy director of Shunde Debao Packaging Machinery Factory before founding his own company in 1997.
current_role: Founder and former chairman of Sotech Smarter Equipment (松德智慧装备, SZSE 300173, now Funeng Oriental Equipment Technology); current role not found
research_notes: Bio from Sotech's 2018 annual report. The listed company (now Funeng Oriental, sec@fnorient.com) is controlled by Foshan Public Utilities; he appears in its 2025 report only as a party to earlier performance commitments, so company channels may not reach him.

name: Zhang Xiaoling
profile: Listed by Hurun China (2015-2017) with wealth from 'Sotech Smarter' (manufacturing), shared with Guo Jingsong. No source linking 张晓玲 or Guo Jingsong to a company of that name was found; the name is very common.
research_notes: Identity unresolved; the company's Chinese name could not be identified. No contact found.

name: Liu Guoyao
profile: Liu Guoyao (b. 1962), a former Southeast University power-engineering lecturer, co-founded Nanjing Sciyon (科远), an industrial automation and smart-plant technology company listed in Shenzhen in 2010, where he is chairman and a co-controlling shareholder (~61m shares). He was re-elected chairman in Sept 2025.
interesting_fact: He started as a teacher in Southeast University's power engineering department (thermal control) and head of the instrument lab at its vibration engineering institute; he later won a Jiangsu Science and Technology first prize (2017).
deep_cut_fact: He holds a master's in engineering from Southeast University and a Tsinghua SEM EMBA, is an honorary trustee of Southeast University and an off-campus PhD supervisor there, and in 2020 was named a 'caring ambassador' for Jiangning district's youth dream fund.
current_role: Chairman, Nanjing Sciyon Wisdom Technology Group (科远智慧, SZ:002380)
research_notes: Hurun 'Keyuan' = 科远 (Sciyon), Nanjing; identified via Lixinger controlling-holder listing and Sina Finance bio. Relevant to energy angle (thermal control/power-plant automation background). Board secretary: Zhao Wenqing (per Sina). Company site sciyon.com could not be fetched.

name: Shi Xugang
profile: Shi Xugang (石旭刚) was controlling shareholder, actual controller and chairman of Hangzhou Zhongwei Electronics (OB Telecom Electronics), a Hangzhou video-surveillance/communications company. He stepped down as general manager in 2021 but remained chairman; later he sold down shares and, around late 2025, waived voting rights on his 7.90% stake as control passed to Fu Yingbo.
interesting_fact: After a change of control, he committed to waive voting rights on his 7.90% stake and not seek control of the company he had controlled.
current_role: Shareholder (former controlling shareholder and chairman), Hangzhou Zhongwei Electronics (中威电子, 300270.SZ); current board role not confirmed
research_notes: No personal bio found. Chairman-in-2021 per https://www.nbd.com.cn/articles/2021-08-27/1893140.html. Low profile; route via company board secretary.

name: Chen Hankang
profile: Chen Hankang (陈汉康, b. 1961), from Chun'an county, Zhejiang, was the actual controller of Kangsheng, a Chun'an-based maker of refrigeration tubing and parts for appliances that later moved into new-energy commercial vehicles and liquid-cooling products. He held ~7.5% directly in 2022 alongside his vehicle Zhejiang Runcheng Holding; control of Kangsheng has since passed to other holders.
interesting_fact: Kangsheng, registered in Chun'an's Pingshan industrial park near Qiandao Lake, became a supplier of refrigerant pipelines for fridges and air-conditioners before diversifying into EV commercial vehicles.
current_role: Former actual controller of Zhejiang Kangsheng Co. (康盛股份, 002418.SZ); no current listed executive role found
research_notes: Current controlling shareholders of Kangsheng are other entities (Changzhou Xingruo etc.); 2019-21 filings show pledged-share litigation and court-ordered share disposals (https://disc.static.szse.cn/disc/disk02/finalpage/2019-09-18/391054ec-c700-424c-881b-c07aa748f2d1.PDF). Hurun wealth (2015-17) shared with Zhou Zhen is stale; poor outreach target.

name: Zhou Zhen
profile: Listed on Hurun 2015-2017 alongside Chen Hankang for wealth from Kangsheng, the Zhejiang maker of tubular products (refrigeration pipes) listed in Shenzhen. A 2022 SZSE disclosure shows her owning 30% of, and serving as manager of, an entity in which Chen Hankang holds 70%. No other public biography was found.
current_role: Shareholder (30%) and manager of a holding vehicle co-owned with Chen Hankang, the actual controller of Zhejiang Kangsheng (康盛股份, 002418.SZ)
research_notes: Very low profile. The source is SZSE filing https://disc.static.szse.cn/disc/disk03/finalpage/2022-09-22/ace8775b-1608-4541-8900-d6550e8a6a0c.PDF. Her relationship to Chen Hankang is not stated in the sources read. The Hurun-era wealth is likely stale.

name: Pan Jiangen
profile: Pan Jiangen (born 1965), a professor-level senior engineer trained in optoelectronic measurement at Zhejiang University, founded Hangzhou Everfine Instruments in 1994 and Everfine Photo-E-Info in 2003, which makes optical/photoelectric test and measurement instruments. He directly and indirectly controls about 48.65% of the listed company and was reappointed GM in Sept 2025.
interesting_fact: He is both chairman and 'chief scientist' of the company he founded, and directly and indirectly controls 48.65% of it (Sept 2025 filing).
deep_cut_fact: Before becoming an entrepreneur he stayed on at Zhejiang University in 1989 to do research and teaching after graduating in optoelectronic measurement technology and instrument engineering, then founded Hangzhou Everfine Instruments in 1994.
current_role: Chairman, General Manager and Chief Scientist, Hangzhou Everfine Photo-E-Info Co. (远方信息, formerly 远方光电; SZSE: 300306)
research_notes: board@everfine.cn is the board office/securities representative contact published in the company's Sept 2025 announcement. Co-listed wealth with Meng Xin (shareholder).

name: Meng Xin
profile: 孟欣 (b. 1966) and her husband Pan Jiangen controlled about 81.5% of Everfine, a Hangzhou maker of photometric/optical testing instruments, at its 2012 ChiNext IPO; Pan remains chairman, GM and chief scientist. She co-founded the predecessor Hangzhou Yuanfang Instruments in 1994 and was GM of Mimi Electronics from 2010.
interesting_fact: She trained as a doctor: from 1989 to 1995 she was a physician/attending physician at the Children's Hospital of Zhejiang Medical University, then an attending physician at Zhejiang University's hospital (1995-2002), before joining Everfine in 2003.
deep_cut_fact: In Oct 1994 she was one of four founders of Hangzhou Yuanfang Instruments (registered capital RMB 500,000), putting in RMB 50,000 cash for a 10% stake; that firm became the root of Everfine.
current_role: Co-actual controller (with husband Pan Jiangen) of Hangzhou Everfine Photo-E-Info Co. (300306.SZ, now short name 远方信息); current executive title not confirmed
research_notes: Low public profile; facts are from the 2012 IPO prospectus. Pan Jiangen chairs board meetings per 2024-2026 announcements. Route would be via Everfine company secretary.

name: Cheng Shangnan
profile: Cheng Shangnan is the long-time leader and a major shareholder (8.85% at end-2022) of Changzhou NRB, one of China's main automotive bearing suppliers, founded in 1987 as Changzhou Needle Bearing Factory. NRB makes needle roller, clutch release and wheel bearings plus circuit boards, supplying VW, BYD, Daimler, NIO, XPeng, Li Auto, ZF and others.
interesting_fact: In July 2017, as NRB chairman, he signed a strategic needle-roller-bearing cooperation framework with the president of Svenska Kullagerfabriken (SKF) at its Gothenburg headquarters, aimed at supplying SKF's global clients.
current_role: Major shareholder (and former chairman), Changzhou NRB Corp. (Changzhou Guangyang Bearing)
research_notes: Current title unclear: search snippets of MarkLines suggest he is now honorary chairman (~6.4% at end-2024) but I could not confirm on the page opened. Company profile: https://www.marklines.com/en/top500/changzhou-nrb

name: Zhang Xiangwen
profile: Zhang Xiangwen (张湘文) and her husband Cheng Shangnan were the actual controllers of Changzhou NRB Corp (光洋股份), a needle/roller and clutch-release bearing maker for car and truck transmissions, founded 1994 and listed in Shenzhen in Jan 2014. Control later passed to Huangshan city's state-asset commission; Cheng still holds about 5%.
interesting_fact: NRB's test centre is one of 11 bearing-industry labs in China with ISO/IEC 17025 national accreditation, and NRB was first drafter of national standards for automotive transmission bearings.
current_role: Former co-controlling shareholder (with husband Cheng Shangnan) of Changzhou NRB Corporation (002708.SZ); no current executive role found
research_notes: Identity is from the 2013 IPO sponsor letter (disc.static.szse.cn/.../7afdbeab-36cf-495f-8fc5-89485fe03750.PDF), which names Cheng Shangnan and Zhang Xiangwen as the husband-and-wife controllers. The company is now state-controlled, so its IR (bearing@nrb.com.cn) is not a route to her. Very private.

name: Zhou Xuhui
profile: Zhou Xuhui is the founder and largest shareholder (about 28% per registration data) of Chengdu-based Geeya Technology, a digital-TV head-end and set-top-box software/hardware maker founded in 1999 and listed on ChiNext in October 2009. In 2016-17 he personally bought Geeya Technology (Hong Kong) from the listed company for CNY 96.3m.
interesting_fact: Geeya listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext growth board in October 2009 (stock code 300028), selling digital-TV front- and back-end systems.
current_role: Founder/major shareholder of Geeya Technology (金亚科技, SZSE: 300028); current title unverified
research_notes: Geeya's 2019 annual report flagged delisting risk after three straight years of losses (2016-18). Company has had regulatory troubles; current status of Zhou and the company not verified. Not a good podcast target without further checks.

name: Tao Linggang
profile: One of the sibling actual controllers of Lionco Pharmaceutical (Hurun 'Lionco'); his sister Tao Lingping chairs the company. In July 2023 he planned to sell his remaining ~0.99% direct stake.
current_role: Shareholder / one of the actual controllers of Lionco Pharmaceutical (灵康药业, SSE 603669); not chairman
research_notes: Few positive public facts found; low profile. Source: https://finance.sina.cn/2023-07-24/detail-imzctxcy2356518.d.html

name: Shi Zhengmin
profile: Shi Zhengmin (石政民, b. 1946) founded Hangzhou Innover Technology, a smart gas-meter and 'smart gas' solutions maker set up in 1991 and listed in Shenzhen in June 2015. He held ~65% at incorporation and still holds ~42%, acting in concert with chairman Shi Yimin. Innover serves 1,200+ gas utilities and 50m+ online meters.
interesting_fact: Innover was one of the first companies certified as a high-tech enterprise by Zhejiang's science commission, and now runs a smart-gas big-data centre and a 5-million-unit-per-year smart manufacturing base in Hangzhou.
deep_cut_fact: An engineer by training, he began his career at the China Meteorological Administration before becoming deputy GM of Beijing Haidian Xianfeng (Pioneer) Industry and president of Dongguan Xianfeng, the group that seeded the Hangzhou gas-meter business in 1991.
current_role: Founder and controlling shareholder (~42%, acting in concert with chairman Shi Yimin) of Hangzhou Innover Technology (先锋电子, SZSE: 002767)
research_notes: Age ~80 and not in day-to-day management (chairman is Shi Yimin, GM Shi Yang). Alive status inferred from a Sept 2026 SZSE filing listing him as current shareholder; not otherwise confirmed. Very low public profile; Chinese-language approach via the company.

name: Sun Zhiqiang
profile: Sun Zhiqiang (b. 1959), a senior engineer from Beijing's Fangshan district, chaired Beijing Hengtong Innovation Saimu Technology (恒通创新赛木), a prefab/new building-materials company, from 2010 to 2020. After China Railway took control in 2020 the company became China Railway Assembly Construction; he chaired it until 2022 and remains a director.
interesting_fact: He started in 1978 as a foreman on the Liulihe construction team in Fangshan, Beijing, rising to deputy manager of the branch before moving into decoration and then prefabricated building materials.
deep_cut_fact: He was named a Beijing Model Worker and National Outstanding Project Manager in 2000 and received the National May Day Labor Award in 2002.
current_role: Director, China Railway Assembly Construction (中铁装配式建筑股份有限公司); Chairman, Jiangsu Tong'an Yunchuang Intelligent System Integration (per user-submitted bio)
research_notes: Identity based on Hengtong + construction materials match; sole biographical source is user-submitted maigoo.com page, so verify before outreach. Hurun list years 2015-2017 coincide with Hengtong's chairmanship.

name: Cai Jingxian
profile: Known as 'Duolong' and 'Taobao's first programmer', Cai joined Alibaba in 2000 after a biology master's at Hangzhou University, was one of three engineers who built Taobao in about a month in 2003, and became an Alibaba partner in 2014. He left Alibaba in 2025 after 25 years and joined LCComputing, founded by ex-Alibaba researcher Lin Hao, which builds big-data/AI infrastructure and cost-management tools.
interesting_fact: From 2003 to 2007 he single-handedly developed and maintained Taobao's search engine; a popular saying inside Taobao was 'When in trouble, find Duolong.'
deep_cut_fact: His academic background is not in computing: he earned a master's from Hangzhou University's Department of Biology in 2000 before joining a then little-known Alibaba; colleagues likened his deep-focus coding to a meditation state.
current_role: Technical partner, LCComputing (Hangzhou AI/big-data infrastructure startup), since Aug 2025; former Alibaba partner
research_notes: Famously low-profile; reportedly does not use social networks. Best route likely via LCComputing. AI infrastructure angle fits data-center theme. New-job details: https://technode.com/2025/08/19/taobaos-first-programmer-joins-startup-after-25-years-at-alibaba/

name: Cao Zhengguo
profile: Cao Zhengguo chairs Jiangsu Zhengdan Chemical, a Zhenjiang maker of specialty fine chemicals founded in 2007 and listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext in April 2017. Its main products are trimellitic anhydride (TMA) and the plasticiser trioctyl trimellitate (TOTM). With Shen Xingxiu he is an actual controller, indirectly controlling about 33.5%.
interesting_fact: Zhengdan's core products are trimellitic anhydride (TMA) and trioctyl trimellitate (TOTM), a heat-resistant plasticiser. The company calls itself a maker of 'environmental new materials' and specialty fine chemicals.
current_role: Chairman and legal representative, Jiangsu Zhengdan Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. (300641.SZ), Zhenjiang
research_notes: Controller stake (Cao Zhengguo and Shen Xingxiu, 33.50%) per basic.10jqka.com.cn/300641/holder.html as summarised in search. Relationship with Shen Xingxiu not confirmed. Best route is the board office IR email.

name: Sun Lijun
profile: Sun Lijun (孙利军) joined Alibaba's B2B unit in 2002 straight out of Zhejiang University as a junior clerk selling China Supplier memberships, rose to run East China sales, and in 2014 helped launch Rural Taobao across 27 provinces. He was named an Alibaba partner in Dec 2015 and later led the Alibaba Foundation; Yicai reported he left the partnership in fiscal 2025.

deep_cut_fact: In his first year as an Alibaba B2B salesman (2002) he ranked sixth in sales; by 2006 he was number one, before going on to lead China Supplier Services for East China.
current_role: Former Alibaba Group partner; previously GM of Rural Taobao and president of the Alibaba Foundation (current role unconfirmed)

name: Wu Jiang

current_role: Deceased; former chairman of Zhejiang Zomax Transmission (中马传动, SSE: 603767)
research_notes: Deceased Feb 2023 (source: https://www.jiemian.com/article/10527543.html). Do not contact.

name: Yu Rongqing
profile: Yu Rongqing is a PhD materials scientist (born November 1967). He is the controlling shareholder (34.5% after a 2021 share transfer) and remains chairman.

name: Wang Yinxiang
profile: Oncology scientist (PhD, University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences; Yale postdoc). Co-founded Betta Pharmaceuticals in 2003 with Ding Lieming and Zhang Xiaodong, and as president/CSO led development of icotinib (Conmana), approved in 2011. Left Betta around 2017 to build Jacobio, a Beijing biotech focused on KRAS/SHP2 cancer targets.
interesting_fact: Icotinib, which he led, is described as China's first small-molecule targeted anticancer drug. He and his co-founders became known as the 'Betta Three Musketeers' (贝达三剑客).
deep_cut_fact: While a Yale postdoc, he and Zhang Xiaodong discussed the idea of developing an anticancer drug targeting the EGFR kinase. That conversation became Betta's founding technical route. He first trained at the Graduate School of the Chinese Academy of Preventive Medicine.
current_role: Founder, Chairman and Co-CEO, Jacobio Pharmaceuticals (HKEX: 1167)
public_contact: ir_email: ir@jacobiopharma.com | press_email: media@jacobiopharma.com | official_website: https://www.jacobiopharma.com
research_notes: Hurun lists wealth under Betta, but his current company is Jacobio. He is vice chairman of PHIRDA's New Drug R&D Committee. The Yale/EGFR anecdote and the musketeers nickname come from news reports surfaced in search.

profile: Zhao Jizeng (赵继增), born 1955, is a professor-level senior engineer and former executive vice-president of the Ministry of Metallurgy's Luoyang Institute of Refractories Research. It listed in Shenzhen in 2010.
interesting_fact: He is a scientist-turned-founder: he won a National Spark Program science and technology award and eight ministerial/provincial S&T awards, and was named a national advanced science and technology worker before leaving a state research institute to start his own refractories company.

current_role: Founder and former Chairman, Beijing Lirr High-temperature Materials Co. (SZSE: 002392); his son Zhao Wei has been chairman since July 2024

He brought in US$70m of foreign private equity in 2007 and pursued a planned New York IPO; Yicai put his wealth at RMB 1.7bn in 2011.

interesting_fact: Ysstech's fund accounting/valuation and custody systems hold a claimed >90% share of China's market for those systems, serving 300+ financial institutions.
deep_cut_fact: Began his career in 1993 as a technician at the Changsha Electric Meter Factory, then spent four years as a development engineer at Shenzhen Shenruan Electronic Technology before taking over Ysstech in 2001.
current_role: Chairman, legal representative and co-controlling shareholder, Shenzhen Ysstech Info-tech (赢时胜, SZSE: 300377)
public_contact: ir_email: ysstech@ysstech.com (company disclosure email; board secretary Cheng Xia) | official_website: https://www.ysstech.com

name: Gu Shaoming
profile: Gu Shaoming founded Shenzhen Bauing Construction Group, a building-decoration and fit-out contractor that reverse-merged into listed Chenglin (成霖股份) in 2013. In January 2020 he and his investment vehicle agreed to sell a 22% stake to Zhuhai Airport City Development Group and delegate voting rights; the company is now controlled by Zhuhai state capital (Da Hengqin Group).
interesting_fact: Bauing went public in 2013 by injecting its business into tap-maker Chenglin, issuing 610.9m shares to Gu and the other nine original Bauing shareholders.
current_role: Founder and former controlling shareholder of Shenzhen Bauing Construction (宝鹰股份, SZSE 002047); no current board role found
research_notes: Exited control in 2020-21 to Zhuhai SOE; company has since had ST status. Current activities unknown; no personal public contact. Company site per 10jqka: www.szbygf.com (no longer his).

name: Weng Yaogen
profile: Weng Yaogen (翁耀根, b. 1958), a senior economist from Wuxi, built Huadong Heavy Machinery, a maker of port container cranes and heavy handling equipment, from a local machinery works. He chaired the listed company from Oct 2010 to May 2023 and in April 2025 was appointed its senior adviser; with concert parties he holds about 12% of the company.
interesting_fact: Huadong Heavy Machinery listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2012 and is known for container gantry and quayside cranes used in ports.
deep_cut_fact: His career began running township factories: he was director of the Wuxi Huazhuang Metal Machinery Factory (无锡华庄金属机械厂), then Wuxi Huazhuang Heavy Machinery Factory and Wuxi Huadong Heavy Machinery Factory, before incorporating the business in 2004.
current_role: Senior adviser (2025-2028) and co-controlling shareholder, Wuxi Huadong Heavy Machinery (华东重机, SZSE: 002685); executive director/GM of Wuxi Huadong Heavy Machinery Technology Group
research_notes: Low public profile; appears mainly in exchange filings. Formal route is Huadong Heavy Machinery's board office via SZSE disclosures. No published personal/office contact.

Zhao Hui (b. 1974) is chairman of the controlling shareholder, Jinyuan Holding Group, and has chaired the listed company at times. No public profile or filing role for Zhao Bisheng was found.
