name: Zhao Hui
profile: Zhao Hui (赵辉) and his father Zhao Bisheng built Hangzhou-based Jinyuan, a cement maker that diversified into hazardous-waste treatment and lithium resources and is listed as Jinyuan Environmental. They jointly controlled it through Jinyuan Holding. He stepped down in 2024, and in March 2025 his entire 10.79% direct stake was transferred away, leaving his father as sole actual controller.
interesting_fact: In 2021 Jinyuan began a transition into new-energy materials (lithium) and the next year began divesting the cement and building-materials business that had made the family's fortune.
current_role: Former chairman and general manager of Jinyuan Environmental (金圆股份, SZSE: 000546); resigned all posts in September 2024
research_notes: Not recommended for outreach. Jiemian reports he was placed on 'qubao houshen' (released pending criminal investigation). The CSRC opened a disclosure-violation case in Nov 2024, and the Jilin CSRC bureau separately fined him RMB 1.5m. His shares were transferred in a 2025 divorce settlement (source: jiemian.com/article/12120058.html). The Hurun Unicorn-founder tag may belong to a different Zhao Hui.

name: Yu Jianmo
profile: Yu Jianmo (俞建模) was the long-time chairman and a core shareholder of SZSE-listed 002621, originally Dalian Sanlei (plastic-pipe machinery), which later pivoted into early-childhood education by acquiring the China operator of the US My Gym children's fitness brand and was renamed Meijimu (美吉姆). He stepped down as chairman and director in March 2017 and has since been reducing his stake.
interesting_fact: The company he led reinvented itself from industrial machinery into children's education, taking over the China franchise of the US kids' gym brand My Gym.
current_role: Major shareholder (approx. 11.6% in 2023) of Dalian Meijimu Education Technology (*ST美吉, SZSE: 002621); former chairman, left board March 2017
research_notes: No longer in management; low public profile. Hurun lists wealth shared with Yu Yang. Company is now *ST (risk warning) status. Sanlei-machinery background is from memory of company history, verify in SZSE filings.

name: Yu Yang
profile: Yu Yang is a founding promoter of Dalian Sanlei Machinery, a maker of plastic-pipe extrusion machinery that listed on the Shenzhen exchange in 2011. He co-founded it with Yu Jianmo, with whom Hurun lists the wealth jointly. In 2016-17 the pair sold control to Zhuhai Rongcheng, and the company pivoted into children's early-education franchising as 'My Gym' (美吉姆). He remained a major shareholder (about 3.8%).
interesting_fact: The company he co-founded made one of China's stranger listed-company pivots: from industrial plastic-pipe machinery (Sanlei) to licensing the US kids' gym brand My Gym in China.
deep_cut_fact: He was one of the 15 individual founding promoters when Dalian Sanlei Machinery Co. converted into a joint-stock company in 2008, before its September 2011 IPO at RMB 24 a share.
current_role: Shareholder of Dalian My Gym Education Technology (formerly Dalian Sanlei Machinery, 002621.SZ, now delisted); no current executive role found
research_notes: The listed company (*ST My Gym, 002621) has been delisted, and I found no current company contact. Don't confuse him with Yu Yang, the general manager of Huaxin Co. (600621), who is a different person. Low profile.

name: Li Mingyan
profile: Correct characters are 李明焱 (list shows 李明炎). From a family of traditional medicine practitioners in Wuyi, Zhejiang, he built Shouxiangu, a 'China Time-honored Brand', into a listed maker of reishi (lingzhi) mushroom and broken-wall spore powder products. His two sons now serve as vice chairman and general manager.
interesting_fact: He helped drive international standards for traditional Chinese medicine on lingzhi (2018) and on broken-wall Ganoderma spore powder (ISO, 2025).
deep_cut_fact: From 1993 he combed the mountains of Zhejiang, Fujian and Jiangxi, collecting 50+ wild reishi strains. He bred 'Xianzhi No.1' around 2001, then sent seeds aboard China's first crewed spacecraft Shenzhou-5 to breed the improved 'Xianzhi No.2' (2006).
current_role: Chairman, Zhejiang Shouxiangu Pharmaceutical (寿仙谷, SH: 603896)
research_notes: Scientist-entrepreneur profile; open to media about TCM standardisation. Contact via the company's SSE-listed IR/board secretary. Not an energy/data-center fit.

name: Lu Yuanjian
profile: Born 1950, a chemical engineer-manager from Nanping, Fujian, who led and chaired Yuanli Active Carbon, which grew from a ~500-tonne plant (1999) into China's largest wood-based activated-carbon maker. He left formal posts in 2018 but remains controlling shareholder and is subscribing shares in Yuanli's acquisition of silica maker Tongsheng.
interesting_fact: Yuanli's wood-based activated carbon output grew from about 500 tonnes when the plant was built in 1999 to nearly 100,000 tonnes, making it the largest such producer in China.
deep_cut_fact: Before Yuanli he was director of Nanping No. 2 Chemical Factory and GM/chief engineer of Nanping Jialian Chemical; he later chaired the Evonik Jialian precipitated-silica JV in Nanping and served as president of the Fujian Activated Carbon Industry Association.
current_role: Co-actual controller of Fujian Yuanli Active Carbon (300174.SZ) with Wang Yan'an; no formal company post since Feb 2018
research_notes: Hurun lists co-owner as 'Wang Yanan'; filings give 王延安 (Wang Yan'an), his wife and fellow actual controller. Activated carbon/silica has energy-storage angles (supercapacitor carbon). Private; route via board secretary IR email.

name: Wang Yanan
profile: Wang Yan'an (王延安, b. 1949) co-built Fujian Yuanli Active Carbon in Nanping, Fujian, with her husband Lu Yuanjian; she was general manager of the predecessor company and later a director and deputy GM. Yuanli is one of China's largest wood-based activated carbon producers and has moved into silica and carbon materials for new energy uses. She has since stepped back from any role.
interesting_fact: Yuanli's activated carbon business has expanded beyond water and food purification into materials for the battery/new-energy supply chain, such as porous carbon used in silicon-carbon anodes.
deep_cut_fact: Before going into industry she was a schoolteacher, teaching in the Wangtai school district and at a vocational school in Nanping, Fujian, before becoming GM of Nanping Yuanli Active Carbon, the company's predecessor.
current_role: Co-actual controller (with husband Lu Yuanjian) of Fujian Yuanli Active Carbon Co. (SZSE: 300174); holds no current post at the company
research_notes: Name in Chinese is 王延安 (Wang Yan'an). Retired from company roles per the 2025 annual report; very low profile. The energy-materials angle may suit the podcast; route via board office dm@yuanlicarbon.com.

name: Shi Xiuyou
profile: Shi Xiuyou (施秀幼), a Hong Kong national, is joint actual controller of Shanghai-listed Taihua New Material together with her younger brother, chairman Shi Qingdao. Taihua, based in Jiaxing, Zhejiang, makes nylon (polyamide 6/66) filament yarn, greige fabric and finished fabrics. She holds her stake through Fuhua Global, of which she is director and legal representative.
interesting_fact: The company's 2025 annual report names her and her brother Shi Qingdao as the group's ultimate controllers ('施秀幼、施清岛姐弟'), a sister-and-brother partnership in nylon textiles.
current_role: Co-actual controller of Zhejiang Taihua New Material Group (603055.SH); director of controlling shareholder Fuhua Global (福華環球有限公司)
research_notes: Non-executive, low profile; brother Shi Qingdao (chairman) is the public face. Route via company board office.

name: Li Yuchi
profile: Early partner in Shanghai-based oilfield-services and upstream group Zhongman Petroleum (ZPEC), which grew from drilling services into an integrated driller, equipment maker and oil producer with overseas assets, listing in Shanghai in 2017. He was one of the joint-stock company's founding promoters with about 8% of shares and is named in 2024 filings as a concert party of the controlling group led by Zhu Fengxue. No current executive role found.
interesting_fact: At ZPEC's conversion into a joint-stock company he was the fifth-largest founding promoter (about 8%), alongside Sequoia China funds and Shenzhen Capital Group.
current_role: Co-founder and founding shareholder of Zhongman Petroleum & Natural Gas Group (ZPEC, 603619.SH); acts in concert with controller Zhu Fengxue
research_notes: Only on Hurun 2018; minimal public profile. Has sold down shares (2024 block/agreement transfers). Better interview targets at ZPEC: chairman Li Chundi or controller Zhu Fengxue; route via board secretary office (Shi Mingxin).

No personal biography found.
interesting_fact: Her firm Mingtai Capital (registered 2014, Beijing IFC) has backed growth-stage rounds (B+ and C) in manufacturing, software and healthcare startups, per 36Kr.
current_role: Co-founder of Bairong Mingtai Capital Investment Co. (百荣明泰资本), Beijing (per 36Kr investor database)
research_notes: Very low public profile; identity based on a single third-party database page matching name + Mingtai Capital. No published contacts found.

name: Qian Gaofa
profile: Qian Gaofa founded the Ningbo company that became Gaofa Automotive Control System in 1999; it makes automotive control cables and shift/pedal systems and listed in Shanghai. He ran Ningbo Gaofa Auto Cable as executive director and GM from 2000 to 2011, then became chairman of the listed company; since 2023 he also heads its new-energy subsidiary.
interesting_fact: Gaofa is a family-run founder company: Qian Gaofa (about 4.9%), and Qian Guoyao and Qian Guonian (about 4.4% each) are the top three shareholders, with Qian Guonian serving as general manager.
deep_cut_fact: Still active in his seventies: in December 2023 he took on the additional post of executive director and GM of Gaofa's new-energy subsidiary (高发新能源), after heading its electronics unit since 2021.
current_role: Chairman, Ningbo Gaofa Automotive Control System Co. (SSE: 603788) (chairman since June 2011; 2023-2026 board term; post-July 2026 status not confirmed)
research_notes: Born c. 1949 (aged 74 in 2023 AR). Contacts are the company's published IR email/site from the 2023 annual report.

name: Luo Aiwen
profile: Female entrepreneur behind Dongguan-based elevator and escalator maker IFE Elevators (快意电梯), listed in Shenzhen. She directly holds about 17% of the company and controls it with affiliated vehicles (combined ~45% controlling stake held by Kuaiyi Equity Investment); she chairs the board.
interesting_fact: In June 2025 she chaired the board meeting at which IFE agreed to set up an investment and M&A fund of up to RMB 500m with Shenzhen Investment Holdings' Donghai Investment.
current_role: Chairman and actual controller of IFE Elevators (快意电梯, 002774.SZ), Dongguan
research_notes: 'Ife Elevators' = 快意电梯. Shareholding facts from the March 2025 shareholder notice (https://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2025-03-11/1222759569.PDF). Search snippets say she co-founded the company in 1987 and holds Dongguan CPPCC and federation-of-commerce roles, but this was not verified in a source I opened.

name: Du Guoying
profile: Serial consumer-products marketer (杜国楹). He founded Tianjin Yipin Technology and the posture-corrector brand Beibeijia (背背佳) in 1997, the English-learning device Haojixing (好记星) in 2003, the E人E本 tablet and the 8848 titanium phone (2015), and then the premium tea brand Xiaoguan Tea (小罐茶).
interesting_fact: His product run is a generational memory in China: Beibeijia posture braces, Haojixing English gadgets, the E人E本 tablet (billed as 'China's iPad', with ads starring Feng Xiaogang and Ge You), the 8848 titanium phone and Xiaoguan Tea.
deep_cut_fact: He was a teacher until 1994, when at 21 he left to go into business; in 1995, posted to Tianjin, he ran his first radio ad and took his company's sales lead, which set off his advertising-led playbook.
current_role: Founder, Xiaoguan Tea (小罐茶, Beijing Xiaoguan Tea Co.)
research_notes: High-profile marketer; his companies have drawn advertising controversies (e.g. Beibeijia claims, Xiaoguan Tea's 2019 'master-made' row), so steer clear. No personal contacts published; route via Xiaoguan Tea corporate PR.

name: Liu Fahe
profile: Liu Fahe (刘法合, b. Aug 1959) built Sanli Group in Matou town, Zouping (Shandong) into a family conglomerate spanning cotton, compact/ring spinning, home textiles, petroleum refining, chemicals, feed, logistics and coal. He controls it with his brothers. Hurun listed the Liu Fahe family at RMB 2.3bn in 2012-2013 for 'Sanli textiles and petrochemicals'.
interesting_fact: Sanli is a rare cotton-to-oil combination: the four Liu brothers own a group that runs cotton, compact and ring spinning, eco home textiles, edible oil and feed alongside petroleum, chemicals, logistics and coal.
deep_cut_fact: Sanli's company profile describes him as a native of Shaodian village (邵店村), Matou town, Zouping, a university-educated engineer and Party member who had run the business continuously since 1985.
current_role: Founder and chairman/legal representative of Zouping Sanli Group (邹平县三利集团) and its parent Zhongrong Shuangchuang (Beijing) Technology Group (中融双创), Zouping, Binzhou, Shandong
research_notes: Hurun 'San Li' = 三利集团. name: Chen Hongchao
profile: A Peacebird veteran described as on a par with founder-chairman Zhang Jiangping, Chen Hongchao (陈红朝) was a director from 2012 and general manager from April 2017 (after the January 2017 IPO) for about six years, also heading the women's-wear division (Peacebird Women, Lautomn, MG). He resigned for personal reasons and remains a top-four shareholder.
interesting_fact: He ran Peacebird's women's apparel division, covering the Peacebird women's line, Lautomn (乐町) and MG brands, and was the company's No. 2 shareholder after the parent group as of 2022.
current_role: Major individual shareholder (4.75% at end-2025) of Peacebird (太平鸟, SSE 603877); former director and general manager, resigned all company posts (announced 7 Feb, c.2023)

Resignation year inferred as 2023 from the article context.

name: Cheng Zhongfa
profile: Cheng Zhongfa (also written 程终发) controls Shandong Taihe Technologies, a Zaozhuang-based maker of water-treatment chemicals, including scale and corrosion inhibitors, biocides and electronic-grade chemicals. The company was founded about 20 years ago and says it aims to become a global leader in fine chemicals; about 60% of its water-treatment chemical sales are exports.
interesting_fact: Taihe has more than 500,000 tonnes a year of water-treatment chemical capacity and has been named a national manufacturing 'single champion'.
deep_cut_fact: Taihe's subsidiary Qingli New Materials (氢力新材料) captures by-product hydrogen from its caustic-soda process and uses it for power and heat. The company is also investing 410m yuan in new-energy battery materials (LiFSI, FEC).
current_role: Chairman (per 2024 interview) and controlling shareholder of Shandong Taihe Technologies (泰和科技, SZSE: 300801), Zaozhuang
research_notes: Hurun spells the name 程钟发; filings use 程终发. Relevant to the energy theme (hydrogen by-product, battery electrolyte materials). The 2025 H1 report names Yao Ya as company head, so his exact current title should be checked.

name: Dai Yan
profile: Dai Yan (b. 1965), a materials engineer, has worked at Chengdu Galaxy Magnets since 1993 and has chaired it since June 2007. The company, founded 1993 and listed in Shenzhen in 2010, makes bonded NdFeB rare-earth magnets; he holds about 98.6m shares.
interesting_fact: A career magnet technologist, he has spent his whole working life on bonded NdFeB rare-earth magnet R&D and production at Galaxy, and won a Sichuan Science and Technology Progress first prize and Sichuan provincial model-worker title.
deep_cut_fact: He studied materials science at Sichuan University (BS 1986) and earned a master's in materials engineering in 1991, two years before joining Galaxy Magnets at its founding year.
current_role: Chairman and legal representative, Chengdu Galaxy Magnets (银河磁体, SZ:300127); re-elected June 2025 for 2025-2028
research_notes: Board secretary Zhu Kuiwen per 10jqka (https://basic.10jqka.com.cn/300127/company.html). Rare-earth magnets link to EV motors/energy supply chain.

name: Deng Yong
profile: Deng Yong (邓勇), born 1967, has spent his career in glass: he joined a glassware factory as a worker in 1985, ran several glass factories from 1988, and became general manager of Zhengchuan in 1997. He was chairman and GM of the listed company 2013-2022 and chairman since October 2022; it makes pharmaceutical glass tubing, vials and caps in Beibei, Chongqing.
interesting_fact: In July 2026 Zhengchuan signed a long-term strategic cooperation agreement with Italy's SPAMI on pharmaceutical packaging manufacturing and market expansion.
deep_cut_fact: He started at 18 as a factory-floor worker at a glassware plant in 1985, rising to workshop director and technician before running Tankou Glass Factory; he is a qualified engineer.
current_role: Chairman, Chongqing Zhengchuan Pharmaceutical Packaging Materials Co. (正川股份)
research_notes: Common name; identity tied via Zhengchuan role. Route via company board secretary.

name: Du Ligang
profile: Du Ligang (杜立刚) co-founded Shanghai EV maker WM Motor with CEO Shen Hui, a former colleague, in late 2015. He joined as CFO and later became executive vice chairman, overseeing fundraising, new business development, legal and internal control during WM's rise to unicorn status. Media reported in Dec 2022 that he was leaving after seven years.
interesting_fact: One account says WM Motor's roots trace to an electric-drivetrain ('three-electric' battery/motor/control) R&D company Du founded in 2012, which later merged with Shen Hui's venture; other reports say he joined at Shen's invitation.
current_role: Former co-founder and Executive Vice Chairman of WM Motor (威马汽车, 'Weltmeister'); reported to be leaving in Dec 2022. Current role unknown
research_notes: No public profile or contact channels found since he left WM Motor; WM later went through bankruptcy restructuring (2023), so the Hurun wealth figure (2021) is likely stale. Low priority for outreach.

name: Gao Zhijiang
profile: Gao Zhijiang (高志江) co-founded Chuzhou Chaoyue Xinxing Waste Disposal in July 2009 with Li Guangrong, each putting in RMB 1.5M of its RMB 3M registered capital. The firm, now Anhui Chaoyue (listed on ChiNext), incinerates, landfills and recycles industrial hazardous waste and dismantles e-waste, and has added vehicle dismantling and lithium-battery recycling.
interesting_fact: Chaoyue started in 2009 with just RMB 3 million of registered capital in Chuzhou, Anhui, and grew into a listed hazardous-waste and e-waste processor now also in lithium-battery recycling.
current_role: Co-founder and co-actual controller (29.1%) of Anhui Chaoyue Environmental Protection Technology (超越科技, 301049.SZ)
research_notes: Not listed as chairman; chairman is co-founder Li Guangrong (李光荣). Board secretary/CFO Fan Min (范敏). Low personal profile.

name: Li Huafeng
profile: Li Huafeng (李华锋) is one of the 58 individuals who owned Guangdong Haitian Group, controlling shareholder of soy-sauce giant Haitian. The 2013 IPO prospectus shows him with about 0.63% of Haitian Group and 1.57M shares (0.22%) held directly in Haitian Flavouring. The company's employee-owner model made dozens of managers wealthy.

name: Li Lifeng
profile: Li Lifeng (b. Oct 1971) is a Yuyao, Zhejiang entrepreneur who rose through family-run Ningbo Shimao Copper (supervisor 2001, GM 2009, chairman 2016) and has chaired Ningbo Shimao Energy since 2018. Shimao Energy runs waste-to-energy incineration plants selling power and industrial steam in Yuyao; it listed in Shanghai in 2021. Unrelated to developer Shimao Group.
interesting_fact: Shimao Energy turns municipal household waste into electricity and process steam for local industry - a waste-to-energy and combined heat business rather than conventional power.
deep_cut_fact: Li is a deputy to the 14th Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress, vice-chair of Yuyao's federation of industry and commerce, and was named a 'Yuyao Model Worker' and one of Ningbo's outstanding entrepreneurs (16th edition).

public_contact: ir_email: shimaoenergy@shimaoenergy.com (company email for shareholder matters) | ir_email: wujiangang@shimaoenergy.com (board secretary Wu Jiangang, published IR contact) | official_website: http://www.shimaoenergy.com

name: Li Tie
profile: Li Tie (Tie Li, also 'Johnny') has been CFO and a director of EV maker Li Auto since July 2016, joining founder Li Xiang from Autohome, where he worked 2008-2016 rising to vice president. His wealth comes from his early Li Auto shareholding; he steers the company's finances and capital-markets messaging.
interesting_fact: Before cars he was an auditor: he worked at PwC's Beijing office from 2002 to 2008, then followed Autohome into the auto-internet world before joining Li Auto at its early stage in 2016.
deep_cut_fact: He holds a bachelor's in accounting and a master's in management from Tsinghua University, completed Harvard Business School's Senior Executive Leadership Program in 2019, and is an independent director of TCM clinic chain Gushengtang Holdings (HKEX: 2273).
current_role: Director and Chief Financial Officer, Li Auto Inc. (Nasdaq: LI; HKEX: 2015), since July 2016
public_contact: ir_email: ir@lixiang.com | pr_agency: Christensen Advisory (Roger Hu), Li@christensencomms.com

name: Liu Meng
profile: Liu Meng co-founded Kunming Chuan Jin Nuo Chemical in June 2005 in Dongchuan, Yunnan, and remains its chairman and controlling shareholder. The company makes phosphoric acid, feed-grade phosphates and phosphate fertilizers, and has expanded via its Guangxi Chuan Jin Nuo New Energy subsidiary into iron phosphate and lithium iron phosphate (LFP) battery cathode materials for EVs and energy storage.
interesting_fact: A phosphate-fertilizer maker turned battery-materials player: Chuan Jin Nuo now produces iron phosphate and LFP cathode material used in EV and energy-storage lithium batteries.
deep_cut_fact: The company started on 2 June 2005 as a 1 million yuan limited company founded by Liu Meng and three partners, registered in the Sifangdi industrial park in Tongdu town, Dongchuan district, Kunming.
current_role: Chairman, legal representative, controlling shareholder and actual controller, Kunming Chuan Jin Nuo Chemical (川金诺, SZSE ChiNext: 300505)
research_notes: Energy-storage/LFP angle relevant to the podcast. Contact is company IR (securities affairs).

name: Liu Xiancheng
profile: Liu Xiancheng chairs Shenzhen Lifotronic (Pumen Technology), which was founded in 2008 around therapy and rehabilitation devices, added in-vitro diagnostics in 2013 and later skin aesthetics and consumer health. It is listed on Shanghai's STAR Market. He held about 29.4% as of March 2026, and 2025 revenue was about RMB1.04bn.
interesting_fact: Lifotronic built on its wound photonic-therapy know-how to move into medical aesthetics, and is now described as one of China's most comprehensive makers of medical aesthetic equipment.
deep_cut_fact: At a January 2024 Daotong Investment founders' session, Liu said 'a company's value is the value of its product differentiation', arguing that differentiation keeps firms out of price 'involution' on the same track and that heavy R&D is the core engine of growth.
current_role: Chairman, controlling shareholder and actual controller, Shenzhen Lifotronic Technology Co., Ltd. (688389.SH)
research_notes: 29.39% stake per a quote.cfi.cn shareholder page (as summarised in search). Has announced plans to buy RMB10-30m of company shares. Speaks at investor and industry events, so a podcast angle on medtech/aesthetics could resonate. Route via company board office.

name: Zhao Hanxin
profile: Zhao Hanxin (赵汉新), born October 1953, is an engineer and senior economist from Yanqiao, Wuxi. He ran local micro-motor factories from 1984 and then founded Xishan Hongtai, later New Hongtai, which makes key circuit-breaker components, low-voltage breakers, BMC moulded insulation parts and fuse switches. He took it public in Shanghai in 2016 and left the board in 2020.
interesting_fact: New Hongtai, the company he co-founded with Zhao Minhai and others, makes the moulded insulating parts and mechanisms inside low-voltage circuit breakers, basic components of power distribution in buildings and data centres.
deep_cut_fact: He started in 1973 as a technician at the micro-motor factory run by Yanqiao Middle School in Wuxi, and spent 11 years there before becoming director of the Wuxi County micro-motor factory in 1984.
current_role: Co-founder and former Chairman (2008 to 2016) and director (to October 2020), Wuxi New Hongtai Electrical Technology Co. (SSE: 603016)
research_notes: Web search quota ran out mid-lane; data comes from Sina Finance filings. He has not been on the board since October 2020. Ding Kui has been chairman since December 2023, which suggests control may have changed; Zhao Minhai (vice-chairman and GM) is co-listed. Born 1953; I found no recent news of him.

name: ZhaoMin
profile: Zhao Minhai (赵敏海, listed as 'ZhaoMin'; b. 1979, Tsinghua EMBA) built Wuxi New Hongtai with his family (co-listed holder Zhao Hanxin). It makes circuit-breaker key components, low-voltage breakers and BMC/SMC moulded insulation parts. He was chairman 2016-2023; after state-owned Wuxi Industry Development Group took control in 2023 he stayed on as vice-chairman and GM, holding ~26m shares.
interesting_fact: New Hongtai is a grid-equipment play: it supplies moulded-case and air circuit breakers, moulded insulation parts and breaker motor-operating mechanisms, and is classed under power equipment / grid equipment.
deep_cut_fact: He joined the family business at about 23, in October 2002, and was already vice-chairman and general manager by 2008, before the company's IPO.
current_role: Vice-chairman and general manager, Wuxi New Hongtai Electrical Technology Co. (SSE: 603016)
research_notes: Name in source data is truncated ('ZhaoMin'); the Chinese name 赵敏海 matches the New Hongtai executive. Relevant to an energy/grid-equipment angle. Route via the company board secretary's office (Du Jianping per 10jqka).

name: Zhu Tangfu
profile: Founder of Landai, set up in Chongqing's Bishan district in 1996 as Chongqing Landai Industrial; it makes automotive transmission assemblies, gears/shafts and EV e-drive parts, and since buying Taiguan Technology also touch screens and touch-display modules. He chaired the board through its 2015 Shenzhen IPO and four board terms; control has since passed to state-owned Anhui Jiangdong Industrial Investment.
interesting_fact: Landai straddles two very different businesses: power-transmission parts for cars/EVs and touch-screen/touch-display panels, after acquiring Shenzhen Taiguan Technology.
deep_cut_fact: In March 2024 the board named him honorary chairman, crediting him with leading the company from its founding through its 2015 listing as chairman of its first four boards; he then held 19.25% of the shares.
current_role: Founder and Honorary Chairman (since Mar 2024), Landai Technology Group (蓝黛科技, 002765.SZ), Chongqing
research_notes: Alive as of the Mar 2024 announcement. Company is now state-controlled (Anhui Jiangdong), so IR is not a direct channel to him; family member remains vice chairman/acting chairman. Very low media profile.

name: Zhang Chen
profile: Zhang Chen founded Mahua FunAge in the early 2000s as a stage-comedy producer (plays, musicals, children's theatre). It broke through on CCTV's 2012 Spring Festival Gala and moved into film with 2015 smash 'Goodbye Mr. Loser', followed by hits such as 'Hello Mr. Billionaire'; he remains chairman of what is China's leading comedy content company, with theatres and troupes in 10+ cities.
interesting_fact: Mahua FunAge's first film, 'Goodbye Mr. Loser' (夏洛特烦恼, 2015), became a breakout box-office hit and launched the company - and stars like Shen Teng - from the stage into Chinese cinema.
deep_cut_fact: In 2020 he launched the first Longgang Comedy Festival in Shenzhen (10 days, 10+ original Chinese comedies, from mime and physical comedy to stand-up), saying it needed 3-5 years of groundwork; after Covid lockdowns his company took three free charity shows of 'Wulong Mountain Count' to Wuhan for medical workers.
current_role: Founder and Chairman, Mahua FunAge (Kaixin Mahua / 开心麻花), Beijing
research_notes: Not to be confused with co-founder Zhang Duo. Favorite quote (2015): '我们做东西产量不高，很慢，但是慢工才能出细活' ('we produce slowly, because careful work yields quality'). Entertainment, not energy - fits entrepreneurship angle only. No official contact found in budget; company site is kaixinmahua.com.cn (unverified).

name: Qu Honggui
profile: Qu Honggui (瞿洪桂, b. 1965), a UESTC-trained engineer and former manager at the Ministry of Electronics' China Electronic Equipment Corp., built Sinonet (北京中电兴发) in smart-city/public-security systems and chairs the listed parent. The group now focuses on smart power distribution equipment and new energy: energy storage, solar plants, EV chargers and carbon-management software.
interesting_fact: The company's pivot puts it squarely in the energy transition: switchgear and power distribution plus new-type energy storage systems, PV and charging infrastructure.
deep_cut_fact: He co-founded a counter-terrorism/police equipment joint lab with his alma mater, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, where he is a research fellow; he was named a 2019 'Smart City Leader' and one of Anhui's '30 Best Innovative Entrepreneurs'.
current_role: Chairman, Anhui Zhongdian Xinlong Technology Co. (formerly Sinonet / 中电兴发, SZSE 002298)
research_notes: Strong fit for an energy/data-center podcast (power distribution + storage). Contact email is the board secretary address published in the 2025 annual report.

name: Luo Ruifa
profile: Luo Ruifa (b. 1976), a senior engineer in transport information engineering, co-founded Shenzhen-based Genvict in 2004. It became a leading maker of ETC (electronic toll collection) on-board units, with cumulative OBU sales passing 100 million around China's 2019-20 removal of provincial toll stations. He now steers it toward vehicle-road coordination (V2X), smart highways and transport-energy integration.
interesting_fact: Genvict built its first-generation ETC product in 2004, deployed in Guangdong, and helped draft China's national ETC standards; its OBU sales topped 100 million units during the 2019-20 nationwide toll-booth removal programme.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding Genvict he was a department manager at Guangzhou telecom-equipment firm Etes Communication; he is now pursuing a PhD in transportation at Tongji University and chairs the Shenzhen Smart Transportation Industry Promotion Association.
current_role: Chairman and General Manager, Shenzhen Genvict Technologies (金溢科技, SZSE: 002869)
research_notes: Strong podcast fit: Genvict's 2025 strategy pivots to 'transport-energy integration' (digital energy, connected transport). He holds many industry-association roles in Shenzhen, so is relatively accessible via IR/board office.

name: Nie Dongsheng
profile: Nie Dongsheng (聂东升, born 1960) spent two decades as a Henan provincial veterinary official before going into business. He has chaired Shanghai-based Shenlian Biomedical since 2006. The company makes veterinary vaccines, notably synthetic-peptide and inactivated vaccines against foot-and-mouth disease in pigs and cattle, and listed on Shanghai's STAR Market. It is now also moving into human biologics through affiliates.
interesting_fact: Shenlian has built its business on synthetic-peptide vaccines for foot-and-mouth disease in pigs, a technology platform rather than the conventional inactivated-virus approach, and it holds national Class-I new veterinary drug certificates.
deep_cut_fact: Before business he was a career veterinary official: section chief at the Henan Veterinary Prevention Station, deputy head of the Henan Animal Quarantine Station, and from 2001 to 2011 head (社长) of the Henan Journal of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Medicine. He holds the title of agricultural technology extension researcher.
current_role: Chairman and controlling shareholder (with Yang Yufang), Shenlian Biomedical (申联生物, SSE STAR 688098)
research_notes: Facts are from Shenlian's 2025 annual report (published April 2026). The IR email is the board office address published there. Low English-language media profile.

name: Yang Yufang
profile: Yang Yufang (杨玉芳) is one of four acting-in-concert controlling shareholders (together ~30.8%) of Shanghai Shen Lian Biomedical, a STAR-Market-listed maker of veterinary vaccines, notably foot-and-mouth-disease vaccines for pigs, cattle and sheep, including synthetic-peptide FMD vaccines. The 2025 annual report lists her principal occupation as 'retired'; Nie Dongsheng chairs the company.
interesting_fact: Shen Lian is known for synthetic-peptide foot-and-mouth-disease vaccines (e.g. a porcine FMD type O/A bivalent synthetic peptide vaccine), a niche where China runs compulsory livestock immunisation programmes.
current_role: Retired; co-actual controller and major shareholder of Shanghai Shen Lian Biomedical / 申联生物 (SH688098)
research_notes: Retired, no public profile; not an outreach candidate in her own right. The operational figure is chairman Nie Dongsheng (listed in input as shared_with). Route via company IR.

interesting_fact: Allwinner's cheap ARM chips (A10/A13/A20) briefly made it the world's No. 1 supplier by units of Android-tablet application processors in 2012-13, and powered open-hardware boards like the Cubieboard.
deep_cut_fact: Allwinner was started by a group of senior engineers who left Zhuhai's Actions Semiconductor; per Allwinner's 2026 filing, Ding Ran has been a co-founder since the company's creation in September 2007.
current_role: Director and Vice President, Allwinner Technology (Zhuhai; SZSE ChiNext: 300458)
research_notes: Low public profile; holds Macau permanent residency per filing. Board secretary is Cai Xiaopeng (IR). Edge-AI chip angle fits the data-center/AI focus loosely.

Founded in 2010, the company listed on Shanghai's STAR Market in March 2021; he has been chairman and GM since 2018.

current_role: Chairman and General Manager, Hangzhou MDK Opto Electronics (SSE STAR: 688079)

name: Shao Wei
profile: Shao Wei (邵伟, ~56) founded Qingdao Hiron Electrical in 2006, which became Hiron Commercial Cold Chain and listed in Shanghai in Nov 2018. Hiron makes commercial freezer and chiller display cabinets and smart vending cabinets for ice-cream, beverage, beer, dairy and convenience-store customers, plus ODM refrigeration; he holds ~77m shares and still runs the company as chairman and GM.
interesting_fact: Hiron's products are the branded freezer and chiller cabinets seen at the point of sale; the company runs fully automated fluorine-free (CFC-free) production lines and also builds smart vending cabinets.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding Hiron he worked at Aucma (澳柯玛), the Qingdao appliance maker known for chest freezers, and at Qingdao Jingxuehua Electrical; he also sits on the board of Beijing smart-retail firm 极智简单科技.
current_role: Chairman & general manager, Qingdao Hiron Commercial Cold Chain Co. (海容冷链, SSE: 603187)
public_contact: ir_email: dm@chinahiron.com (board office; IR tel +86 532-58762750; board secretary Zhao Dingyong)

name: Shen Haibo
profile: Born 1968, Shen Haibo is a Ganfeng Lithium veteran who joined in 2005 as marketing director and served as a director from 2007 and director/vice president from 2010, holding ~15.3M Ganfeng shares directly. He now runs Ganfeng's battery subsidiaries Huichuang New Energy and Dongguan Ganfeng and oversees the group's battery recycling business; he stepped off the board in Oct 2026 for work reasons but stays with the company.
interesting_fact: He was among the earliest executives at Ganfeng, now one of the world's largest lithium producers, joining in 2005 years before its 2010 Shenzhen IPO and helping build its sales operation.
deep_cut_fact: Lithium was his trade before Ganfeng: from 1996-2002 he was lithium-products manager at the Beijing office of China Nonferrous Metals Import & Export Xinjiang Corp; he studied industrial engineering management at North China University of Technology (class of 1991).
current_role: General Manager of Huichuang New Energy and Dongguan Ganfeng; heads battery recycling at Ganfeng Lithium (left Ganfeng board Oct 2026, remains in other roles)
public_contact: press_email: sunyifan@ganfenglithium.com | ir_email: info@ganfenglithium.com | official_website: https://www.ganfenglithium.com
research_notes: Ganfeng lists a named 'Media Cooperation' contact (Evan Sun) - best route. Battery recycling/second-life angle is relevant to energy storage. Board exit Oct 2026 reported by rccaijing; confirm his current title before outreach.

name: Song Weiquan
profile: Song Weiquan (宋卫权) is one of the seven natural persons - with chairman Chen Xiangdong, Fan Weihong, Zheng Shaobo, Jiang Zhongyong, Luo Huabing and Chen Guohua - who jointly control Silan Microelectronics via Hangzhou Silan Holdings. Silan is a Hangzhou-based integrated device manufacturer of power semiconductors, MEMS sensors and LED chips; Hurun listed him at ~$360M (2021).
interesting_fact: Silan has been controlled by the same seven-founder group for decades - its 2025 half-year report still names all seven as the company's ultimate controlling parties, a rare example of a stable founder collective in Chinese semiconductors.
current_role: Co-founder and one of seven ultimate controlling shareholders of Hangzhou Silan Microelectronics (士兰微, SSE: 600460); no board/executive title found
public_contact: ir_email: 600460@silan.com.cn (board secretary / securities affairs office) | office_email: silan@silan.com.cn (company general email) | official_website: http://www.silan.com.cn

name: Tan Zheng
profile: Tan Zheng (48) is a pharma sales and commercialisation veteran who has led Immunotech Biopharm (Yongtai), a T-cell immunotherapy developer whose lead product EAL targets liver-cancer recurrence, since 2018, listing it in Hong Kong in 2020. He also chairs BrainAurora Medical Technology.
interesting_fact: Immunotech was the first T-cell immunotherapy specialist to list pre-revenue on HKEX (July 2020); its shares rose ~41% on debut.
deep_cut_fact: He began his career in 1998 at Shaanxi Buchang Pharmaceutical, rising to office supervisor of its Tianjin office, then ran Beijing offices for Shanxi Kanghui Pharmaceutical and Wuhan Heer Medical.
current_role: Chairman and Executive Director, Immunotech Biopharm Ltd (HKEX: 6978); Chairman, BrainAurora Medical Technology (HKEX: 6681)
research_notes: Controls votes via Tan Zheng Ltd and a proxy arrangement. Company site not reachable from this environment; IR contact not found.

name: Men Qingjuan
profile: Men Qingjuan (门庆娟), born 1981, co-founded Wuxi Online Offline in September 2012 with Wang Kun (汪坤) and was its first executive director and manager. The company sells mobile messaging services, mainly enterprise SMS, and listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext in March 2021, which put both founders on the Hurun China and under-40 lists. A new board led by Xia Jun took over in October 2025.
interesting_fact: She made the Hurun China Under-40 list in 2021 after her enterprise-SMS company IPO'd on ChiNext. The business delivers verification codes and notifications for large internet platforms.
deep_cut_fact: Her first job was as an office clerk at the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China's Neijiang (Sichuan) branch. She then worked at a computer company in Changzhou before co-founding Online Offline in Wuxi in 2012.
current_role: Co-founder and former director (to October 2025), Wuxi Online Offline Communication Information Technology (SZSE: 300959); executive director of Wuxi Junmao Investment
research_notes: She and Wang Kun left the board in October 2025, when a new board under Xia Jun was installed, likely after a change of control, so the company IR channel may no longer reach her. Web search quota ran out mid-lane; data comes from Sina Finance filings.

name: Wang Yuxiang
profile: Wang Yuxiang (b. 1975) holds a PhD in cartography and GIS from the CAS Institute of Remote Sensing and Digital Earth. He co-founded Beijing remote-sensing software and services firm PIESAT in 2008 and controls it with co-founder Zhang Yan. PIESAT now builds its own 'Nuwa' satellite constellation. Note: it reported a 2025 net loss of RMB 1.86bn with overdue debts and going-concern doubts.
interesting_fact: At the January 2026 Beijing 'two sessions' he proposed a 'space data centre innovation consortium' to crack power supply, cooling and inter-satellite links for orbital computing; PIESAT's Nuwa compute satellites target ~4 PFLOPS per satellite in dawn-dusk orbit.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding PIESAT he was technical director at Beijing Nova Information Technology, part of Finland's Novo Group (2002-04), then at Founder-Aode (2004-08); he is on China's national 'Ten Thousand Talents' programme.
current_role: Chairman (and acting CFO), PIESAT Information Technology (SSE STAR: 688066); Beijing CPPCC member
research_notes: Excellent fit for a data-centre/energy podcast (space computing, orbital data centres). Caveat: PIESAT is in financial distress (2025 loss, debt overdue; an independent director abstained on the Q1 2026 report citing going-concern doubt, per CS.com.cn filings). Route via the board secretary's office.

name: Wang Zengchao
profile: Born 1969, Zhejiang-origin entrepreneur with 30+ years in scrap-metal recycling and secondary aluminium. Founded Shunbo in Chongqing in 2003; it listed in Shenzhen in Aug 2020 and is one of China's leading recycled-aluminium alloy producers. He co-runs it with Wang Zhenjian (chairman), both holding ~140m shares each.
interesting_fact: Shunbo was the first listed company from Chongqing's Hechuan district and the city's 56th listed firm; its business is turning scrap aluminium into alloy ingots, a low-carbon alternative to primary aluminium.
deep_cut_fact: His career began at the Xilu metal-fittings factory in Yongkang, Zhejiang; even after founding Shunbo in 2003 he worked in its purchasing department (2005-07) before becoming executive director and later chairman/GM.
current_role: Vice Chairman and President, Chongqing Shunbo Aluminum Alloy (002996.SZ)
research_notes: Facts from exchange-disclosed management bios (Eastmoney F10). Recycled aluminium/energy-intensity angle fits an energy podcast. Has been gradually selling shares (2025).

name: Wei Xiaolin
profile: Born in 1956, Wei Xiaolin founded Chengdu-based Xiling Power in 1999; it makes engine components such as camshafts, pulleys and crankshaft dampers for automakers and has expanded into aviation and defense parts. He and his wife are the company's controlling shareholders, and he runs it as chairman and general manager.
interesting_fact: Xiling Power started in auto parts but now runs a separate aviation and military components division, putting the Chengdu firm in aerospace supply chains as well as automotive.
deep_cut_fact: He spent 17 years (1975-1992) as a worker in Workshop 82 at Chengdu Aircraft Company, then in 1992 founded a small auto-parts factory in Qingyang district before creating Xiling in 1999.
current_role: Chairman & General Manager and controlling shareholder, Chengdu Xiling Power Science & Technology (西菱动力, SZSE: 300733)
public_contact: ir_email: Yanghao@xlqp.com | ir_email: hexinzhu@xlqp.com | official_website: http://www.xlqp.com
research_notes: Contacts are the board secretary (Yang Hao) and securities rep from the 2024 annual report. The board term expired in Jan 2026; re-election outcome not checked. Low public profile; only on Hurun China 2021.

name: Xiang Lehong
profile: Founder-chairman of Loctek, which began in March 2002 as Lijing Electronic Cable in Ningbo and became a maker of electric sit-stand desks, monitor arms and smart beds. It listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext in Dec 2017 as the first A-share ergonomics company and the first cross-border e-commerce IPO, and now also runs public overseas warehouses for Chinese brands shipping abroad. Hurun lists him with Lou Yi.
interesting_fact: Loctek invested over US$100m in public overseas-warehouse complexes, turning a desk maker into a cross-border logistics provider ('4supply') for other Chinese brands.
deep_cut_fact: At the 'cloud opening' of the 127th Canton Fair (2020, held online), Xiang Lehong was the company chairman who video-linked live with then-Premier Li Keqiang; Loctek was also first to put electric height-adjustment into a children's study desk.
current_role: Chairman, Loctek Ergonomic Technology Corp. (乐歌股份, SZSE: 300729), Ningbo
research_notes: Listed-company chairman; IR contact is published in Loctek's SZSE filings (investor-relations page on loctek.com is JS-only). Cross-border e-commerce/logistics angle may suit an entrepreneurship podcast.

profile: Xie Qingkui (谢庆奎, b. 1951) is the founder-chairman of Seamild, a Guilin-based maker of oat cereals and healthy-grain foods that he previously also ran as general manager. Seamild, listed in 2019, describes itself as a pioneer and leader of China's oat industry with a field-to-table supply chain.
interesting_fact: Seamild runs oat production lines imported from Switzerland's Bühler Group and has a grain subsidiary in Zhangbei, Hebei, as part of its farm-to-table oat chain.
current_role: Chairman, Guilin Seamild Foods Co. (西麦食品, SZSE 002956)

name: Xu Huadong
profile: Chinese industrialist (b. 1968) who founded Huafeng Power in April 2004; with partner Chui Lap Lam he controls it via Engineus Power Holding. The company makes diesel-engine blocks/heads, small multi-cylinder diesel engines and generator sets (10kW-2,400kW), and is pushing gas gensets as prime power for data centers, including in the US market.
interesting_fact: Huafeng says its natural-gas generator sets can serve as primary (not just backup) power for data centers and it is pursuing US certification and orders; it earlier won diesel-genset tenders for China Unicom's Langfang and Hohhot data-center bases.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding the engine maker he worked in trade, at Changzhou Garment Import & Export Co. and Changzhou International Economic & Technical Cooperation Group; he holds a master's degree and is also listed as one of the company's core technical personnel.
current_role: Founder, Chairman and General Manager, Power HF Co., Ltd. (Huafeng Power, SSE: 605100), Weifang, Shandong
research_notes: Chinese name 徐华东. No published email found; company switchboard/IR via board secretary Liu Xiang per filings. Data-center backup/prime power angle is a strong podcast hook, though gensets are still a small share of revenue.

name: Chui Lap Lam
profile: Hong Kong-linked investor disclosed, with chairman Xu Huadong, as an actual controller of Power HF (Huafeng Power), holding ~8.6% indirectly via offshore vehicles (Engineus Power Holding). Power HF makes diesel engines for backup power, data centers, trucks, construction and marine use; listed in Shanghai in 2020. No public biography found.
interesting_fact: Power HF's diesel engines are sold for stationary power generation including data-center backup, linking this low-profile fortune to the data-center buildout.
current_role: Co-actual controller (with Xu Huadong) of Power HF Co., Ltd. / Huafeng Power (SSE: 605100), Weifang, Shandong

name: Yang Guimo
profile: Yang Guimo (b. c.1949) built Weihai-based Shandong Weida, a major maker of drill chucks, saw blades and precision power-tool parts that has diversified into energy-storage lithium battery packs and EV battery-swap stations. In July 2024 he transferred control to his daughter Yang Mingyan, now chair and GM, and stepped off the board at the February 2025 term end.
interesting_fact: A power-tool-accessories manufacturer, Weida now also builds energy-storage battery packs and battery-swap stations for new-energy vehicles.
deep_cut_fact: The 2024 handover was structured as a family succession: control of Weida Group passed from Yang Guimo to his daughter Yang Mingyan, who started as a staff member at Shandong Weida Machine Tool Group before rising to chair.
current_role: Founder and former actual controller of Shandong Weida Machinery (山东威达, SZSE: 002026); left the board Feb 2025
research_notes: Now retired from the board (aged ~76). For a podcast on energy, his daughter Yang Mingyan (chair) is the more relevant guest given Weida's battery-swap and storage business. Hurun listing shared with Yang Mingyan.

name: Yang Mingyan
profile: Yang Mingyan (杨明燕, born 1977, master's degree) leads Shandong Weida Machinery in Weihai, which she controls; the rich-list entry is shared with Yang Guimo. Weida makes drill chucks, switches, saw blades and other power-tool parts for Stanley Black & Decker, Bosch, TTI and Makita. Under her it has moved into energy-storage lithium battery packs and EV battery-swap stations.
interesting_fact: A power-tool-parts maker turned energy-transition player: Weida now builds energy-storage lithium battery packs and battery-swap stations for electric vehicles alongside its drill chucks.
deep_cut_fact: She started as an ordinary staff member at the Shandong Weida Machine Tool group before becoming chairwoman. She also served as a director of Wuhan Weineng Battery Asset Co. (蔚能), the battery-leasing company behind NIO's battery-as-a-service model, and runs Shanghai Yunyan New Energy Technology.
current_role: Chairwoman, General Manager and actual controller, Shandong Weida Machinery (山东威达, SZSE 002026)
research_notes: Strong fit for an energy-focused podcast (battery storage, EV battery swapping). Facts are from Weida's 2025 annual report. The IR email is the board-secretary office address published there.

name: Yang Xiaoqi
profile: Shanghai Jiao Tong University graduate (b. 1963) who founded fabless chip designer Fullhan in 2004. Fullhan makes image-signal-processing and video SoC chips for security cameras, smart-home devices and in-car cameras, and listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext in 2017. He leads the largest shareholder group (~25% with concert parties) and is pursuing a Hong Kong dual listing.
interesting_fact: Fullhan's ISP and IP-camera chips are a key domestic supplier for China's video-surveillance industry; its 2025 chips integrate on-chip NPUs for AI detection.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding Fullhan he was a department manager at China Kejian Co. (1987-92), general manager of Shenzhen Silicon Valley Electronic Systems (1994-2000) and COO of Wuhan Hanwang High-Tech (2000-03).
current_role: Founder, Chairman and General Manager, Shanghai Fullhan Microelectronics (富瀚微, SZSE: 300613)
research_notes: Low English-language profile. Chips focus is edge video/AI vision rather than data-center compute. Best route: Fullhan investor services (stock@fullhan.com).

name: You Tianyuan
profile: You Tianyuan (尤天远) is one of the founding team of Guangzhou-based CVTE (视源股份), set up in 2005 and listed in Shenzhen in 2017. CVTE began in TV/display mainboards and now makes interactive flat panels and AI devices under the seewo (education) and MAXHUB (meeting-room) brands, with 2025 revenue of about RMB24.4bn. He holds about 27.3 million shares and is one of six joint actual controllers.
interesting_fact: CVTE has no single controlling shareholder: six co-founders (Huang Zhengcong, Wang Yiran, Sun Yonghui, Yu Wei, Zhou Kaiqi and You Tianyuan) are jointly the actual controllers, an unusual 'partnership' ownership model for a Chinese listed tech company.
current_role: Co-founder, shareholder and one of six joint actual controllers of Guangzhou Shiyuan Electronic Technology / CVTE (SZ002841); no current board role listed

name: Zhang Songgen
profile: Born 1966; a radio-electronics PhD and former Chinese Academy of Sciences researcher who has led Tinavi since 2007, building China's pioneer orthopaedic surgical robot maker. Its TiRobot system covers full-spine, trauma and joint-replacement surgery; the company listed on the STAR Market in 2020 and he remains chairman.
interesting_fact: Tinavi was the first company in China, and the fifth worldwide, to win a registration licence for a medical (surgical) robot.
deep_cut_fact: He earned his doctorate at the Russian Academy of Sciences' Institute of Radio-engineering and Electronics, then worked as an assistant/associate researcher at the CAS Institute of Electronics (1995-2001) before turning entrepreneur.

He controls Jianxin Chemical (ChiNext-listed 2010), a fine-chemicals maker of dye and thermal-paper intermediates in Cangzhou's Lingang zone. He was a deputy to the 11th and 12th National People's Congress.
interesting_fact: Jianxin makes specialist intermediates such as metanilic acid, 3-diethylaminophenol and phloroglucinol (used to synthesise genistein) for dyes and pressure- and heat-sensitive recording paper.
deep_cut_fact: His first job, in 1975, was at the Cangxian county water conservancy bureau; he later became deputy head of the technical section at the Cangxian fertiliser plant. He is also a part-time professor at Hebei Engineering and Technical College.
current_role: Chairman, Hebei Jianxin Chemical Co., Ltd. (建新股份, SZSE: 300107), Cangzhou; re-elected May 2026 to 2029

name: Xie Jianping
profile: Xie Jianping (b. Jan 1972) is one of four Xie family members (with brothers Xie Jianyong and Xie Jianqiang and father Xie Xianxing) who jointly control Yotrio, a major maker of outdoor leisure furniture, sun umbrellas and tents for export markets. He previously served as the company's GM and has been vice chairman since July 2019, holding about 17% directly.
interesting_fact: Yotrio, headquartered in Linhai, Zhejiang, designs and makes outdoor furniture, parasols and tents, largely for overseas retailers; the Xie family together control the listed group.

current_role: Vice Chairman and director, Zhejiang Yotrio Group (浙江永强, SZSE 002489), Linhai, Zhejiang

name: Xie Jianqiang
profile: Xie Jianqiang (谢建强, b. 1975) is one of the four co-controlling Xie family shareholders of Yotrio Group, a Linhai-based maker of outdoor leisure furniture, sun umbrellas and tents sold largely to Western retailers. name: Guo Huaqiang
profile: Guo Huaqiang (郭华强, b. 1956) founded Hangzhou-based Sunyard Technology in 1996. Sunyard makes software and systems for banks and financial institutions. He was chairman until December 2017 and remains on the board for the 2025-2028 term, holding about 10.4m shares.
interesting_fact: He built Sunyard on banking know-how: the company he founded in 1996 makes banking software, an industry he knew from the inside.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding Sunyard he was head of the software section in the technology department of ICBC's Zhejiang branch, then vice-chairman and president of Hangzhou Xinli Electronics. He studied finance at China Central Radio & TV University (1986) and did graduate business-management study at Zhejiang University.
current_role: Founder and Director, Sunyard Technology (信雅达, SSE: 600571), Hangzhou
research_notes: Low media profile. Current Sunyard chairman is Geng Junling, so the company board-secretary route (Ye Hui, per SSE filings) is the published channel. No public email found; the website is mostly script-rendered. Web-search budget ran out during this lane.

name: Hu Qingzhou
profile: Hu Qingzhou (b. 1968) founded Yitoa Electronics in Shenzhen in July 2001 and built it into a ChiNext-listed electronic-components distributor. Since 2020 he has steered it toward semiconductor manufacturing (IDM), starting with the purchase of Pioneer Micro Technology from Japan's Pioneer Corp. He still chairs the company, holding about 8.5% as of April 2026.
interesting_fact: In 2020 Yitoa bought Japanese chipmaker Pioneer Micro Technology for about 3bn yen, a rare Japan-approved Chinese chip acquisition. In late 2025 it announced further 'dual-chip' deals for Guilin Guanglong Integrated Technology and Shanghai Aojian Microelectronics.
deep_cut_fact: Before becoming an entrepreneur he worked at the Huaibei (Anhui) tax bureau and at ICBC's Shenzhen branch. He studied at University of Science and Technology Beijing (BS 1991) and earned a management master's from Tianjin University in 2000, a year before founding Yitoa.
current_role: Founder, Chairman and controlling shareholder, Shenzhen Yitoa Intelligent Control (英唐智控, SZSE: 300131)
research_notes: Active chip-industry founder; the semiconductor localisation and IDM-pivot story could suit an entrepreneurship episode. Best route is the board-secretary/IR email from the 2026 interim report. His stake has shrunk through pledge-related transfers, so avoid that topic.

name: Liang Wei
profile: Liang Wei (梁伟) was chairman and general manager of Wuhan Golden Laser from 2009 and took it public on ChiNext in 2011; the company makes laser cutting/engraving systems and moved into 3D printing. He has since left the board and management but remains the controlling shareholder.
interesting_fact: Golden Laser, the Wuhan laser-equipment maker he led, listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext board in 2011 and later diversified into 3D printing applications.
current_role: Controlling shareholder/actual controller of Wuhan Golden Laser (金运激光, SZSE: 300220); no longer a director or executive
research_notes: Not suitable for outreach: in August 2026 the Jiangsu High Court upheld his conviction for securities-market manipulation (3 years 9 months, RMB 12m fine). Common name; identity tied via Golden Laser.

name: He Daofeng
profile: He Daofeng is a Yunnan-born economist who worked as a researcher at the Central Rural Policy Research Office and the State Council Development Research Center. From 1995 he chaired Huaxia West Economic Development, through which he controlled Kunming Department Store (昆百大), and he was its chairman from 2001 to 2015. He sold control in 2015-16 and retired; he reportedly now lives in the US, writing on ethics and faith.
interesting_fact: He ran a listed retail group and China's biggest poverty NGO at the same time. As Executive President of CFPA from 1999 to 2015 he grew its funds from $2.5m to $90m, with programmes in China and ten other countries.
deep_cut_fact: When he took on the acting presidency of the China Foundation for Poverty Alleviation in 1999 while chairing Huaxia West, he refused a salary. He later won the 2014 Olga Alexeeva Memorial Prize (announced in Istanbul) for developing philanthropy in emerging markets.
current_role: Retired. Former chairman of Kunming Department Store Group (昆百大, now 5i5j / 我爱我家, 000560.SZ) and former Executive President of the China Foundation for Poverty Alleviation
research_notes: Hurun's 'Kunming Sinobright' refers to Kunming Department Store / Huaxia West. Identity is confirmed via the 2016 SZSE disclosure (former CRPRO and DRC researcher, KBD chairman 2001-15). He has been retired since 2015 and reportedly lives in the US. No published contact. A philanthropy and social-enterprise angle is likelier to land than an energy one. Prize source: https://globalfundcommunityfoundations.org/?p=211

name: Shu Longsheng
profile: Born 1963, a senior engineer who was chairman of Wuhu-based Xinlong Electrical, a maker of switchgear and power-distribution equipment, from 1998 to end-2018 and took it public in Shenzhen. He became vice chairman in 2019 as the company expanded into smart-city and information businesses; he has gradually reduced his stake (about 8% in 2020).
interesting_fact: Before Xinlong he ran the Wuhu Electrical Equipment Factory (芜湖市电器设备厂) as factory director, the base of what became the listed power-equipment group.
deep_cut_fact: He started his career as a technician at the Tongling phosphate-ammonium fertilizer plant (铜陵市磷铵厂) before moving into electrical equipment.
current_role: Vice Chairman (since 2019) and major shareholder, Anhui Xinlong Electrical, now CEC Xingfa/中电鑫龙 (SZ: 002298), Wuhu

name: Zhang Qiaomin

He has stepped back; Zhang Haiyan is chairman and sole actual controller per the 2025 annual report.
interesting_fact: Longji grew out of a village enterprise in Longkou's Hongguang village into a listed brake-component exporter supplying overseas auto-parts markets.
deep_cut_fact: His career began as chief accountant and then deputy village committee secretary of Hongguang Village in Longkou before he became director of the Shandong Automotive No. 3 Pump Factory, the seed of Longji.
current_role: Founder and former chairman of Longji Group / Shandong Longji Machinery (002363.SZ), Longkou; left the listed company's board in January 2023

No longer named as actual controller in the 2025 annual report. liujian@ is the board secretary's published address (not the Liu Jian in this lane). Bio from Lixinger (third-party aggregator of filings).

current_role: Chairman, legal representative and actual controller, Kunming Longjin Pharmaceutical Co. (龙津药业; now traded as 龙津5, 400270)
research_notes: Hurun listing only 2015-2016; company was delisted from SZSE in 2025 after losses, so current wealth likely far below list figure. No personal biography found.

interesting_fact: OriginWater, which he helped own, is a pioneer of membrane-bioreactor wastewater technology in China and is now controlled by state-owned China Communications Construction Group.
current_role: Former major shareholder of Beijing OriginWater Technology (碧水源, SZSE: 300070); current role unknown
research_notes: No longer listed among OriginWater's officers in its 2025 annual report; company IR email unlikely to reach him personally. MarketScreener lists a 'Yi Li Chen' as an OriginWater chairman 2007-2019, unverified.

He was unanimously elected chairman in January 2022. He leads a 500+ store brand built on its 'royal heritage', the patented Blue Flame True Heart diamond cut and a Smurfs IP tie-up.
interesting_fact: Under him, Leysen's 蓝火真心钻 (Blue Flame True Heart diamond), which uses a patented cut with a heart shape on the base, won 'jewellery of the year for craftsmanship' at Best of the Best 2022. In May 2022 the brand also issued an NFT version billed as the first digital wedding ring from a high-end jeweller.

current_role: Chairman, Leysen Jewellery / 莱绅通灵 (formerly Tesiro 通灵珠宝, 603900.SH): elected Jan 2022, still chairman in a July 2023 report

interesting_fact: In July 2015 the Belgian royal house made him an Officer of the Order of Leopold, which was described as the first award at that grade to a Chinese businessman.
deep_cut_fact: TESIRO partnered with the Berlin International Film Festival from 2009, became a main partner in 2014, and launched a red-carpet collection in 2010. Shen also co-produced and made a cameo in the TV drama sequel to 'Diamond Lover' (克拉恋人).
current_role: Former chairman of Leysen Jewellery / TESIRO (莱绅通灵, SSE: 603900); stepped down as chairman in January 2022 but stayed on as a director at that time
research_notes: Avoid the 2021-22 control dispute. After stepping down he said he was enjoying the free time. No personal contact found; his current activities after 2022 are not verified.

name: Chen Zhenbiao
profile: Chen Zhenbiao (陈振标), born 1961, is a senior economist with a master's degree. In 2002 he co-founded Wenzhou Peidi Pet Products with family members including Chen Zhenlu and Zheng Xianglan, and built it into Petpal, a leading Chinese maker of pet chews and pet food, much of it exported. It listed on ChiNext in 2017, and he still runs it as chairman and GM.
interesting_fact: Petpal is based in Shuitou town, Pingyang, historically China's leather-processing hub. He also chairs the Zhejiang Import & Export Pet Food and Supplies Association and is vice-president of the China Animal Agriculture Association's pet industry branch.
deep_cut_fact: Before pet food he spent a decade (1992 to 2002) as director of the Pingyang Peidi Leather Goods Factory (平阳县佩蒂皮件制品厂). The Peidi name and the leather know-how carried straight into the pet-chew business he founded in 2002.
current_role: Chairman and General Manager, Petpal Pet Nutrition Technology Co. (SZSE: 300673), Pingyang, Wenzhou
research_notes: Hurun co-lists Zheng Chunlan; the company's co-founder in filings is Zheng Xianglan (郑香兰), possibly the same person under a different romanisation, which I could not verify. Web search quota ran out mid-lane; data comes from Sina Finance filings. Weak fit for the energy/data-centre theme.

name: Zheng Chunlan
profile: Zheng Xianglan (郑香兰; listed as 'Zheng Chunlan') and her husband Chen Zhenbiao jointly control Petpal, a Pingyang, Wenzhou maker of dog chews and pet treats. Petpal listed in Shenzhen in July 2017 as China's 'first pet-food stock'. She remained a top-ten holder and co-controller as of the Q3 2025 report.
interesting_fact: Petpal grew out of Shuitou town's leather industry: leather offcuts became raw material for dog chews in the early 1990s, and chews were over 90% of Petpal's sales in 2014-2016.
current_role: Co-actual controller and top-ten shareholder of Petpal Pet Nutrition Technology (SZSE: 300673), with husband and chairman Chen Zhenbiao; no executive title found
research_notes: English name in source data appears to be a mistransliteration of 郑香兰 (Zheng Xianglan). Low profile; husband Chen Zhenbiao (a former Wenzhou middle-school teacher who started in pet chews in 1992) is the public face. Controller status: https://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2025-10-28/1224742716.PDF. Route via the company securities office.

name: Chen Yongrui
profile: Guangzhou-born (1984) MBA who founded Shengxunda in Dec 2006 and took it public on ChiNext in June 2016 while holding ~60%. The firm began making mobile-phone hardware, then pivoted fully to mobile games (standalone and cross-platform titles) by 2014; it now focuses on casual/social card games for Southeast Asia. Control passed to new owners in 2022.
interesting_fact: Shengxunda started as a mobile-handset hardware company and completely exited hardware in Aug 2014 to become a pure mobile-game developer, two years before its IPO, when he was 31.
current_role: Founder and former chairman/GM, Shenzhen Shengxunda Technology (盛讯达, 300518.SZ; now renamed Guangxi Xinxunda Technology); ceded control in Sept 2022
research_notes: Exchange filings write his name as 陈湧锐. Sensitive: shares frozen in 2021, control changed 2022 (http://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2022-09-30/1214721820.PDF), and a CSRC administrative penalty against the company and its then controller in Dec 2024. No current public role or contact found; not a recommended target.

name: Ma Xiaoming

Through Huizhou Keen Point Precision Plastics it supplies electroplated and painted plastic trim ('one-stop surface decoration') to global automakers, with ~4,700 staff and production in China, Malaysia and Mexico.
interesting_fact: Xin Point has expanded from Huizhou into a global auto-parts supplier with 13 locations; in 2026 its Malaysian plant passed a Tier-1 audit and it is building out in Mexico.
current_role: Founder/controlling shareholder (reported chairman), Xin Point Holdings Ltd (HKEX: 1571), Huizhou
public_contact: ir_email: haorancui@xinpoint.com | press_email: Joewang@xinpoint.com | official_website: https://www.xinpoint.com/

name: Guan Li
profile: Guan Li (官力, born 1979) is an SF Express insider. After strategy consulting in Singapore and Beijing, he joined SF's parent in 2007 and rose from senior strategic-planning manager to VP of strategy management and VP of innovation management. He later headed SF's change-management department. He sat on SF Holding's supervisory board from December 2016, which explains his place on the Hurun list (2017–2020) through SF shares.
interesting_fact: He was one of the strategy executives who joined SF in 2007, long before its 2017 backdoor listing in Shenzhen made Wang Wei and early managers very rich.
deep_cut_fact: He holds a master's in high-performance computation for engineered systems from the National University of Singapore. He began his career as a consultant at a Singapore decision-systems consultancy (2002–05) before moving into logistics strategy.
current_role: Former SF Holding (顺丰控股) supervisor and SF strategy/innovation executive; current role not confirmed
research_notes: Bio is from SF Holding's 2017 annual report (supervisor section). He no longer appears among directors or supervisors in the 2020 report, so the SF IR email is only an indirect route. Very low public profile.

name: Lin Xiaofang
profile: Lin Xiaofang (林肖芳, aged 62 per the 2025 report) built Quanzhou-based Anji Foodstuff, a maker of compound seasonings (rib-flavour and bone-broth seasoning powders, chicken powder, natural-extract seasonings, oyster sauce and soup bases), which listed in Shanghai in 2015. He served as general manager from 1995 to 2020 and remains chairman; the company also has a Cambodian subsidiary.
interesting_fact: Anji's product range includes six main seasoning families - pork-rib, seafood, bone-broth, beef, chicken and restaurant-dish seasonings - plus natural extracts such as mushroom, scallop and abalone essences.
current_role: Chairman and legal representative, Anji Foodstuff / 安记食品 (SH603696), Quanzhou, Fujian
research_notes: Very low media profile. Web search budget ran out before a personal deep-cut fact could be sourced. Route via board secretary (published IR email).

name: Li Songxiao
profile: Li Songxiao (郦松校) led Neo-China Land, a property developer founded in 1999 and listed in Hong Kong in 2003. After aggressive land buying in 2007 and a 2008 suspension, he sold 500 million shares to Shanghai Industrial (SIIC) in 2010 as SIIC took about 45% control. The company was renamed Shanghai Industrial Urban Development.
interesting_fact: In 2010 Shanghai Industrial bought about 45% of Neo-China Land for HK$2.746bn, including 500 million existing shares from Li at HK$2.32 each, ending his control.
current_role: Former chairman and controlling shareholder of Neo-China Land Group (now Shanghai Industrial Urban Development, 0563.HK); no current role found
research_notes: Exited control in 2010; no current public role found. Low suitability for outreach. Web search budget ran out during this lane, so this is minimal; worth a re-run with Chinese-language search (company filings, Qichacha).

name: Tang Bingquan
profile: Wuxi entrepreneur whose Jiangsu Double Elephant Group (founded 1985, originally rubber/plastics machinery) controls 64.5% of listed Double Elephant, one of China's leading makers of microfibre synthetic leather and PU leather (30m metres a year for car interiors, furniture, shoes and bags) and, increasingly, PMMA/MS optical plastics (250,000 tonnes a year).
interesting_fact: Double Elephant has evolved from artificial leather into one of China's top PMMA/MS optical-materials producers, with 250,000 t/yr of capacity alongside its microfibre leather lines.
deep_cut_fact: His holding company, Jiangsu Double Elephant Group, was registered on 9 April 1985 as a rubber-and-plastics machinery business, a quarter-century before its synthetic-leather arm listed in Shenzhen in April 2010.
current_role: Chairman, Jiangsu Double Elephant Group; actual controller of Wuxi Double Elephant Micro Fibre Material Co. (SZSE: 002395)
public_contact: ir_email: sx@sxcxgf.com (listed company disclosure email; board secretary Sang Ping) | official_website: http://www.sxcxgf.com
research_notes: Not on the listed company's board (chairman is Gu Xihong); controls via the group. Very low media profile. Confirmed via 2025 annual report (cninfo).

name: Yu Haifeng
profile: Chengdu-based financier who founded Fanhua Puyi Investment Management in November 2010, a third-party wealth manager for China's mass-affluent and emerging middle class, and took it public on Nasdaq as Puyi Inc. in 2019. He handed the CEO role to Yong Ren in Sept 2019 while staying chairman. The listed company was later renamed Highest Performances and then Maase, and it disposed of the Puyi wealth business in Sept 2025.
interesting_fact: Puyi's US listing structure was a VIE: Yu personally held the onshore operating company Puyi Bohui under contractual arrangements that lasted from 2018 until the business was spun out of the listed group in September 2025.
current_role: Founder of Fanhua Puyi / Puyi Inc. (Chengdu wealth management); no longer a principal shareholder of the listed successor (now Maase Inc., Nasdaq: MAAS)
research_notes: Current activities unclear; he is absent from Maase's 2025 principal-shareholder table. Source for founder/chairman role: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1750264/000121390019018722/f6k092319ex99-1_puyi.htm. No personal contacts found.

Sacon joined the listed Sunrise East group (日出东方, 603366) in 2017; its chairman is now Xu Xinjian. Zou's present activities could not be confirmed.

current_role: Founder-era owner of Sacon (帅康) kitchen appliances, Yuyao, Zhejiang; current role unknown (Sacon now part of listed Sunrise East, 603366)

It was rated the world's seventh-largest transceiver vendor in 2022, bought US silicon-photonics firm Alpine Optoelectronics that year, and its shares surged on Nvidia-driven demand in 2024-25.

name: Sun Li
profile: Sun Li (孙黎) leads Xiamen Amoytop Biotech, founded in 1996 and focused on long-acting recombinant protein drugs, especially peginterferon for chronic hepatitis B. He controls the company jointly with Yang Ying under an acting-in-concert agreement. He holds about 8% directly, and his spouse Cai Zhihua, listed jointly with him by Hurun, holds 2.8%. In October 2026 the controllers pledged not to sell for five years.
interesting_fact: In October 2025 China approved Amoytop's Pegbing (peginterferon alfa-2b) in combination with antivirals to clear hepatitis B surface antigen. China Daily called it the world's first domestically developed drug approved for a functional cure of hepatitis B.
current_role: Chairman, General Manager and legal representative, Xiamen Amoytop Biotech (特宝生物, SSE STAR: 688278); co-actual controller
research_notes: Biotech founder-operator with a strong recent milestone (hepatitis B functional-cure approval). The topic is outside energy/data centres but suits an entrepreneurship episode. The only published route is the company's general email; no personal channels found.

name: Zou Jiachun
profile: Zou Jiachun (born February 1959) founded Hangzhou Huning Elevator Parts Factory in 1996. It grew into a supplier of elevator safety components (buffers, door systems and the like) to global lift makers and listed on ChiNext in 2017. He controls it through Hangzhou Huning Investment and Stafford Investment and also chairs related ventures in laser devices and digital technology.
interesting_fact: Beyond elevator parts, his group has moved into lasers and digital tech through Hangzhou Huning Liangyuan Laser Devices and Xianbite Digital Technology, where he is executive director.
deep_cut_fact: He started in 1978 as a production and operations planner at the Hangzhou Drilling Machinery Factory and spent a decade there. He then became deputy director of the Hangzhou Xizi auto-parts factory (1988-95), before founding his own elevator-parts workshop in April 1996.
current_role: Chairman and General Manager (controlling shareholder), Hangzhou Huning Elevator Parts Co. (沪宁股份, 300669.SZ)
research_notes: Self-made, with a junior-college education. Very low media profile. The company email listed in the annual report is the best route (board secretary contacts are also published there).

name: Wang Junyang
profile: Wang Junyang (王君扬) is a member of the Dongguan Wang family that controls Kanghua Healthcare, a for-profit private hospital operator listed in Hong Kong since 2016. He joined Kanghua Hospital in 2007, rose through operations and business-development roles, became executive director in 2015 and now chairs the group, which runs two general hospitals in Dongguan, a cardiovascular hospital in Chongqing and rehab services in Anhui.
interesting_fact: Kanghua Hospital was among the first private for-profit general hospitals in China to earn the top 'Grade 3A' (三级甲等) rating, and the group set up a Huawei branch hospital (东莞康华医院·华为分院) in partnership with Huawei.
deep_cut_fact: In 2012 he served as president of the 5th council of the Dongguan Young Entrepreneurs Association, and in June 2014 was named an 'Outstanding Young Dongguan Merchant' by the World Dongguan Merchants Convention organising committee.
current_role: Executive director & chairman, Guangdong Kanghua Healthcare Group (康华医疗, HKEX: 3689), Dongguan
research_notes: Second-generation family business leader; low international profile. Route via company IR email. Healthcare focus; weak fit for energy theme.

interesting_fact: Minkave designs and builds urban night-scape lighting projects, a niche that boomed with Chinese cities' landmark lighting shows in the 2010s.

name: Zhang Jinshan
profile: Jinshan Zhang (b. 1963, US citizen) holds a chemistry PhD from the University of Michigan and founded Shanghai Phichem in 2002; it develops and makes UV-curable materials and other new materials for high-tech uses and listed in 2014. Hurun listed him with Wang Lili. He also chairs Jiangsu Hecheng Display Technology.
interesting_fact: A US-trained chemist (Michigan PhD, US citizen), he built Phichem around UV-curable materials, later expanding into display and electronic chemicals, including chairing Jiangsu Hecheng Display Technology.
deep_cut_fact: He earned a master's at the CAS Shanghai Institute of Optics and Fine Mechanics (1987) after a chemistry degree at East China Normal University (1983), before his 1993 Michigan PhD.
current_role: Chairman (and acting board secretary), Shanghai PhiChem Corporation (SZ:300398)
research_notes: Materials supplier to electronics; possible data-center/fibre angle worth checking in company materials. US-educated; likely comfortable in English.

name: Xie Yong
profile: Xie Yong (谢勇) leads 5I5J Holding Group, the listed parent of 5i5j (我爱我家), one of China's largest housing brokerages. The listed company, formerly Kunming Department Store Group (Kunming Sinobright), was originally a Kunming retail business and is now a Beijing-based brokerage, rental and asset-management platform. He was re-elected to the board in August 2026.

current_role: Director and board leader of 5I5J Holding Group (我爱我家控股, SZSE: 000560). Re-elected in August 2026 and presided over the 12th board's first meeting, very likely as chairman.

interesting_fact: Yuanlong Yato has been an official licensed producer/retailer for the 2008 Beijing Olympics, 2010 Shanghai Expo, 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics and Paralympics, and the 2025 Harbin Asian Winter Games.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding the company he was a teacher at Beijing Union University's economics & management school (1988-90) and a lecturer at Beijing University of Technology (1990-98); he chairs the gift-industry chamber of the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce.
